The cavern is infested with Dreugh and slaughterfish, likely serving as an outer colony for the substantial Dreugh citadel known as The Whispers. Scattered gemstones constitute the grotto's primary points of interest, found resting on and within the organic Dreugh furniture that litters the cave.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Diru Grotto is.

title: Disturbed Shipwreck
topic_desc: This former Dres vessel rests deep on the Andaram lakebed within an underwater ditch, situated east of Andarannipal and south of Aimrah in the Aanthirin region. Dreugh have claimed the sunken wreck as their lair, inhabiting its three submerged levels.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Disturbed Shipwreck is.

title: Doldig Isle
topic_desc: Doldig Isle is a tiny, uninhabited island situated in Dagon Urul, close to Firewatch. The residents of Firewatch attribute a protective significance to the isle, commonly describing it as sitting like a sentinel guarding the bay. Local belief holds that the island watches over Firewatch, helping to keep the city safe from surrounding hostiles.
topic_desc_basic: Doldig Isle is a tiny, uninhabited island in Dagon Urul, close to Firewatch. Locals believe it sits like a sentinel guarding the bay, watching over and helping to keep the city safe from surrounding hostiles.

title: Dolmolag Peninsula
topic_desc: The Dolmolag Peninsula is a vast promontory within the Boethiah's Spine region that projects into the Sea of Ghosts. It forms the eastern arm encompassing Noloubal Bay, paired with the Nedweisra Peninsula to the west. A narrow strait separates the Dolmolag Peninsula from Althoa to the west. The peninsula is dominated by the Velothi village of Bal Oyra, which stands at its northern tip and features a lighthouse.
topic_desc_basic: The Dolmolag Peninsula is a large promontory in Boethiah's Spine that juts into the Sea of Ghosts. It forms the eastern arm of Noloubal Bay and is dominated by the Velothi village of Bal Oyra at its northern tip.

title: Dondril
topic_desc: Dondril is a small farming village in the Aanthirin region, situated south of Old Ebonheart along the road. It falls under the rule of Indoril Ilvi of Roa Dyr. Surrounded by a palisade of uncertain purpose, the settlement works the surrounding Indoril farmlands in commonage, utilizing slave labor to cultivate corkbulb, scrib cabbage, and meadow-rye. Local commerce is modest, consisting of a street smith, two limited merchants in the Craftsmer's Hall, and a small outdoor bar. A hetman administers the village and enforces bounties on escaped slaves and criminals as directed by the Indoril lordship. The surrounding area features a Malacath shrine within the daedric ruin of Hadrumnibibi.
topic_desc_basic: Dondril is a small farming village south of Old Ebonheart in the Aanthirin region. It falls under Indoril rule and works the surrounding farmlands in commonage, cultivating crops like corkbulb and meadow-rye with slave labor.

title: Dorammu Cavern
topic_desc: Dorammu Cavern is a small natural cave situated in the Boethiah's Spine region, south of the settlement of Andar Mok. The cavern features an interior waterfall and flooded passages inhabited by slaughterfish. The southern end of the cave serves as the dwelling of a Dunmer healer, whose den contains books, potions, and alchemical apparatus amid common storage containers. The cave's remote position, accessible via a rope bridge spanning a gorge, and its limited contents suggest it sees little regular traffic.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dorammu Cavern is.

title: Dosadan Grotto
topic_desc: Dosadan Grotto is a largely dry cavern situated in the Lan Orethan region. The entrance lies high on a cliffside above the waters, upriver from Vlars Manor. The grotto is occupied by parastylus and offers little of material value, being rich only in violet coprinus fungi. Beyond this modest flora, the cave holds no significant wealth or resources.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dosadan Grotto is.

title: Dothril Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Dothril Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral burial site in the Aanthirin region, situated south-southeast of Hlan Oek. The upper level was once ransacked by looters who established temporary camp there, but these intruders were subsequently slain by vengeful undead emerging from the deeper chambers. The lower level, where the tomb's most significant treasures remain, is decorated with gold and ebony and houses an Adamantium dagger, suggesting an apparent connection to a Hlaalu family. A Glass shortsword also resides among the lower chambers. The tomb's undead guardians continue to patrol the site, deterring further desecration.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dothril Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Dragonhead Point
topic_desc: Dragonhead Point is a prominent rock formation in the Boethiah's Spine region, situated where the river draining Lake Boethiah meets the Padomaic Ocean, east of Alt Bosara. The structure strikingly evokes a giant petrified dragon head and spine. Local lore offers diverse explanations for its origin. One legend claims a grieving dragon, whose child was abducted by a Telvanni sorceress, lay waiting in the water until it died and turned to stone. Alternative accounts variously attribute the formation to an Alteration and Illusion spell, a swordsman carving a mountain, a Dunmeri navigational landmark built centuries ago, a dragon that ate harmful berries, a decapitated dragon turned to stone by a Telvanni spellsword, or a durable illusion. Skeptics dismiss it as an accidental pile of stones shaped like a dragon.
topic_desc_basic: Dragonhead Point is a prominent rock formation in the Boethiah's Spine region, east of Alt Bosara, where the river draining Lake Boethiah flows into the Padomaic Ocean. The landmark strikingly resembles a giant petrified dragon head and spine, inspiring varied local legends regarding its origin.

title: Drakehold Ruin
topic_desc: Drakehold Ruin is an old Imperial fortification west of Necrom in the Sacred Lands region of Morrowind. The site is infested with undead and comprises two zones: a keep and a dungeon.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drakehold Ruin is.

title: Dralnabissit
topic_desc: Dralnabissit is a cave situated in the Mephalan Vales region. It currently serves as a refuge for smugglers and a necromancer.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dralnabissit is.

title: Drals Farmhouse
topic_desc: Drals Farmhouse is a hamum root farm situated in the eastern Coronati Basin, northeast of Ald Marak. The settlement is operated by Ivela Drals, who hails from Bal Foyen, and her husband Salamat, a former Ashlander. The farm also relies on the labor of an Argonian slave. As a modest agricultural homestead, it yields local produce for trade in the surrounding region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drals Farmhouse is.

title: Dread Minotaur
topic_desc: The Dread Minotaur is a House Hlaalu trading vessel navigating Lake Coronati in the Coronati Basin. The ship is owned by a rival of Ivul Hleryn; a recovered sailor's diary strongly suggests the owner is Hlaalu Councilor Atran Oran, referencing his past as a fighter in the Narsis Arena. The vessel transports goods and enslaved Argonian and Khajiit across the lake. Following a violent boarding, the ship sinks to the lake bottom, where it remains as a submerged wreck.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dread Minotaur is.

title: Dren Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Dren Ancestral Tomb is the ancestral tomb of the prominent Dren family. It is situated in the Shipal-Shin region of mainland Morrowind, southeast of Narsis and the Old Dren Plantation, just south of the Chimer stronghold of Indomarano. The tomb contains notable heirlooms, including a Holy Tower Shield and the enchanted Shirt of Ultis Dren, both secured in the southernmost chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dren Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Drenim Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Drenim Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Sunad Mora region, a short distance northwest of Llothanis. Like many such tombs, it is inhabited by undead guardians, including bonelords and a lich, which protect the interred ancestors and their funerary goods. The tomb contains notable treasure, including an Orcish battle axe concealed in a submerged passage accessible through a small cave pool. The presence of a lich among the guardians suggests that at least one of the Drenim ancestors attained significant power in life or undeath. The tomb's proximity to Llothanis places it within the settled coastal reaches of Morrowind's Telvanni-influenced northeast.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drenim Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Drenka Cavern
topic_desc: Drenka Cavern is a large natural cave situated in the Sunad Mora region of mainland Morrowind. Its primary significance lies in providing access to the Daedric Shrine of Ibiammusashan, which is reached through the cavern's southeastern reaches. The cave itself serves as a modest waypoint, containing only scattered supplies such as bottles of Shein, crates of iron armor, and kwama eggs. It is currently inhabited by Daedra, wild animals, and the thief Naruni Drethan, who has taken up residence within its chambers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drenka Cavern is.

title: Dreynim
topic_desc: Dreynim is an Indoril-aligned settlement in the Lan Orethan region, distinguished by its prominent hot springs spa. The settlement caters to visitors seeking the baths, featuring a multi-winged resort complex with dedicated hotel, restaurant, and foyer facilities. Beyond the spa, Dreynim sustains a local economy of boat-building and general trade, supported by a shipwright's office, equipment and storage shacks, and outdoor merchants. The permanent community resides in outlying shacks and the spa's upper wings. The population is predominantly Dunmer of House Indoril, though outlanders—including Imperials, Nords, Wood Elves, and a Redguard—mingle among the nobles, commoners, and pilgrims frequenting the resort.
topic_desc_basic: Dreynim is an Indoril settlement in the Lan Orethan region known for its hot springs spa. The village features a sizeable resort complex with baths, a hotel, and a restaurant, drawing visitors alongside a local boat-building trade.

title: Dreynim Spa
topic_desc: Dreynim Spa is a famous resort northwest of Dreynim, situated at the edge of the Lan Orethan forest in Indoril territory. The large establishment features its own hotel, a restaurant, and underground hot springs. Its guest records indicate visits from prominent figures such as King Helseth, Barenziah, and Grand Ascendant Neril Sevuro.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dreynim Spa is.

title: Drolam Grotto
topic_desc: Drolam Grotto is a small coastal cavern in the Dagon Urul region, its entrance resting on the beach north of Tel Oren and some distance southeast of Firewatch. The flooded interior harbors rich pearl deposits, with kollops and eyestars thickly lining the submerged rock. Slaughterfish and a dreugh inhabit the waters, posing a threat to any who would harvest the grotto's bounty. The cave comprises a single zone of interconnected rocky passages beneath the coastal cliffs. Though the pearl beds offer potential reward, the aquatic predators and confined underwater passages make Drolam Grotto a dangerous site for all but the most prepared divers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drolam Grotto is.

title: Drolar Manor Ruin
topic_desc: Drolar Manor Ruin is an ancient structure situated deep within the Dulun-Sarethi Egg Mine in the Boethiah's Spine region. Built in the manner of a manor, its ground floor contains an antechamber, a dining room, and a locked bedroom, while a basement holds several cages. The site teems with undead guardians and is presided over by the lich Lord Drolar. The ruin holds notable artifacts, including Native Chuzei Gauntlets, rare books, an Ebony Katana, an Indoril Shield, and the shortsword Flametail. The presence of basement cages suggests the architecture may have originally served a different purpose before its current undead infestation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drolar Manor Ruin is.

title: Droryn Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Droryn Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Coronati Basin. It serves as the resting place for the Droryn family, housing the remains and possessions of its ancestors, including Fervayn Droryn and his Cane. Recently, the tomb has become a site of spiritual disturbance. A shrine to Arkay was placed within by Ganalis Droryn, a family member residing in Sadrathim who sought to honor the dead. However, this act has caused consternation among the ancestral ghosts interred there, who are unnerved by the presence of the Arkay shrine. The tomb also contains valuable ebony tableware in its southeastern chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Droryn Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Drothril Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Drothril Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer burial site in the Aanthirin region, situated on a steep cliff northwest of Roa Dyr. The interior is littered with ectoplasm and guarded by ancestor ghosts. Offerings left on the sarcophagi suggest the Drothril lineage included individuals of disreputable character, such as a skooma addict and a thief. A Shrine of Almalexia's Mercy stands within the first chamber. The tomb's elevated position makes approach difficult, with no obvious path; the easiest ascent is from the daedric ruin of Hadrumnibibi.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drothril Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Drurel Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Drurel Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Coronati Basin. It serves as the resting place of Terur Drurel, regarded as the last Knight of Dibella, who was interred with the artifact Heartseeker. The tomb's undead inhabitants guard these remains and the ancient blade.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Drurel Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Dubshal Hive
topic_desc: Dubshal Hive is a skyrender nest situated in the Shipal-Shin region, east of Ald Khan. The hive is inhabited by skyrenders, including a queen within its deepest chamber. The nest holds the tome Dead Magic within the queen's chamber, alongside a Dreugh Shield in an adjoining passage.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dubshal Hive is.

title: Duda
topic_desc: Duda is a cavern situated in the hills behind the Savrethi Distillery within the Roth Roryn region. Currently serving as a hideout, it is occupied by a band of smugglers and bandits. The group includes rogues, scouts, agents, and battlemages who have established a secure base within the cave's chambers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Duda is.

title: Dulandos
topic_desc: Dulandos is a large ruined Indoril settlement situated on a rocky ridge east of Bosmora in the Lan Orethan region. Its verdant surroundings and commanding view suggest it was once a rich and beautiful locale. The site comprises eight distinct zones: an outdoor square, a shrine, a vicarage, a ruined house, a main hall, catacombs, storage chambers, living quarters, and a top floor. The ruin is currently occupied by a community of necromancers and their undead servants. The vicarage houses a senior necromancer, Akintal, alongside filled soul gems and an Alteration skill book, while the main hall serves as a lecture and study area for the broader group. Additional necromancers operate from the ruined house, catacombs, storage chambers, and living quarters. The shrine and deeper catacombs are warded by locked doors that trigger magical traps and summon guardian undead upon activation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dulandos is.

title: Dulun-Sarethi Egg Mine
topic_desc: Dulun-Sarethi Egg Mine is a deserted kwama egg mine situated in the Boethiah's Spine region. Once a working source of kwama eggs, the mine's kwama colony has perished entirely, leaving only egg sacs and no living creatures. The settlement holds a subterranean connection to Drolar Manor Ruin, accessed via a door within the otherwise empty tunnels. The site lies along a valley route near the ruins of Bal Dushal, positioned between Tel Muthada and Alt Bosara.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dulun-Sarethi Egg Mine is.

title: Dulun Varethi's Shack
topic_desc: Dulun Varethi's Shack is a modest seaside dwelling resting on a small peninsula north of Necrom within the Sacred Lands. Facing the Padomaic Ocean, the structure reflects a solitary existence, its occupant subsisting on fish harvested from the surrounding waters. The shack holds little of material value, serving as a simple hermitage along the rugged coast near the holy city of the Dunmer dead.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dulun Varethi's Shack is.

title: Dun Akafell
topic_desc: Dun Akafell is a vast ancient ruin in the Mephalan Vales, situated west of Akamora. The site comprises at least sixteen interconnected zones, including an entrance, canals, forgotten tunnels and vaults, a forsaken manor with a basement, an ominous manor, a rectory, a ruined chapel, and a ruined house. Numerous entrances are scattered across the hillside. Vampires of an unknown clan infest the many interiors. The ruin holds notable artifacts, including an adamantium katana, a dreugh helm, glass daggers and tantos, and an ebony dagger. A valuable gem known as the Nobura Tayo is located at the chapel altar.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dun Akafell is.
aliases: Dun Akafell, Forgotten Vault, Upper Floor

title: Dunada-Nammu
topic_desc: Dunada-Nammu is an ancient Dunmer burial chamber in the Sunad Mora region, north of the township of Ranyon-ruhn along the Bosouada road. The tomb is inhabited by mummified undead, a relatively rare form of corporeal undead in Morrowind, numbering at least nine. The interior comprises multiple burial chambers arranged across several levels, featuring a waterfall and pools of standing water. Interred grave goods of diverse cultural origin accompany the mummified dead, including weapons and precious materials. Some chambers are situated at considerable elevation and are difficult to reach without magical levitation. The presence of mummies rather than the ancestral ghosts or bonewalkers more typical of Dunmer barrows suggests a distinct funerary tradition or preservation practice associated with this site.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dunada-Nammu is.

title: Dundras Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Dundras Ancestral Tomb is an expansive and labyrinthine Dunmer burial site situated in the Sundered Scar region. The tomb's winding passages and considerable depth form a maze-like interior that guards the remains of the Dundras lineage. Like many ancestral tombs, it is inhabited by undead protectors that ward against intrusions. The site holds notable cultural artifacts: a copy of the 36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 8, rests in a chamber near the entrance, and a Glass Poisonsword is concealed within the deeper maze sections, accessible only through levitation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dundras Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Dungra
topic_desc: Dungra is a large coastal cave situated on the shores of Lake Boethiah within the Boethiah's Spine region, near Tel Mothrivra. The cavern currently serves as a lair for a band of slavers and smugglers. Its interior includes both dry chambers furnished with communal bunks and an submerged section inhabited by hostile creatures. The gang stores modest contraband within the cave, including sacks of moon sugar and mundane crates of weapons and armor, though it holds no notable treasures.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dungra is.

title: Dunnechi Bay
topic_desc: Dunnechi Bay is an inlet where the Bosouada river flows into the Sea of Ghosts. The Telvanni settlement of Tel Ouada is constructed on a platform of mushrooms extending into the bay. To the east, a promontory holds the Tel Ouada Guar Farm, while the Saekim-Sur Grotto lies at the promontory's base.
topic_desc_basic: Dunnechi Bay is an inlet on the Sea of Ghosts where the Bosouada river meets the coast. The Telvanni town of Tel Ouada sits on mushroom platforms extending into the bay.

title: Dunusi
topic_desc: Dunusi is a cavern in the Roth Roryn region of Morrowind mainland, situated near the Dunmer settlement of Menaan. The cave serves as a smuggler's hideout, occupied by bandits and outlaws of various sorts. Its single large, deep chamber holds a substantial collection of contraband goods. The presence of a Camonna Tong thug among its occupants suggests ties between the cavern's criminal denizens and that syndicate. Dunusi also harbors an Ashlander spirit, Tissamsi, a former healer whose ghostly presence lingers within the cave. The combination of smuggler activity and an ancestral Ashlander ghost marks Dunusi as a site where underworld commerce and older spiritual presences coexist.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dunusi is.

title: Duril Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Duril Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer burial site situated on the isle of Althoa, within the Sea of Ghosts region northeast of Bahrammu. Like many ancestral tombs, it serves as the protected resting place for the Duril lineage's dead. The interior is guarded by several undead, including Skeleton Archers and four Bonewalkers, whose enfeebling curses present a significant hazard to any who disturb the crypt.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Duril Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Durthungz
topic_desc: Durthungz is a Dwemer ruin situated in the Sacred Lands, on the far eastern side of the peninsula holding Necrom, near Virith Ancestral Tomb. The site comprises four distinct zones: the Faltering Tower, the Hallway, the Restless Tower, and the Sleepless Eye. Like many Dwemer strongholds, it remains defended by active automata, including Steam Centurions and a Centurion Archer guarding the bridge connecting the Sleepless Eye and Hallway to the upper towers. The ruin also harbors Dwarven Spectres within the Restless Tower and a Greater Dwarven Spectre in the Faltering Tower. Scattered Dwemer coins, weaponry, and gem-filled kegs endure within its chambers, reflecting the durable construction and lingering hazards typical of such sites.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Durthungz is.

title: Dusura
topic_desc: Dusura is a cave in the Armun Ashlands serving as a lair for a ravenous vampire. Its entrance is situated between the Dwemer ruin of Barzamthuand and the Velothi tower of Udai, overlooked by the former. A short passageway within leads to a small, flooded chamber where the undead inhabitant dwells.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Dusura is.

title: Duvana's Shack
topic_desc: Duvana's Shack is a small dwelling and farmstead in the Aanthirin region, situated east of Old Ebonheart. The property lies across a rope bridge from the monastery of Serynthul. The shack stands empty, its occupant absent and whereabouts unknown. The surrounding field marks it as a modest agricultural holding rather than a mere shelter.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Duvana's Shack is.

title: Ebamasharisus
topic_desc: Ebamasharisus is a small Daedric shrine dedicated to the Daedric Prince Malacath, situated in the Shipal-Shin region of Morrowind. The site is inhabited by Malacath cultists and Daedra. A glass pauldron rests upon the Prince's pedestal as an offering. The shrine is distinct from the similarly named ruin Ebamusharisus.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ebamasharisus is.

title: Ebamusharisus
topic_desc: Ebamusharisus is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Mehrunes Dagon, situated within a steep-sided canyon in the Sunad Mora region. The site is occupied by Dagon's daedra and cultists. Its altar holds a piece of raw ebony and a ruby, both cursed to summon adversaries if disturbed. The shrine holds little other wealth, though the Masque of Purity and two Daedric darts remain embedded in the body of a slain individual near the premises.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ebamusharisus is.

title: Ebunammidan
topic_desc: Ebunammidan is a Daedric shrine dedicated to the Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon, situated within the region of Dagon Urul. The site comprises three distinct zones: the Outer Shrine, the Antechamber, and the Inner Shrine. The Inner Shrine houses a statue of Mehrunes Dagon before which notable offerings such as a Daedric Saber and ebony throwing stars are displayed. The Antechamber holds further valuable offerings, including a Glass Helm and a Grandmaster's Calcinator. The shrine is inhabited by Dagon-worshipping cultists and summoned Daedra who guard the sacred chambers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ebunammidan is.

title: Edalvel Plantation
topic_desc: Edalvel Plantation is a Hackle-Lo plantation located in the Othreleth Woods, situated a short distance from the settlement of Hlerynhul. The estate is owned by the Hlaalu noble Thavere Edalvel and managed by the overseer Melur Beloth. The grounds include a manor house, a guard tower, and storage facilities. Like many such operations in the region, the plantation relies on the labor of enslaved Argonians and Khajiit.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Edalvel Plantation is.

title: Edhryn Farothran's Lighthouse
topic_desc: Edhryn Farothran's Lighthouse is an isolated lighthouse situated on a cape jutting into the Padomaic Ocean, southeast of Baldrahn within the Boethiah's Spine region. The structure serves as both a navigational aid and the personal residence of its lightkeeper, Edhryn Farothran. The interior reflects the keeper's quiet pursuits, stocked with several barrels and bottles of sujamma and mazte, alongside a small collection of literature including copies of Mysterious Akavir and A Less Rude Song.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Edhryn Farothran's Lighthouse is.

title: Edryn Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Edryn Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer burial site in the Aanthirin region, located south of Almas Thirr and southwest of the Oran Plantation. The tomb is inhabited by undead—a bonewalker and two ancestor ghosts—standing vigil over the sarcophagi within. Its lower chamber contains burial goods, including precious stones such as ruby and jet. An Amulet of Silence rests atop one of the sarcophagi.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Edryn Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Ehameshulk
topic_desc: Ehameshulk is a cave situated in the Shipal-Shin region on the border with Black Marsh. The cavern burrows into a brown mesa located between the Ayleid ruin of Mala Tor and the Chimer stronghold of Kaladryon, near Stormgate Pass. It currently serves as a lair for a band of outlaws who keep tamed nix-hounds within its chambers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ehameshulk is.

title: Elandad
topic_desc: Elandad is a small flooded hilltop cavern in the Roth Roryn region of Morrowind mainland, situated southeast of Omaynin. The cave is largely unremarkable, serving as a nest for rats. Within its southeastern passage lies the skeleton of an unidentified individual, chained to a rock. A note found nearby suggests the likely involvement of the Camonna Tong in whatever transpired there. Little else of note occupies the cavern.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Elandad is.

title: Elaraddu Grotto
topic_desc: Elaraddu Grotto is a large, crystal-filled cavern situated beneath the surface of Lake Andaram within the Aanthirin region. Its submerged entrance lies to the northwest of Paruddma's Maw. The grotto is inhabited by dreugh and slaughterfish, typical denizens of such underwater cave systems.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Elaraddu Grotto is.

title: Elfmaid
topic_desc: The Elfmaid is a cargo ship currently docked at Bal Oyra for repairs after suffering severe damage off the island of Althoa. Her most recent voyage originated in Old Ebonheart, where she took on a cargo of cloth and supplies destined for Tel Ouada and Llothanis. The vessel's hold contains stores of food, weapons, chests of gold, and crates of moon sugar. The captain's cabin holds a chest of weaponry. The ship's company includes a cook, a warrior, a trader, and an Argonian sailor who offers training.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Elfmaid is.

title: Elvul Farm
topic_desc: Elvul Farm is an agricultural estate and processing mill situated on a slope southeast of Narsis's Council Quarter in the Shipal-Shin region. The facility specializes in processing Drumpear Seeds. The property operates under the ownership of Bolvynu Elvul, who employs a Wood Elf retainer and maintains two Argonian slaves to work the fields. The site consists of a farmhouse and a windmill.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Elvul Farm is.

title: Ember Keep
topic_desc: Ember Keep is a mighty Imperial stronghold in Firewatch, guarding the Eastern Inner Sea. As old as the city it protects, the complex comprises three distinct components: the keep itself, the Drakelight Beacon—a great lighthouse maintained by the knightly Order of Firewatch—and the Dustmoth Legion Garrison. This arrangement encloses three separate military forces within a single fortified enclosure. The keep is ruled by Duchess Perulia Jandacia, an Imperial who assumed the duchy following the death of the previous Dunmer duchess, Bredami Vaynth, who left no heirs. As ruler of the Telvannis District, the duchess governs from the Great Hall. The stronghold's interior includes ducal chambers, high halls, guard barracks, a wizard's tower, and a treasure chamber, reflecting its role as the seat of Imperial authority in the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ember Keep is.

title: Emmurbalpitu
topic_desc: Emmurbalpitu is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Azura, situated in the Aanthirin region between the Mundrethi and Oran plantations. The ruins are concealed within a deep crater, accessible through the underwater grotto of Malarnubi or by levitation. The site comprises four distinct zones: the Broken Halls, the Aisle of Dawn, the Aisle of Dusk, and the Crepuscular Shrine. The Broken Halls and aisles are inhabited by the non-hostile spirits of Azura's worshippers. The Aisle of Dawn is only accessible during early morning hours, while the Aisle of Dusk opens only in the early evening. The innermost Crepuscular Shrine bears the smoking remains of War Ordinators, indicating a violent historical conflict. Offerings of gems lie before a statue of Azura, and the heretical text Crimes of the Tribunal is housed within the Aisle of Dusk.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Emmurbalpitu is.

title: Enamor Dayn
topic_desc: Enamor Dayn is a small, peaceful Indoril town situated on the east coast of Morrowind within the Nedothril region. Though sleepy, it sustains decent enchanter and blacksmith services at its local tradehouse. A pier offers boat transport to the island settlement of Gorne. The surrounding area borders the Lan Orethan forests to the west, near which the Daedric ruins of Bushipananit rise above the treeline. Local landmarks include Adarys Manor and The Gentle Velk tavern.
topic_desc_basic: A small, peaceful Indoril town on the east coast of Morrowind in the Nedothril region, with boat transport to Gorne.

title: Enar Sothran's Shack
topic_desc: Enar Sothran's Shack is an isolated fisherman's dwelling situated on the Kanit River within the Othreleth Woods. The structure stands opposite Hladri Winery. While ostensibly the home of the Dark Elf fisherman Enar Sothran, the shack serves as a covert waystop for smugglers, a fact obscured by its remote riverside location.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Enar Sothran's Shack is.

title: Endelius' Shack
topic_desc: Endelius' Shack is an isolated homestead situated on an island east of Edhryn Farothran's Lighthouse within the Boethiah's Spine region. The dwelling serves as the residence of Endelius, an Imperial alchemist. The interior holds alchemical apparatus, including a journeyman's mortar and pestle, various ingredients and potions, and a copy of the skill book A Game at Dinner. A small garden of corkbulb plants grows outside the structure. A Breton farmer, Fenandre Hutresien, is presently found outside the premises.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Endelius' Shack is.

title: Endrovel Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Endrovel Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral burial site situated within the Boethiah's Spine region. Like other such tombs, it serves as the resting place for the deceased of the Endrovel lineage and is typically guarded by the undead remains of the family's ancestors. The tomb consists of a single interior zone.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Endrovel Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Enravel Egg Mine
topic_desc: Enravel Egg Mine is a kwama egg mine situated on the Peninsula of Veloth within the Sacred Lands region. The site operates as a working mine, harvesting kwama eggs from egg sacs and storing yields in shipping crates and barrels. A small crew of Dark Elf miners works the tunnels. The operation receives religious oversight from a Tribunal Temple acolyte stationed at the site. The mine lies within the range of both Almsivi Intervention, linking it to Necrom, and Divine Intervention, connecting it to Fort Umbermoth.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Enravel Egg Mine is.

title: Entrenched Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Entrenched Shipwreck is a sunken vessel resting deep within a trench in the Sea of Ghosts, situated just west of Sadas Plantation in the Telvanni Isles. The wreck holds notable cargo: four crates in the hold collectively store a significant quantity of raw glass, alongside the drowned corpse of a sailor named Roderick and his ornamental key. The ship's cabin contains a chest holding the ebony dai-katana Goujian, a weapon of considerable repute. The circumstances of the ship's sinking remain obscure, though its substantial and valuable cargo suggests it was a merchant or expeditionary vessel lost to the treacherous northern waters.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Entrenched Shipwreck is.

title: Eravan
topic_desc: Eravan is a three-shack farming village located just east of Roa Dyr in the Aanthirin region. Under Indoril alignment, its inhabitants cultivate corkbulb and comberry. The settlement is modest, consisting of the shacks of Omarcil, a Wood Elf farmer and former tutor-slave, and Talsi Envano, a Dark Elf commoner, along with the outdoor farmer Ulor Noryn. Eravan falls within the intervention range of Almas Thirr for Almsivi Intervention and Old Ebonheart for Divine Intervention.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Eravan is.

title: Erda's Shack
topic_desc: Erda's Shack is a small shack situated in the Alt Orethan region. It serves as the home of Erda Neriem, a Dark Elf commoner.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Erda's Shack is.

title: Erechel's Shack
topic_desc: Erechel's Shack is a fisherman's dwelling at the foot of the Pryai River's cascading waterfalls in the Roth Roryn region. The shack sits below the falls near a wooden bridge along the riverbank west of Bodrum. It is a modest structure with little of note inside.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Erechel's Shack is.

title: Erelis Ilnim's Cave
topic_desc: Erelis Ilnim's Cave is a cave dwelling in the Lan Orethan region of mainland Morrowind, serving as the hermitage of a meditating pilgrim. The cave is reached by following the road north from the settlement of Dreynim and taking the first right fork. The occupant, Erelis Ilnim, is a Dark Elf monk given to contemplative retreat. The cave is described as comfortable rather than austere, suggesting some modest provision for habitation. Erelis welcomes visitors with pleasant surprise but can offer them little beyond his own company. The site reflects the broader Dunmer tradition of religious or philosophical withdrawal into isolated natural shelters, away from settled communities.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Erelis Ilnim's Cave is.

title: Erendi Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Erendi Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral burial site situated on a ridge in the Velothi Mountains, east of Hendor-Stardumz. The ridge serves as a geographic divide separating the Velothi Mountains from the Armun Ashlands. Like many such tombs, it serves as the resting place for the honored dead of the Erendi lineage. The tomb is guarded by undead, including skeletons and a bonelord, which protect the ancestral remains and interred treasures. Among the notable items housed within is a glass war axe, located in the easternmost chamber of the tomb.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Erendi Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Erethan Plantation
topic_desc: Erethan Plantation is a wickwheat plantation situated north of Akamora in the Molag Ruhn region. The estate is owned by the Erethan family of House Indoril. Its centerpiece is a manor housing the family head, Drelom Erethan, who reportedly never leaves the building, having secluded himself in mourning for his deceased wife. Drelom also holds ownership of nearby Hlersis, a settlement devoted to bloatspore mining. The plantation grounds feature a guarded tower, along with outbuildings that include storage facilities and separate shacks. The settlement maintains a labor force of slaves who work the grounds and are quartered in the outlying shacks.
topic_desc_basic: Erethan Plantation is a wickwheat plantation located north of Akamora in the Molag Ruhn region. It is owned by the Erethan family of House Indoril.

title: Eriba-Adad
topic_desc: Eriba-Adad is a sapphire-studded cave situated in the Shipal-Shin region, accessible by descending into the canyon crossed by the first bridge along the Purple Road from Septim's Gate Pass. The cavern is inhabited by wild beasts, including Nix-Hounds, Slaughterfish, and Canyon Threshers. Four sapphire veins are scattered throughout the passages. A flooded western section conceals an entrance to the ancient burial site of Hattusili, making the cave of particular interest to archaeologists.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Eriba-Adad is.

title: Erishanu Ramaran's Shack
topic_desc: Erishanu Ramaran's Shack is a solitary dwelling perched on the edge of the Velothi Mountains within the Roth Roryn region. The structure commands a panoramic view of the surrounding landscape. Despite bearing the name of its supposed occupant, Erishanu Ramaran remains absent from the premises, and her whereabouts are unknown. The shack sits at the terminus of a winding path leading northwest from the Bodrum quarry, offering a secluded vantage point in the highlands.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Erishanu Ramaran's Shack is.

title: Ermunsour
topic_desc: Ermunsour is a long, winding cavern in the Velothi Mountains, northwest of Balititashpi, concealing a forgotten shrine. The entrance lies hidden on a small rocky hillock. The tunnel descends sharply through twists and turns, where skeletal remains obstruct passage. At the far southern end, Velothi architecture marks a doorway to the Forgotten Shrine proper—a large, impressive chamber filled with undead. A triolith in this southern chamber holds gems, and ledge walls contain further treasures, including a copy of the 36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 10. The site's original purpose and the identity of those who built the shrine remain uncertain, though the Velothi stonework suggests connection to ancient Dunmeri religious tradition. The shrine's current state of abandonment and the prevalence of undead indicate long desuetude.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ermunsour is.

title: Ernabapalit Camp
topic_desc: Ernabapalit Camp is an Ashlander trading post situated in the Armun Ashlands, a short distance west of the Redoran stronghold of Arvud. The camp consists of at least one yurt—Yakasamshi's Yurt—alongside open-air gathering areas. It serves as a point of contact between the nomadic Ashlander clans and settled Dunmer travelers or merchants operating near Arvud's southern approaches. The camp's inhabitants include hunters, warriors, and traders affiliated with the Ashlanders as clanfriends, reflecting its function as a modest commercial outpost rather than a permanent tribal seat. Its location on the fringe of Redoran-controlled territory gives it a liminal character: an Ashlander presence within reach of House settlement, facilitating trade and passage through the ashland wastes.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ernabapalit Camp is.

title: Ernaberinsu
topic_desc: Ernaberinsu is a large, two-level cave situated in the Mephalan Vales region, southwest of Windmoth Legion Fort. The cavern is occupied by Daedra and spellcasters, indicating a site of arcane or cultic significance rather than common habitation. Its division into distinct upper and lower levels suggests a structured use of the subterranean space by its current denizens.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ernaberinsu is.

title: Eroth Island
topic_desc: Eroth Island is an island situated in the Padomaic Ocean off the northern coast of the city of Necrom. The island lacks roads and remains largely undeveloped, its terrain shaped by a central bay that flows out into the surrounding ocean. A shack sits on the island's north beach, while the Salvarys Ancestral Tomb occupies the center of the isle near the bay. The island's name has roots in earlier cartographic records of the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Eroth Island is.

title: Eroth Island Shack
topic_desc: A derelict shack standing on Eroth Island in the Padomaic Ocean, situated near a shipwreck and accompanied by a small rowboat. The structure is devoid of occupants or valuable items. The surrounding wreckage and the presence of the boat suggest the shelter was likely built by a marooned sailor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Eroth Island Shack is.

title: Erushara Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Erushara Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb located halfway along Aranyon Pass, due south of Sarvanni in the Sunad Mora region. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Erushara family and is guarded by undead protectors, including a skeleton archer and numerous other animated corpses. The tomb holds little of note beyond a copy of the thirty-fifth sermon of Vivec's thirty-six lessons, a text valued for its martial and philosophical teachings regarding the spear.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Erushara Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Ervas Dalveni's Shack
topic_desc: A fisherman's shack southeast of Gol Mok in the Aanthirin region, situated on land that House Hlaalu has eyed for a potential outpost.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ervas Dalveni's Shack is.

title: Essarnartes
topic_desc: Essarnartes is a Daedric shrine dedicated to the Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon, situated in the Armun Ashlands. Cultists and Daedra occupy the site, conducting rites in service to the Prince of Destruction. A copy of the treatise The Lunar Lorkhan rests behind the shrine's central statue of Dagon. The shrine lies east of Bapatipi, another Daedric site dedicated to Molag Bal, and is reached by traveling north from Arvud toward Hummurushtapi before turning west.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Essarnartes is.

title: Essurdan Cave Dwelling
topic_desc: Essurdan Cave Dwelling is a scout's residence situated within a canyon in the Roth Roryn region of Morrowind. Hollowed into the canyon wall, it provides a durable shelter suited to the rugged terrain of the region. The dwelling is currently inhabited by a Dunmer scout who offers training in athletics, block, and long blade skills to those who find the isolated home. You do not know where Essurdan Cave Dwelling is.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Essurdan Cave Dwelling is.

title: Essurnashpi
topic_desc: Essurnashpi is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Mehrunes Dagon, situated in a canyon southeast of the Purple Road as it approaches Septim's Gate Pass in the Shipal-Shin region. The site comprises three zones: the Outer Chambers, the Caverns, and the Inner Shrine. A statue to Dagon dominates the Inner Shrine, beneath which an ebony open helm rests, while a glass tanto lies in the cells beneath the adjacent walkway. The shrine serves as the seat of a sacrificial cult devoted to the Prince of Destruction.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Essurnashpi is.

title: Esultin
topic_desc: Esultin is a kwama nest situated in the Coronati Basin, northwest of Ald Iuval. The cave lies near the Chimer stronghold of Vandirelyon, accessible via a path leading from that ruin's stairs. The mine is typically inhabited by kwama, though it has recently drawn the attention of more dangerous Daedric predators.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Esultin is.

title: Esuranamit
topic_desc: Esuranamit is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Sheogorath, the Madgod, situated in the Mephalan Vales of mainland Morrowind. The site consists of a single interior zone housing the Prince's altar. As a place of Daedra worship, it draws devotees of the Madgod, including both Altmer and Dunmer cultists, who maintain the shrine's observances.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Esuranamit is.

title: Etana Egg Mine
topic_desc: Etana Egg Mine is a House Hlaalu-owned kwama egg mine situated in the Roth Roryn region, west of Menaan and east of the Shalmurat Velothi tower. Operations have recently halted due to the miners' refusal to work. The work stoppage stems from the discovery of ancient architecture within the tunnels and a bowl that the laborers believe is cursed; one miner who touched the artifact subsequently suffered a strange affliction. The mine's foreman seeks to resume egg production but remains wary of the object.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Etana Egg Mine is.

title: Eternal Voyager
topic_desc: The Eternal Voyager is a vessel currently docked at Helnim. The ship bears a reputation as a haunted craft, with disturbances reported on its lower deck. It comprises a captain's cabin, an upper level, and a lower hold. The haunting has made the vessel a subject of unease among those frequenting Helnim's harbor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Eternal Voyager is.

title: Etu-Saras Egg Mine
topic_desc: Etu-Saras Egg Mine is a middling-sized kwama egg mine situated off the Purple Road in the Shipal-Shin region of Morrowind. The mine entrance lies south of the road's second stone bridge between Shipal-Sharai and Septim's Gate Pass. Kwama colonies occupy the interior, and miners of varied racial backgrounds work the site. The mine forms part of the local egg-trade economy that supplies settlements along the Purple Road corridor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Etu-Saras Egg Mine is.

title: Evos
topic_desc: Evos is a small settlement in the Sacred Lands region, consisting of just four buildings. The town provides basic services for the surrounding area, including a blacksmith. Its communal housing shelters local miners and farmers, and a Tribunal Temple adept maintains a presence among the residents. The settlement lacks a formal named exterior cell in standard geographic records.
topic_desc_basic: Evos is a small town of four buildings located in the Sacred Lands region.

title: Exodus
topic_desc: The Exodus is a ship currently docked in the harbor of Necrom, at the Necrom Waterfront.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Exodus is.

title: Exposed Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Exposed Shipwreck lies in the Sunad Mora region, on the peninsula southeast of Llothanis. The vessel's stern juts visibly above the waterline along the coastal bay. The upper deck holds several Drowned Corpses, while the lower deck contains numerous miner's picks embedded in the breached hull alongside a lone hostile Argonian named Sunk-In-Swamp. The physical evidence suggests a grim fate: the crew apparently stored a crate of miner's picks on the same deck as their Argonian captive, who used the tools to breach the hull, sinking the ship and drowning his captors while surviving the deluge himself.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Exposed Shipwreck is.

title: Falanos Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Falanos Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer burial site situated a short distance south of Helnim, near the coast at the base of the hills. Despite its cramped halls, the tomb is heavily secured, featuring doors locked with mechanisms ranging from simple to exceptionally complex, alongside several trap pits. Five undead ward the premises. Paradoxically, the extensive defensive measures protect remarkably little; the tomb contains negligible treasure, offering only mundane cutlery, cheap ingredients, and miscellaneous items of no real value.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Falanos Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Falar Bay
topic_desc: Falar Bay is a calm expanse of water, sheltered by tall cliffs from the storms of the Inner Sea. At its southwestern edge, the bay is overlooked by the looming Dwemer ruins of Kemel-Ze. Its shore heads southeast past Marog before curving northeast towards Helnim, where a sharp turn forms a natural harbor for the city-port. The bay's coastline hosts notable sites: Kemel-Ze, a huge Dwemer city inhabited by researching archaeologists, reckless adventurers, and still-working Dwemer machines; Marog, a settlement along the southeastern shore; and Helnim, an important Imperial trading center between the Empire and House Telvanni. Smaller locales include Galseah, a medium-sized cavern on the northern coast of Molag Ruhn between Marog and Helnim used by wizards; Berantus, a small cliff cavern northwest of Helnim occupied by bandits; and Falanos Ancestral Tomb, located a short distance south of Helnim.
topic_desc_basic: Falar Bay is a calm expanse of water sheltered by tall cliffs from the storms of the Inner Sea. It curves from the looming Dwemer ruins of Kemel-Ze past Marog to Helnim, where a sharp turn forms a natural harbor for the city-port.

title: Falascu
topic_desc: Falascu is a two-zone cave in the Boethiah's Spine region, northeast of Tel Mothrivra. Difficult to access without levitation, it serves as a hermitage. The outer cave contains pearl-bearing kollops, while the inner hermitage holds a central pool, additional kollops, a small chest of gold, alchemy ingredients, and a bottle of Cyrodiilic brandy. A hostile sorcerer currently occupies the dwelling.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Falascu is.

title: Farys Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Farys Ancestral Tomb is a compact Dunmer burial site situated in the Lan Orethan region, directly along the road south of Bosmora. The interior is a mazelike network of twisting passageways, presumably designed to confuse and deter intruders from disturbing the dead. Like many ancestral tombs, it is guarded by undead protectors, though it presently holds no treasure of notable value.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Farys Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Favelnim Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Favelnim Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb located a considerable distance due west of Port Telvannis in the Telvanni Isles, situated near the mining village of Nethre-Pulu beneath a cluster of mushrooms. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead and houses shrines to the Tribunal and Saint Veloth. The tomb is currently inhabited by undead, a common affliction of Dunmer ancestral sites, including several skeletons. It contains a moderate amount of funerary offerings, including precious stones and a magical amulet.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Favelnim Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Felms Ithul
topic_desc: Felms Ithul is an Indoril settlement in the Aanthirin region, spread loosely along a road hugging the Thirr River. The village economy centers on a large velk paddock; the creatures are farmed for materials likely processed into punavit at the Brewers Hall of Vhul to the southwest, supplying the Indoril nobles of Roa Dyr. Local services include spellmaking and alchemical ingredients. The surrounding area contains a riverbed shipwreck and the caves of Manumnabi and Kadanuran. The settlement falls within range of both Almsivi and Divine Intervention.
topic_desc_basic: Felms Ithul is an Indoril settlement in the Aanthirin region, spread along a road on the edge of the Thirr River. It is known for farming velk in a large paddock.

title: Flooded Shipwreck
topic_desc: A sunken vessel resting in the Sea of Ghosts, southwest of Nivalis. Its flooded interior spans multiple levels and now harbors slaughterfish, including a blind albino specimen. The wreck holds the remains of Nandor Beraid, an armorer documented in historical accounts of a famous wager, whose skeleton rests on the upper level. A secured chest on the lower level contains his renowned artifact, Nandor's Spear.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Flooded Shipwreck is.

title: Fokbar's Runestone
topic_desc: Fokbar's Runestone is an ancient Nordic runestone situated on a small island in the Sea of Ghosts, east of Leviathan Keep. The site is inhabited by Ice Wraiths. Beyond the runestone itself and its spectral occupants, the location holds little else of note. The origins of the stone and the identity of Fokbar remain unrecorded.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Fokbar's Runestone is.

title: Forlorn Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Forlorn Shipwreck is a grounded vessel resting upon a rocky island in the Dagon Urul region, situated halfway between Tel Oren and the Daedric shrine of Kannidamarus. The wreck preserves multiple interior spaces—a cabin, an upper level, and a lower level—though the vessel's origin and the circumstances of its grounding remain unrecorded. Fragments of the Savior's Hide remain among the wreckage on the lower deck. Beyond these remnants, little of value endures aboard the deteriorating hull.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Forlorn Shipwreck is.

title: Forsaken Shack
topic_desc: The Forsaken Shack is a dilapidated, extremely isolated dwelling located deep inside a canyon in the Mephalan Vales, northeast of Dun Akafell. The building has evidently sat abandoned for a considerable time, evidenced by fungus growing along its interior walls. The former owner apparently committed suicide; a skeleton still hangs from a rope inside the structure. The meager remaining contents include a locked chest, generic storage crates and baskets, and a solitary bedroll in the corner, reflecting a grim and solitary end to the site's habitation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Forsaken Shack is.

title: Forsaken Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Forsaken Shipwreck is a sunken vessel resting off the coast of the Mephalan Vales in the Azura's Coast region. The deteriorating hull is divided into a cabin and a hold. Like many wrecks found along these rocky shores, it stands as a submerged hazard and a potential repository of lost cargo, known primarily to sailors navigating the eastern waterways of Morrowind.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Forsaken Shipwreck is.

title: Fort Ancylis
topic_desc: Fort Ancylis is an Imperial fortification within Roth Roryn, situated on the coast of the Inner Sea. Following the loss of Sulfurwatch Keep to a undead army, the bastion is shared between the Imperial Legion and the Imperial Navy. The Legion occupies the Main Keep under Knight Protector Rojanna Jades, while the Navy garrison holds the Eastern Keep under Commodore Kventus Lucilius and maintains the warship TEM Ashrunner at the dock. The small Imperial colony of Teyn lies across the bay, and the Hlaalu city of Bal Foyen is a short walk southeast. The fort's name follows the Third Era convention of appending '-moth' suffixes to Legion fortifications, as 'Ancylis' refers to a genus of moths.
topic_desc_basic: Fort Ancylis is an Imperial fort on the coast of the Inner Sea within Roth Roryn. It lies northwest of Bal Foyen and near the colony of Teyn.

title: Fort Firemoth
topic_desc: Fort Firemoth is an Imperial Legion fort situated on the highest point of the Saros Archipelago, overlooking the Imperial Navy fortress of Sulfurwatch Keep to the north. Overrun by an undead army serving the lich Grurn, the fort fell sometime just after the Simulacrum. Though technically part of Vvardenfell District, its strategic position above lucrative glass and ebony mining veins complicates its political status, as the Great Houses of Vvardenfell seek control over the resources. The Imperial Legion maintains ambitions of reclaiming the fortress, though the Empire's lack of coin and the competing interests of the Great Houses present significant obstacles to any rebuilding effort. The fort's subterranean wealth ensures it remains a point of contention.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Fort Firemoth is.

title: Fort Umbermoth
topic_desc: Fort Umbermoth is a small Imperial fortification situated in the Sacred Lands, just south of Sailen. It serves as a local garrison for the Imperial Legion and hosts an Imperial Cult shrine on its upper floor. The fort is a recognized destination for Divine Intervention magic across much of the surrounding region, drawing travelers and legionnaires alike. Its limited facilities include a blacksmith, an apothecary, and a training hall, reflecting its modest scale. A dungeon level holds an evidence chest for confiscated goods. The surrounding area offers little of note, leaving the fort primarily as a waypoint and administrative outpost rather than a bustling settlement.
topic_desc_basic: Fort Umbermoth is a small Imperial fort in the Sacred Lands, located just south of Sailen. It serves as a garrison and a waypoint for Divine Intervention magic in the region.

title: Furam Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Furam Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Shipal-Shin region. The interior suffers from a bug infestation, and Sharai Hoppers have breached the antechamber, damaging its entrance door. Beyond the compromised antechamber, undead guardians protect an inner chamber secured by a locked door. This sanctum houses a Shrine of St. Veloth alongside a set of Dreugh boots and a chest containing a substantial quantity of gold.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Furam Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Gah Sadrith
topic_desc: Gah Sadrith is a medium-sized Telvanni settlement situated on an island in the Telvanni Isles, just south of Port Telvannis. The town is a notable hub of commerce and magical services within House Telvanni's territory, featuring an extensive market that provides alchemical supplies, enchanting, spellmaking, and various trade goods. The settlement's architectural focal point is Tel Darys, the tower of Telvanni Councilor Mistress Eldale. As a prominent port, Gah Sadrith maintains transport links via boat and silt strider, connecting it to Llothanis, Port Telvannis, and other regional destinations. The Wetstone Tavern serves as a local gathering place for the town's diverse populace of Dark Elves, outlanders, and retainers.
topic_desc_basic: Gah Sadrith is a medium-sized House Telvanni town on an island just south of Port Telvannis in the Telvanni Isles. It serves as a significant local hub for trade and magical services, and houses the tower of Telvanni Councilor Mistress Eldale.

title: Galam and Mehra Telas' House
topic_desc: This dwelling in Lan Orethan exemplifies traditional Indoril architectural style. It serves as the residence for a local boatsman who transports agricultural goods from nearby farms to Almalexia. The occupants typically remain at the dock situated south of the building, plying their trade. The interior is notably devoid of valuables.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Galam and Mehra Telas' House is.

title: Galisa's Pike
topic_desc: Galisa's Pike is a pirate vessel captained by Captain Galisa, currently moored at the slave market docks of Mundrethi Plantation in the Aanthirin region. The ship comprises three distinct zones: an upper level, a lower level, and a captain's cabin. For some days, the vessel has remained docked while its Dunmer crew attempts to sell a captured Imperial Navy deckhand into slavery. Finding no buyer willing to assume the risk of enslaving an Imperial sailor, the pirates have been delayed, a circumstance that provides their captive a grim amusement as he awaits potential rescue.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Galisa's Pike is.

title: Galseah
topic_desc: Galseah is a medium-sized, two-zone cavern system situated on the northern coast of the Molag Ruhn region, positioned between the settlements of Marog and Helnim. The cavern serves as a retreat for practitioners of the arcane arts, currently occupied by wizards and warlocks. Daedra are also present within the cave network, suggesting conjuration or other esoteric practices by the inhabitants. The deeper section of the cavern, known as the Deep Caverns, houses more powerful mages.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Galseah is.

title: Gan-Ettu Camp
topic_desc: Gan-Ettu Camp is the main settlement of the Gan-Ettu Shinathi clan, located in the Shipal-Shin region southeast of Narsis. The camp is distinguished by the Ushashishad Hive, a large Skyrender nest. The Gan-Ettu hold a deep affinity for Skyrender insects, revering them as Vivec's children and as the semi-divine source of meat honey. The settlement also maintains Sand Kwoom breeding pools within the Adammurbael cavern on a mesa to the east. The clan is governed by a Saharkhan, who resides in a dedicated tent. The camp features various structures including herders' and farmers' tents, a wise man's tent, and storage within the Skyrender hive itself.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gan-Ettu Camp is.

title: Garvs and Fedura Ovav's Shack
topic_desc: Garvs and Fedura Ovav's Shack is a small farmhouse situated in the Aanthirin region, between the settlements of Dondril and Vhul. The dwelling stands near old ruins built in the Indoril style, a proximity that has fueled rumors among locals in Dondril of the residents' dealings with Daedra. The shack is the home of the Ovav couple, Garvs and Fedura. Following Fedura Ovav's recent death from illness, the residence stands empty while her father, Garvs, seeks a member of the Tribunal Temple in Dondril willing to perform her last rites.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Garvs and Fedura Ovav's Shack is.

title: Gathram Farmhouse
topic_desc: Gathram Farmhouse is a rural residence in the Coronati Basin, situated outside Narsis. The property functions as a guar ranch and tanna farm, reflecting the agricultural practices of the region. Rovone Gathram, a Dark Elf farmer, resides at the home and sells the farm's produce.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gathram Farmhouse is.

title: Geras Egg Mine
topic_desc: Geras Egg Mine is an egg mine situated in the Sacred Lands region. It is a single-zone kwama mine yielding egg resources.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Geras Egg Mine is.

title: Ghalud
topic_desc: Ghalud is a smugglers' cave situated within the Shipal-Shin region of Morrowind. It currently serves as a hideout for a band of outlaws, including individuals of varied races and professions such as rogues, scouts, nightblades, and smugglers. The cave's remote location makes it a suitable refuge for those wishing to avoid the authorities, though it has drawn the attention of the Morag Tong, which has issued a writ of execution against at least one notorious smuggler operating from within.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ghalud is.

title: Ghand
topic_desc: Ghand is a two-level cavern in the Aanthirin region, northwest of Oran Plantation. The upper level, designated the Ritual Chamber, is separated from the entrance cavern by a lava chasm and a locked door. Skeletons occupy the first level. The Ritual Chamber contains a pedestal on the far side of the chasm. The cavern's purpose appears tied to necromantic practice, though specific historical details are not well documented.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ghand is.

title: Ghundabalit Egg Mine
topic_desc: Ghundabalit Egg Mine is an abandoned kwama egg mine situated in the Armun Ashlands. The mine has fallen into disuse and is now inhabited by vampires, rendering it dangerous to any who approach. The nearest major landmark is the Dwemer ruin of Barzamthuand. Northeast of that sprawl of towers lies the smaller Dwemer ruin of Khadumzunch, and the entrance to the mine is found just behind Khadumzunch's main door, past a silt strider shell. The mine's abandonment and undead occupation have put an end to whatever kwama egg trade once operated here.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ghundabalit Egg Mine is.

title: Gilnyth Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Gilnyth Ancestral Tomb is a tomb in the Alt Orethan region west of Dreynim. Undead guard its chambers, which contain several enchanted trinkets and a scroll among the burial goods.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gilnyth Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Gilvan-Tidrith Mine
topic_desc: Gilvan-Tidrith Mine is an abandoned ruby mine located north of Firewatch in the Dagon Urul region. The site contains several ruby veins and scattered skeletal remains, often found alongside miner's picks, indicating a past fatal incident that led to the mine's desertion. It is currently inhabited only by beasts.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gilvan-Tidrith Mine is.

title: Girithammu Grotto
topic_desc: Girithammu Grotto is a medium-sized underwater cavern on the bed of the Sea of Ghosts, situated north of the Daedric ruin of Yamuninisharn within the Sunad Mora region. The grotto's interior is populated by sea creatures and a colony of twelve kollops. Its features include two eyestars, one in the south and another to the east, and a western chamber containing a few barrels and crates of minor loot. The site holds particular relevance for Imperial Legion operations in the area, as saboteurs obstructing naval supply lines have been known to exploit this submerged location to evade pursuit.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Girithammu Grotto is.

title: Git
topic_desc: Git is a small cave situated on a black ridge in the Aanthirin region, directly east of a small Velk camp and west of Old Ebonheart across the river. The interior serves as the home and workspace of the self-professed alchemist Margia Sycora. The cave contains basic alchemy equipment arranged on bookshelves and a copy of the skill book A Game at Dinner resting on a table. The dwelling is notably cluttered with nearly two hundred pillows arranged around the bed. The cave's remote and somewhat concealed location makes it difficult to locate without familiarity with the surrounding terrain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Git is.

title: Glass Fulcrum
topic_desc: The Glass Fulcrum is a pleasure barge belonging to House Hlaalu's Seventh Family, docked outside the Seventh Family Manor in Narsis within the Shipal-Shin region. The vessel's interior is furnished for fine dining and rest, attended by Hlaalu retainers. It serves as a floating extension of the Seventh Family's estate, reflecting the wealth and mercantile standing of that branch of the Great House in one of Morrowind's major western cities.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Glass Fulcrum is.

title: Glinting Moth
topic_desc: The Glinting Moth is an East Empire Company vessel moored at the docks outside Almas Thirr's Hall of Tribute in the Aanthirin region. The ship comprises three distinct areas: a captain's cabin, crew quarters, and a cargo hold. Under the command of Captain Pallatia Prentus, the vessel transports bulk goods such as saltrice and kwama eggs along the Thirr River. The ship's log book reflects ongoing profitability challenges, noting that the crew is financially squeezed by the discount prices demanded by the operators of Mundrethi Plantation. The vessel also carries cargo on behalf of Oran Plantation, though operations have periodically stalled over contract payment disputes.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Glinting Moth is.

title: Gol Mok
topic_desc: Gol Mok is a small Great House Hlaalu fishing village situated near the mouth of the Thirr River. It holds the distinction of being the closest mainland settlement to the island of Vvardenfell. The settlement consists of five stilted shacks built over the river, housing local fishermen and commoners. Overlooking the village on a hill above is a manor governed by the Hlaalu brother Bol Savani and his wife Aure Salvani. The village receives few visitors beyond passing pilgrims and offers no services. It is not connected to the mainland transport network, resting on an island accessible only by bridges from a crossroads between Bal Foyen and the Vathras Plantation.
topic_desc_basic: Gol Mok is a small Great House Hlaalu fishing village near the mouth of the Thirr River. It is the closest mainland settlement to the island of Vvardenfell.

title: Gormoro Grotto
topic_desc: Gormoro Grotto is a small, submerged cavern situated west of Gorne within the Nedothril region. The cave is primarily inhabited by a school of slaughterfish, with a dreugh guarding its western depths. Like many natural grottos along the coast, it supports kollop beds that yield pearls. The remains of a drowned diver rest near the entrance, while a skeleton bearing an exquisite amulet lies within the dreugh's domain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gormoro Grotto is.

title: Gra-Bashamd Farm
topic_desc: Gra-Bashamd Farm is a drumpear seed processing facility east of Narsis in the Shipal-Shin region. The operation mills drumpear seeds on-site at its windmill and maintains a guar ranch. The property is owned by Vedas Plantation to the northwest, reflecting the Hlaalu agricultural network surrounding Narsis. An Orc farmer manages the facility under Hlaalu retainer status, supported by scribes and enslaved laborers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gra-Bashamd Farm is.

title: Grand Hlaalu Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: The Grand Hlaalu Ancestral Tomb is an extensive Dunmer burial complex serving Great House Hlaalu, situated in the Shipal-Shin region just east of Narsis across the river, within a walled and guarded compound. The tomb interrs members of multiple Hlaalu family lines, organized across distinct chambers: the First through Sixth Family Tombs, the First Wardens' Vault, and the War Patrons' Tomb, connected by a central crossroads. The complex is unusually wealthy, accumulating significant quantities of gold, gems, ebonyware, and rare arms and armor across its various sections. Undead, including numerous liches, and Hlaalu retainers occupy the interior. The Vvardenfell Hlaalu Ancestral Tomb is understood to house only the Seventh Family, distinguishing it from this mainland necropolis.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Grand Hlaalu Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Grasped Shipwreck
topic_desc: Grasped Shipwreck is a vessel wrecked in the Coronati Basin, near the Withering Murk. The wreck comprises three accessible areas: a cabin, an upper level, and a lower level. Dreugh have taken up residence within the submerged remains. Beyond scattered cargo, little of note remains aboard.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Grasped Shipwreck is.

title: Gratitude's Wake
topic_desc: Gratitude's Wake is a vessel anchored in the harbor at the Necrom waterfront. The ship is divided into an upper level, a lower level, and a cabin. Its presence in the docks of the sacred city of Necrom marks it as part of the maritime traffic reaching that eastern shore.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gratitude's Wake is.

title: Great Valley
topic_desc: Great Valley is a steep glacial valley in the Velothis District covering Morrowind's northwestern border with Skyrim. Known to the Nord diaspora as the hold of Uld Vraech, it is administered by House Redoran under a grant from Tiber Septim. Constant snow and bitter winds make agriculture virtually impossible, and the scarce herding grounds on the valley floor fuel territorial friction between the two peoples. The region's largest settlements are Dunkreath and Gargen Huul. It borders Julan-Shar to the east, the Grey Meadows and Velothi Mountains to the south, and the Sea of Ghosts, near the islands of Valenhul and Starwatch Keep, to the north.
topic_desc_basic: Great Valley, also called Uld Vraech, is a steep, snow-covered glacial valley in the Velothis District covering Morrowind's northwestern border with Skyrim. It is administered by House Redoran but contested by the local Nord diaspora.

title: Grey Meadows
topic_desc: The Grey Meadows is an ash swamp region in the Velothis District of Morrowind, distinguished by unique mushrooms found nowhere else in the province. Its waters are a mix of pure flows and streams fouled by ash, and a pervasive quiet blankets the landscape. The region is prone to heavy fog and overcast skies. It is bordered by the Clambering Moor to the south, the Velothi Mountains to the southwest, Uld Vraech and Julan-Shar to the north, and the waters of the West Gash and Bitter Coast to the east. Its largest settlement is the city of Kogotel. The region was historically known as Ash Swamp, and Strangled Fen was also considered as a name.
topic_desc_basic: The Grey Meadows is an ash swamp region in the Velothis District of Morrowind, known for its unique mushrooms and quiet atmosphere. It lies bordered by the Clambering Moor, the Velothi Mountains, Uld Vraech, Julan-Shar, and the waters of the West Gash and Bitter Coast. Its largest settlement is Kogotel.

title: Grey-Walker
topic_desc: The Grey-Walker is a Runners League vessel currently moored at the Firewatch docks. Under the command of Captain Inge Coral-Crowned, the ship has only recently arrived in port. Its primary cargo consists of wasabi root imported from Cathnoquey. The vessel also transports various rare goods from the Padomaic Isles, including manatee leather armaments, an obsidian dagger, precious gemstones, bitterstone ore, and distinct regional beverages such as palm wine, ngopta, and cimoa. A secured hold compartment safeguards particularly valuable items like sapphires and an intense sparkaxe. The crew comprises Nord sailors and a sharpshooter.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Grey-Walker is.

title: Gro-Uthig Plantation
topic_desc: Gro-Uthig Plantation is a small guar farm situated on the western shore of Lake Coronati within the Coronati Basin, southeast of Hlerynhul. The estate operates under the auspices of Great House Hlaalu, managed from its on-site manor. The plantation reflects the Hlaalu practice of utilizing both Orcish and Dark Elven retainers in its agricultural operations.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gro-Uthig Plantation is.

title: Gulmebi
topic_desc: Gulmebi is a hermit's cave on the south shore of Lake Coronati, its entrance standing on the east bank of the Thirr River where the river empties into the lake. Located within the Coronati Basin, the cavern contains little beyond wild fungi. Its sole occupant is Andres Relaran, a Dark Elf and former acolyte of the Tribunal Temple who left the Monastery of St. Felms to live a near-naked, ascetic existence within the cave. At times, the site draws the attention of the Ja-Natta Syndicate, whose outlaws can displace the hermit to use the cavern as a temporary hideout.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gulmebi is.

title: Gulmon Nulen's Hut
topic_desc: Gulmon Nulen's Hut is a Redoran farmstead situated on the northwestern edge of the Roth Roryn region. The farm practices mixed agriculture, sustaining guar, muckspunge, corkbulb, and saltrice crops. The occupant, Gulmon Nulen, maintains bonemold armor at the residence, with numerous pieces of this traditional Dunmer armament stored on the premises.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gulmon Nulen's Hut is.

title: Gulunibi Grotto
topic_desc: Gulunibi Grotto is a small, submerged cavern in the Telvanni Isles. The cave is home to aquatic fauna, including slaughterfish, a dreugh, and eyestars, alongside several pearl-bearing kollops. Beyond a minor chest near the dreugh, the grotto holds no other notable features.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gulunibi Grotto is.

title: Gurilo Farmhouse
topic_desc: Gurilo Farmhouse is a small agricultural homestead situated in the Nedothril region of mainland Morrowind. The farmstead is occupied by the Gurilo family, Dunmer farmers who work the surrounding land.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Gurilo Farmhouse is.

title: Habunsanit
topic_desc: Habunsanit is a medium-sized cave situated within the Boethiah's Spine region. It currently serves as a refuge for a group of five Dark Elf bandits, who have established their encampment within its chambers. The occupants include individuals trained in combat and magical arts, such as crusaders, mages, battlemages, archers, and warriors, making the cave a well-defended outlaw holdfast. The cave's location in the rugged Boethiah's Spine terrain provides natural seclusion for those seeking to avoid the authorities of nearby settlements.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Habunsanit is.

title: Haddut Cave
topic_desc: Haddut Cave is a kagouti den situated in the hills of western Aanthirin, positioned at the source of a dried-up river. Steps hewn into the stone indicate past use by sapient beings. An offering of pearls and flowers rests by a pitch-black crevice at the cave's southern end, possibly intended to encourage the resumption of the water's flow. A rock fall high on a ledge in a southern chamber conceals a gold-filled chest and precious gemstones among the boulders. Exposed iron ore veins can be found on the eastern side of the cave.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Haddut Cave is.

title: Hadipasu
topic_desc: Hadipasu is a small cave situated in the Molag Ruhn region, southwest of Tel Muthada. The cave currently serves as a hideout for a group of bandits. Among those sheltering within are Dunmer of rogue and Ordinator backgrounds, alongside a Redguard master-at-arms and a Nord warrior. The presence of an Ordinator among the bandit company is unusual, suggesting circumstances that led this member of the Temple's martial order to abandon conventional duties. The cave's remote location in the rugged terrain southwest of Tel Muthada makes it a serviceable refuge for those wishing to avoid scrutiny. Little else of note is recorded about Hadipasu beyond its use as a bandit encampment.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Hadipasu is.

title: Hadrumnibibi
topic_desc: Hadrumnibibi is a Daedric shrine dedicated to the Daedric Prince Malacath, situated on the east banks of the Thirr River in the Aanthirin region. The ruins are prominent, standing immediately north of Almas Thirr by river. The main entrance is blocked by rocks; access is instead gained through an underwater opening in the river on the west side. This leads into the site's grotto, which connects to a backdoor to the entrance and the inner shrine. A statue of Malacath stands at the southwestern end of the shrine.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Hadrumnibibi is.

title: Halaran Camp
topic_desc: Halaran Camp is a small settlement in the Telvanni Isles, northeast of Port Telvannis, situated inland from the northern shore of the island. The site resembles an Ashlander camp of Vvardenfell, though its origins differ. It consists of two yurts holding modest provisions of food and clothing. The camp is led by Darayn Halaran, who practices ancestral ways to live off the land, while the other residents, a married pair, regard him as a wise man and follow his guidance.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Halaran Camp is.

title: Haliwaran
