Like many such Dunmer tombs, it has suffered extensive looting over the years, leaving little of its original funerary contents intact. The tomb currently serves as a refuge for a group of bandits, who maintain a secured cache of valuables in a locked chamber toward the southern end of the complex.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Landoth Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Latag gra-Lumbak's Shack
topic_desc: Latag gra-Lumbak's Shack is a modest dwelling in the Sundered Scar. It serves as the home of Latag gra-Lumbak, an Orc and knight errant of the Imperial Legion. The residence reflects the continued presence of Imperial military personnel in the region, even in remote and inhospitable areas of Morrowind's coastline.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Latag gra-Lumbak's Shack is.

title: Leftunch
topic_desc: Leftunch is a Dwemer ruin in the Roth Roryn region, north of Bodrum. It comprises two known zones: the Ruined Halls and the Hall of Sun's Height. The site is historically significant as the burial place of Lord Ihlendam, as recorded in the Chronicles of Nchuleft. The main entrance is currently blocked, though an alternate trapdoor grants access into the Ruined Halls. Within the deeper Hall of Sun's Height, a dormant Steam Colossus stands guard over the ruin's most notable artifacts. These include the enchanted Escutcheon of Duunmarkng, found in the alcove housing the Colossus, and an ornate chest containing a Dwarven weapon. The ruin is otherwise occupied by standard Dwemer automata.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Leftunch is.

title: Leviathan Keep
topic_desc: Leviathan Keep is an abandoned Imperial fort situated on an island in the Sea of Ghosts, east of Althoa and north of Tel Ouada. Its original garrison and purpose have passed from record, leaving the structure to the occupation of vermin and Ice Wraiths. Within the interior lies the remains of an individual named Kontin Arynx, who still wears a near-complete suit of Imperial Gold armor—comprising helm, cuirass, pauldrons, greaves, and boots—constituting the keep's most notable remaining possession.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Leviathan Keep is.

title: Limping Scrib
topic_desc: The Limping Scrib is a tavern located in Almas Thirr, a settlement situated along the Thirr River in the Indoril-controlled heartlands of Morrowind. The establishment is operated by Ilerni Hleran, a Dunmer publican who provides food, drink, and lodging. The tavern's upper floors contain multiple rooms available for rent, including a second-floor bed offered for ten gold per night and additional sleeping quarters on a third floor. The Limping Scrib serves as a gathering place for a diverse clientele drawn from the surrounding community and travelers passing through the region. Its situation within Almas Thirr places it at a crossroads of House Indoril authority and broader Morrowind commerce, making it a modest but functional waypoint for those navigating the central heartland waterways.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Limping Scrib is.

title: Litu-Dur Mine
topic_desc: Litu-Dur Mine is a flooded silver extraction site in the Velothi Mountains, situated near Bodrum. The facility suffered a hurried abandonment, leaving silver ore in its minecarts. Kobolds and slaughterfish now occupy the tunnels. Despite yielding only silver, the southwestern chamber holds locked chests of gold and gemstones, and a skeletal remnant in the eastern chamber rests near a key to one such cache. A recovered note suggests the mine served as a front for a gem delivery operation, though the origin and intended destination of these unmined stones remain uncertain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Litu-Dur Mine is.

title: Llaram Plantation
topic_desc: Llaram Plantation is a small agricultural estate on the coast north of Omaynis in the Roth Roryn region. Managed by the Llaram family, the plantation raises guar and cultivates corkbulb. The Llarams hold rank within Great House Hlaalu, and the estate operates using slave labor, with Khajiit slaves working the fields. The manor house features a tower overlooking the surrounding property.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llaram Plantation is.

title: Llaran Farm
topic_desc: Llaran Farm is a corkbulb farm in the Aanthirin region, situated north of Oran Plantation. The holding consists of a farmhouse and a slave shack, with slave-tilled fields worked by Khajiit laborers. The farm is owned by Olvas Llaran, who inherited it after his father's death and is reportedly considering a transition into guar herding. Hlarane Radas serves as overseer.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llaran Farm is.

title: Llaren Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Llaren Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Coronati Basin, situated a short walk north across the bridge from Sadrathim. The tomb features a locked door to its north, for which a key is hidden behind an urn in the entrance chamber. Beyond this sealed passage lies a chamber adorned with a large mural, containing a sarcophagus that holds the Vandirelyon Propylon Index, a notable artifact of teleportation magic.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llaren Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Llarethi Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Llarethi Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb in the Sunad Mora region, housing undead guardians and a clandestine group of Telvanni wizards who revere the teachings of Gilan Llarethi. The tomb contains notable relics including a Veloth's tower shield and the unique text of Gilan Llarethi's Speech.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llarethi Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Llemis Ranch
topic_desc: Llemis Ranch is a netch ranch situated in the Coronati Basin, east of the settlement of Ald Marak. It is owned and operated by Ninlaru Llemis, a Dunmer herder holding the rank of Oathman in Great House Hlaalu. The ranch lies in the shadow of Bessarnamidan, a large Daedric shrine to the north, near which Spider Daedra have recently been sighted. The presence of these Daedric creatures in the vicinity has become a source of growing concern for the ranch's owner.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llemis Ranch is.

title: Llendu Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Llendu Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb built on a crag in the Roth Roryn region, situated west of Shalmurat. The structure can be reached via a winding uphill road extending eastward from a junction near the Daedric ruin of Ossurnashalit. Currently, the tomb is occupied by hostile bandits. Within its depths lies the enchanted Dwarven blade Last Wish, kept in the westernmost chamber, alongside a substantial hidden stash of goods in the southwestern room.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llendu Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Lleris Dalmar's Hideout
topic_desc: Lleris Dalmar's Hideout is a cavern dwelling situated beneath the bridge of Chunzefk in the Sundered Scar region. The cave serves as both a residence and a repository for Dwemer artifacts. The interior is scattered with Dwemer goods and materials, suggesting an amateur excavation of the nearby ruin. Containers within the hideout hold Dwemer armor and weaponry. The cave's namesake occupant is hostile to intruders.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Lleris Dalmar's Hideout is.

title: Llethnen Indri's Shack
topic_desc: Llethnen Indri's Shack is a small dwelling situated on a remote island in the Padomaic Ocean, directly east of Seitur. The isolated structure serves as the home of Llethnen Indri, a Dunmer monk. Its solitary placement in the open ocean marks it as a distant and secluded hermitage far from mainland settlements.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llethnen Indri's Shack is.

title: Lliryn Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Lliryn Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer burial site nestled in a valley within the Sunad Mora region. The tomb comprises a single zone and is guarded by undead protectors typical of Dunmer ancestral tombs, including ghosts, skeletons, bonewalkers, and bonelords. Its central chamber features an ashpit surrounded by a notable collection of rare gems and ingredients, distinguishing it from more ordinary ancestral tombs of the region. The tomb's secluded location in a coastal valley makes it difficult to find. Despite the rarity of its contents, the tomb is relatively lightly guarded.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Lliryn Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Llodayna
topic_desc: Llodayna is a small, abandoned Indoril tower situated upon a hill in the Aanthirin region, between the settlements of Dondril and Vhul. The structure consists of a desolate upper tower and a subterranean lower level. While the tower interior itself is empty, a trapdoor grants access to the crypt-like depths below. This confined lower level is heavily infested with undead remnants of the tower's former inhabitants. A portcullis within these depths bars further progress, operable only via an adjacent crank mechanism, beyond which lies a sealed chamber holding a cursed ruby and scrolls of destructive magic. The site stands as a forgotten vestige of Indoril presence in the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llodayna is.

title: Lloram Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Lloram Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Alt Orethan region, north of Meralag and southeast of Darvonis. Like other such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Lloram lineage. The tomb currently houses a group of non-Dunmer interlopers, including warriors and an assassin, alongside the remains of an Imperial who met an untimely end within its halls.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Lloram Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Llothanis
topic_desc: Llothanis is a bustling House Telvanni port town built over the waters of Nebet Bay in the Sunad Mora region. A fast-growing trading and crafting settlement formerly known as Gah Ouadaruhn, it features a large open-air market and extensive merchant services. The town was founded and built by Telvanni noble Bal Gernak, whose manor is carved into the nearby hills. Gernak and several residing nobles harbor discontent that the Council has snubbed Gernak from recognition. Llothanis maintains transport links via boat to Gah Sadrith and Alt Bosara, and by silt strider to Tel Ouada, Port Telvannis, and Alt Bosara.
topic_desc_basic: Llothanis is a bustling House Telvanni port town built over the waters of Nebet Bay in the Sunad Mora region. A fast-growing trading and crafting settlement, it features a large open-air market and extensive merchant services. The town was founded by Telvanni noble Bal Gernak, whose manor is carved into the nearby hills.

title: Llothas Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Llothas Ancestral Tomb is a remote Dunmer burial site deep within the Shipal-Shin region. It lies northwest of Stormgate Pass, with its entrance situated in a canyon just south of the ancient Chimer stronghold of Kaladryon. The tomb is modest in scale and contains little of material value. As with many ancestral tombs of the Dunmer, undead guardians persist within its walls. Its seclusion in the depths of Shipal-Shin keeps it far from regular travel routes.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Llothas Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Loen Doldal's Shack
topic_desc: Loen Doldal's Shack is an isolated dwelling situated along the road between Firewatch and Llothanis, within the Boethiah's Spine region. It serves as the home of a silt-strider farmer. The structure itself holds little of note, containing only basic provisions such as a few bottles of drink and cheap clothing.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Loen Doldal's Shack is.

title: Lookfar
topic_desc: The Lookfar is a vessel owned and operated by the shipmaster Virevar Tilvayn, docked at Firewatch. It serves as a maritime transport connecting Firewatch with the settlements of Helnim, Sadrith Mora, Nivalis, and Dagon Fel. Virevar maintains strict discipline aboard the vessel, ensuring that no cargo clutters the passenger areas during transit. Cheap food and kwama egg deliveries awaiting shipment can typically be found in barrels on the dock beside the ship.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Lookfar is.

title: Looted Shipwreck
topic_desc: A sunken vessel resting in the Padomaic Ocean east of Gorne. The wreck retains a divided interior comprising a cabin, an upper level, and a lower deck. Its cargo includes crates of Cyrodiilic Brandy still preserved in the hold. The lower deck is infested with slaughterfish, and a securely locked chest concealed behind crates there contains a collection of gemstones. Prior salvaging parties have perished at the site, attesting to the hazards of accessing the submerged compartments. The vessel's origin, name, and the circumstances of its sinking are not recorded.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Looted Shipwreck is.

title: Lukhalutun
topic_desc: Lukhalutun is an enormous cavern system and subterranean river on the border between the Armun Ashlands and Roth Roryn. The cave is heavily infested with Daedra, including Daedroth and Vermai. Its subterranean river hosts Slaughterfish and Dreugh, while the interior Well of Spirits—a tall chamber with waterfalls cascading down a central pillar—is guarded by Dark Seducers. A vampire also inhabits the Well of Spirits, near an altar holding the Ancient Baalvayn Helm.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Lukhalutun is.

title: Lumber Camp
topic_desc: Lumber Camp is a logging settlement in the forests of Lan Orethan, situated on the road leading south of Dreynim. The camp overlooks a river and features a small dock from which felled logs are shipped, presumably to Almalexia. The site includes an overseer's shack and employs workers who harvest the surrounding timber, leaving numerous tree stumps along the approach.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Lumber Camp is.

title: Maar-Bani Crossing
topic_desc: Maar-Bani Crossing is a small Hlaalu outpost in the Aanthirin region, constructed within the last decade to facilitate waterborne trade between the ports of Lake Andaram and the Thirr River. It exemplifies House Hlaalu's mercantile focus, drawing commerce away from older nearby settlements such as Idathren. Shipmasters at the ferry port offer passage to numerous destinations, including Aimrah to the east, Almas Thirr and Hlan Oek to the north, and Idathren to the west. A tradehouse provides lodging for a fee, further generating revenue for the House. The outpost's recent establishment has notably impacted surrounding communities, with Idathren's publican attributing a decline in business to the crossing's construction.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maar-Bani Crossing is.

title: Maarawat
topic_desc: Maarawat is a riverside smuggler cave situated in the Lan Orethan region, south of Bosmoro and Denaven Manor. The cavern serves as a covert storehouse for illicit goods, containing numerous locked chests holding gems, gold, and sundry valuables, alongside sacks of coin secreted beneath the stairs in its northernmost chamber. A small crew of smugglers currently operates within, utilizing the cave's wooden platforms and secluded layout to secure their contraband.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maarawat is.

title: Maatumassu
topic_desc: Maatumassu is a cavern in the Roth Roryn region serving as a conjurer's den. Its interior is inhabited by Daedra and the Altmer sorcerer Imkrand, who presumably summoned them. The cave also holds significance as the haunt of a spectral hunter of the Adairenat Ashlander tribe.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maatumassu is.

title: Mabit Grotto
topic_desc: Mabit Grotto is a cavern in the Aanthirin region, situated south of Felms Ithul. It currently serves as a smugglers' hideout. Beneath its waterline, a submerged chamber holds a Dwemer Jinksword lost to an ill-fated swimmer who once carried it into the depths.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mabit Grotto is.

title: Madalvel Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Madalvel Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer burial site situated in the Armun Ashlands, near the fringe of hills bordering Roth Roryn. Like many such tombs, it houses the undead remains of the honored dead, but it has also become the lair of the vampire Vrashammu, a stalker of the Baluath Clan. The tomb contains a trapped emerald in its northwestern chamber; a written warning accompanies the gem, and disturbing it provokes a Daedric guardian named Marqureth. The tomb's remote and obscured location keeps its current vampiric occupation and dangerous enchantments hidden from common knowledge.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Madalvel Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Maebbu
topic_desc: Maebbu is a small cave in the Mephalan Vales, situated near the coast. The entrance is difficult to reach, requiring levitation to cross the mountainous terrain southeast of the road connecting Alt Bosara and Windmoth Legion Fort. The cave's isolated and defensible position makes it a suitable hideaway. It contains general supplies and a notable quantity of raw ebony stored in crates, suggesting use by smugglers or those seeking to discreetly trade the valuable mineral.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maebbu is.

title: Maelasi Cavern
topic_desc: Maelasi Cavern is a small cave set high in the Sunad Mora region along the coast of the Sea of Ghosts. Its interior presents an unusual blend of natural passages and the remnants of some underground structure. A large chamber contains troughs of the type more commonly associated with Sixth House bases on Vvardenfell, suggesting a historical connection to that cult's activities on the mainland. Two enchanted weapons rest within: a Longsword of Gold Wisdom on a central ledge and a Steel Battle Axe of Precision amid the northwestern ruin. The cavern's remote location, far from any road, makes it difficult to reach.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maelasi Cavern is.

title: Maelstrom
topic_desc: Maelstrom is a passenger vessel owned by the shipmaster Ieva Llori. Docked in Darvonis, it serves as a ferry connecting the region to major settlements across Morrowind. From its berth, the ship carries travelers west to Old Ebonheart and Vivec, and north to Marog and Helnim.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maelstrom is.

title: Maesabun
topic_desc: Maesabun is a sprawling burial complex in the Sundered Scar exhibiting a perplexing convergence of cultural traditions. The site features Dwemer architectural elements and mummified remains indicative of a Deep Elf interment, yet also contains Ashlander goods such as bugbowls alongside Velothi burial urns. The complex is divided into four distinct sections: the Obalus Burial forms the initial entry chamber, connecting to the Hollow Burial and Sunken Burial, which in turn provide access to the Elu Burial. The deeper chambers continue the blended funerary motif, housing further Velothi urns alongside the ancient mummified dead. The mingling of Dwemer, Ashlander, and Velothi burial customs within a single necropolis makes Maesabun an anomalous and poorly understood site.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maesabun is.

title: Maesanammus Mine
topic_desc: Maesanammus Mine is a small amethyst mine situated in the Othreleth Woods, near Teloseras. Operating under House Hlaalu, the site yields only four exposed ore veins, confining active extraction to a small portion of the interior. Hlaalu guards oversee the operation and protect the Dunmer and Orcish miners who work the limited deposits.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maesanammus Mine is.

title: Magun Grotto
topic_desc: Magun Grotto is a swamp troll nest beneath the mangroves of the Coronati Basin. The entrance lies in the Thirr River, just north of Othmura's temple. Mangrove roots pierce the ceiling, though the bulk of the grotto remains flooded. Slaughterfish inhabit the waters alongside the trolls.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Magun Grotto is.

title: Mahsamsi
topic_desc: Mahsamsi is a fungi-filled crystal cavern situated in the Lan Orethan region, north of Bosmora. The cave is distinguished by its abundant growth of Bluefoot, Luminous Russula, and Violet Coprinus fungi. It is otherwise a scenic but largely barren cavern. The remains of a deceased individual rest on a ledge in the northeastern chamber, accompanied by a bottle of vintage brandy. Local fauna primarily consists of rats and nix-hounds. The cavern is visible from the nearby woodland path, positioned directly southwest of Bushipananit.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mahsamsi is.

title: Mala Tor
topic_desc: Mala Tor is a ruined Ayleid outpost on the border with Black Marsh in the Shipal-Shin region. It overlooks the Imperial structures at Stormgate Pass, though the bridges that once connected to it have long since crumbled. The ruin's interior is dominated by a long central shaft descending to a lower section known as Lattagarlas, where a shrine to Meridia stands. Ayleid creatures and Daedra inhabit the chambers throughout. Among the artifacts preserved within are the Varla Stone of Seared Bindings and Saliache relics—bracers and a shield—alongside Ayleid weaponry and statuettes.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mala Tor is.

title: Malamali
topic_desc: Malamali is a flooded cavern in the Roth Roryn region, recognized as a place of pilgrimage. The specific holy significance of the site is unclear, though it clearly holds religious importance. Three Dunmer pilgrims reside within its winding tunnels, maintaining the sacred space. A copy of a notable Vivec sermon is kept within the cave.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Malamali is.

title: Malanibi Grotto
topic_desc: Malanibi Grotto is a remote, submerged cavern in the Padomaic Ocean, situated northwest of Wavebreaker Keep at considerable depth. Despite its location well beneath the sea surface, breathable air pockets persist within its chambers, including an unlikely one near the entrance. The grotto serves as a lair for carnivorous sea crabs, which pose a lethal threat to intruders. The far northern chamber holds the remains of an unfortunate adventurer, still clad in a largely complete set of Dreugh armor, including the distinctive left and right pauldron-fins. The presence of this corpse testifies to the grotto's danger and the fatal surprise awaiting those who navigate its flooded passages.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Malanibi Grotto is.

title: Malarnubi
topic_desc: Malarnubi is a submerged riverbed grotto in the Aanthirin region, serving as the dwelling of the lich Hautharmo and the submerged approach to the hidden Daedric ruin of Emmurbalpitu. The site comprises three distinct zones: an entirely flooded entry tunnel accessible from the river near the Oran Plantation road, a dry antechamber midway through the cave system, and an inner sanctum where Hautharmo resides amid a collection of texts on the dark arts, rare potions, and alchemical apparatus. The grotto's flooded passages require sustained water breathing to traverse safely. Dreugh have been observed near the submerged entrance. The antechamber contains a deep pool and is guarded by undead servants in the lich's service. Malarnubi's significance lies in its concealment of Emmurbalpitu and its occupation by an undead sorcerer of considerable power.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Malarnubi is.

title: Malawius Camp
topic_desc: Malawius Camp is a desolate Ashlander settlement in the Armun Ashlands, situated just south of Mount Annu. The site is littered with the skeletal remains of the Malawius tribe, who were apparently eradicated. The sole standing structure is Addun's Yurt, beneath which a concealed pit harbors a trio of Baluath Clan vampires. These undead—Kashshaptu, Etemmu, and Utukku-Seri—constitute the camp's only inhabitants, having replaced the original Ashlander occupants.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Malawius Camp is.

title: Malkamalit
topic_desc: Malkamalit is a Daedric shrine dedicated to the Prince Boethiah, situated in the Mephalan Vales. The ruin currently suffers occupation by cultists. Within the shrine's central chamber, an enchanted Daedric Staff known as Boethiah's Walking Stick rests at the feet of Boethiah's statue. A key to the complex's locked southeastern door rests on a table in the western portion of the same chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Malkamalit is.

title: Malumed
topic_desc: Malumed is a cavern in the Roth Roryn region, distinguished by silver ore lining its walls. It serves as the final resting place of Yanirab Odissara, the Ashkhan of the Damanu. The cave is occupied by minor wildlife such as rats and slaughterfish, and otherwise holds little of note.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Malumed is.

title: Manabilu Grotto
topic_desc: Manabilu Grotto is a medium-sized cavern in the Dagon Urul region, situated near Tel Oren and the ancient Dunmer stronghold of Mandaran. Unlike typical submerged grottoes, its entrance is located above water, set into a high rocky bank. The interior is characterized by extensive fungal growths and is inhabited by beasts, including beetles and leeches. An eyestar rests on the northeastern cavern floor, and a skeleton clutching a Nordic shortsword lies within an eastern cave, suggesting a past traveler's grim fate.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Manabilu Grotto is.

title: Manamsi
topic_desc: Manamsi is a cave situated in the Shipal-Shin region, lying at the end of a small canyon to the east of the Daedric shrine of Assukilunend. Currently serving as a hideout for a band of outlaws, the cave's interior holds evidence of a violent act against House Hlaalu; the body of a Hlaalu kinsman lies within, suggesting the bandits have slain a high-ranking member of the Great House.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Manamsi is.

title: Mandaran
topic_desc: Mandaran is an ancient stronghold on the Dagon Urul coastline, situated between Firewatch and Helnim in the Inner Sea region. The fortress currently harbors a band of marauders whose operations trouble local trade. The site comprises three interior zones—upper and lower levels alongside a Propylon Chamber—and its ramparts overlook a shoreline stalked by land dreugh. Mandaran's propylon is active, with its index located in the Velothi tower of Shularon. A copy of the treatise *Chance's Folly* rests in the upper level.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mandaran is.

title: Manishtashut
topic_desc: Manishtashut is a flooded Daedric shrine dedicated to Molag Bal, situated on the eastern shore of Lake Coronati in the Coronati Basin. While the ruin's towers still rise above the waterline, the interior is submerged. The flooded chambers are inhabited by dreugh. Scattered gemstones beneath the shrine's statue represent the site's principal treasure.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Manishtashut is.

title: Mannu
topic_desc: Mannu is a Velothi tower situated in the Roth Roryn region, northwest of Bodrum. The tower is currently overrun by a major infestation of scamps. The cause of this daedric overpopulation is a failed summoning spell cast by the Dunmer sorcerer Atreno Drenim, who remains trapped within the tower behind a locked door, unable to safely navigate the swarm of lesser daedra his magic inadvertently unleashed.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mannu is.

title: Mannusudipat Mine
topic_desc: Mannusudipat Mine is an ebony mine located in the Mephalan Vales. The nearest settlement of note is Akamoor, and the nearest Imperial installation is the Windmoth Legion Fort. The mine consists of a single worked zone. Beyond its classification as an ebony extraction site in that region, little detailed information about its operation, ownership, or history is widely documented.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mannusudipat Mine is.

title: Manrizache
topic_desc: Manrizache is a Dwemer ruin that has sunk beneath the Sea of Ghosts. The complex comprises four zones: the Entry and Nuzunch Hall remain submerged, while a breached wall leads to the Factory Maintenance Tunnel, where a series of doors seal out the ocean. Beyond this barrier, the Hall of Dumac stays bone dry and holds numerous Dwemer artifacts, though functional Dwemer constructs still patrol the dry chambers. An archaeological investigation is presently underway from a moored vessel, The Northern Wind, though the submerged corridors have already claimed at least one expedition member to drowning. The persistent construct guardians have compelled the researchers to retain Fighters Guild mercenaries for protection.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Manrizache is.

title: Mansit-Nur Hive
topic_desc: Mansit-Nur Hive is a large skyrender nest located in the Shipal-Shin region, south of Narsis. The cave structure features flooded lower sections alongside drier chambers. It serves as a habitat for skyrenders, which occupy the hive's network of tunnels and central chambers. The wet cave environment has preserved notable artifacts within its depths, including a Claymore of Mysteries, a Glass Tower Shield, and the Helm of Mauloch's Cleaving, the latter situated in the submerged sections. The name is noted in development records as a reference to its creator.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mansit-Nur Hive is.

title: Mansurabi
topic_desc: Mansurabi is a large, five-section cave network in the Alt Orethan region, situated between the settlements of Darvonis and Meralag on the Morrowind mainland. It serves as a conduit for smugglers transporting illegal contraband from Vvardenfell via Darvonis into the interior. The network features four surface entrances: a mountain valley entrance south of Darvonis, a volcanic waste exit west of Meralag, and two concealed exits near Meralag—one behind a large waterfall and another through a muckpond over the mountains. The North Tunnels are occupied by goblins that prey on unwary smugglers. The Lava Tunnels contain a broken Dwemer door connected to the inaccessible surface ruins of Akuband. The Lake section holds submerged rock crystals, glass and raw gold deposits, and bioluminescent fungi. The Falls section is distinguished by a large waterfall, while the South Tunnels hold abandoned smuggler cargo and bloatspore.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mansurabi is.

title: Mansutarmus
topic_desc: Mansutarmus is a cavern in the Sunad Mora region, serving as a conjurer's abode. The single, unbranched passage is well-guarded by Daedra, indicating the summoning practices of its occupant. At the passage's end lies the chamber of the Dunmer sorcerer Fevyn Verethi, who keeps magical scrolls within. Though hostile upon intrusion, Verethi is known to sell spells if pacified.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mansutarmus is.

title: Mantassa Camp
topic_desc: Mantassa Camp is a small settlement of hostile Shinathi located in the Shipal-Shin region. The camp consists of at least two structures: a communal tent and a separate tent. It is situated on the eastern side of a mesa, accessible via a narrow ledge that encircles the formation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mantassa Camp is.

title: Manumnabi
topic_desc: Manumnabi is a small cavern situated along the riverside in the Aanthirin region, northwest of Felms Ithul. Formerly a smugglers' den, the cave now serves as the lair for a pack of Nix-Hounds led by the Nix-Mother, a specimen of remarkable size and strength.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Manumnabi is.

title: Manupillat
topic_desc: Manupillat is a small underwater grotto situated along the coast of the Sacred Lands, southwest of Necrom. The cave serves as a Dreugh lair and holds the remains of several Argonian slaves. Scattered slave bracers beside the bones indicate the Argonians were fed upon by the resident Dreugh. Diamond deposits in the northern chamber ceiling and abandoned pickaxes suggest the slaves were sent into the grotto to mine the precious gems before meeting their demise. The site reflects the perilous intersection of forced labor and the natural dangers of the region's coastal caves.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Manupillat is.

title: Marananit
topic_desc: Marananit is a cavern in the Armun Ashlands situated on a cliff above Addai Mine. The Addai-Marananit Tunnel directly connects the two excavations. The cave currently houses a band of thieves who extract and hoard raw ebony, a practice presumably undertaken without the knowledge of the mine's regular workers. Stolen ebony ore fills crates within the cavern, and much of the raw mineral remains in the direct possession of the occupying rogues.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Marananit is.

title: Marisanibal
topic_desc: Marisanibal is a cave complex in the Boethiah's Spine region, located near the headwaters of the River Garivun east of Helnin. The cave comprises three zones and functions as a large-scale skooma manufacturing operation. The entrance area serves as quarters for the bandits who control the site. Deeper caverns house the primary production facilities, where moon sugar is refined into skooma over open fires and stored in quantity alongside alchemical ingredients used to augment the drug. A separate supply chamber stockpiles vast reserves of finished skooma, moon sugar, and other materials. Enslaved workers labor throughout the production areas. A deep chasm in the upper caves serves as a grim disposal pit. The operation's scale and organization point to a well-established criminal enterprise exploiting the region's remoteness.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Marisanibal is.

title: Marog
topic_desc: Marog is a settlement located on the mainland of Morrowind. Beyond its general existence as an inhabited place, little is widely documented regarding its specific history, governance, or cultural significance.
topic_desc_basic: Marog is a settlement on the Morrowind mainland.

title: Marsud
topic_desc: Marsud is a small underwater grotto situated in the Inner Sea off the coast of Roth Roryn. The cave's interior is partially inhabited by slaughterfish and features kollop beds that yield pearls. A skeletal remains lies within the passage, its hand trapped in a kollop, still clutching a potion of water breathing. A Mark Ring rests on a high, mushroom-covered ledge within the first chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Marsud is.

title: Marushpaanu Tunnel
topic_desc: Marushpaanu Tunnel is a cave system situated in the Mephalan Vales region. It features at least two known entrances, one to the north and another to the east. The tunnel is occupied by spider daedra, suggesting a connection to Daedric influence consistent with the region's association with Mephala. The nearest settlement of note is Akamora, and the Windmoth Legion Fort represents the closest Imperial military presence in the area. The cave comprises a single zone.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Marushpaanu Tunnel is.

title: Marwat
topic_desc: Marwat is a smugglers' cave located in the Sundered Scar region of Morrowind. It serves as a hideout for bandits, who stash contraband goods within its single chamber. The cave entrance lies at the edge of the treeline east of Darvonis.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Marwat is.

title: Maryon Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Maryon Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Sacred Lands, beyond the cliffs north of Necrom. It sits at one terminus of a dirt road linking it to Darethran Ancestral Tomb. Like many such sites, the interior is guarded by undead. A locked door secures the tomb's main valuables, which are kept within a trapped chest alongside a skeleton bearing a copy of The Cantatas of Vivec.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Maryon Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Marys Cave Dwelling
topic_desc: Marys Cave Dwelling is a guar-herder's home situated on the banks of the Pryai in the Roth Roryn region. The entrance is typically identified by the assembled guar outside. The occupant, Felryne Marys, resides there modestly; the dwelling holds little of material value. It serves as a functional shelter for a herder tending guar in the Roth Roryn countryside.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Marys Cave Dwelling is.

title: Mashadananit
topic_desc: Mashadananit is an ash-flooded Daedric shrine dedicated to Mehrunes Dagon, situated in the Armun Ashlands. Unlike typical Daedric shrines, its statue stands outside, half-buried by ash that flooded the site during some unknown cataclysm. The interior, known as the Molten Halls, is a perilous zone featuring hostile Daedra and lava pits. The shrine draws Dagon's cultists and Daedric servants to its ruined grounds.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mashadananit is.

title: Mashanuad
topic_desc: Mashanuad is a small cave situated at the southernmost edge of the Armun Ashlands, accessible by traveling directly west from the Armun Pass Outpost. The cave currently serves as a refuge for a pair of High Elf outlaws. Despite its occupation by bandits, the site yields little of material value; the goods amassed within are notably paltry.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mashanuad is.

title: Massanud
topic_desc: Massanud is a cave in the Aanthirin region, situated on the road running east from the village of Rilsoan. The cavern conceals an entrance to a Dwemer ruin, accessed through a locked door hidden atop a rock at the rear of the cave, near a large glass tube of bubbling water beside a Dwemer bed. The ruin below contains the Dwemer Boots of Flying, which confer a levitation effect upon the wearer. Both the cavern and the subterranean Dwemer complex are occupied by bandits and active Dwemer machines. The bandit presence is connected to nearby Rilsoan, whose residents acknowledge kinship among those operating from the cave.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Massanud is.

title: Massapi
topic_desc: Massapi is a cave situated in the Boethiah's Spine region, west of Alt Bosara. It is distinguished by a prominent subterranean waterfall that dominates its interior. The cave holds no known treasure or hostile inhabitants, but contains a Shrine of Almalexia's Mercy. This shrine provides pilgrims and travelers cures for poison and common or blight diseases, and can bestow Almalexia's Mercy, a blessing conferring temporary resistance to normal weapons.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Massapi is.

title: Massaunus
topic_desc: Massaunus is a small cave situated in the Aanthirin region, lying just north of the Mundrethi Plantation. Its entrance is positioned directly beneath the road leading away from the plantation's manor complex. The cavern serves as a base for smugglers, containing distinct sleeping and storage areas. Among the stored goods is a copy of the mercantile treatise "The Dreadful Theft," and a sapphire and emerald rest in the sleeping quarters.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Massaunus is.

title: Massunat Mine
topic_desc: Massunat Mine is a sapphire extraction site in the Shipal-Shin region, operating under the control of the Ja-Natta Syndicate. The facility lies in the shadow of Udannu, the syndicate's primary stronghold. Access to the mine is restricted; its entrance is secured by lock, with the keys held by syndicate operatives within the mine and the adjacent tower. The excavation is worked by slave labor under the guard of syndicate enforcers and cutthroats, who restrict entry to their own ranks. The site yields sapphire from six ore veins.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Massunat Mine is.

title: Masunabi Egg Mine
topic_desc: Masunabi Egg Mine is a medium-sized kwama egg mine situated in the Dagon Urul region, west of Onimushili. Its entrance lies between the expansive Daedric ruin of Onimushili and the Dwemer tower of Ratharzak. Unlike operational facilities, Masunabi lacks any miner presence, indicating that the kwama colony within is wild and untended. The mine shows negligible signs of sapient activity and contains no worked resources or valuable loot, its tunnels given over entirely to the natural behaviors of the untended kwama.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Masunabi Egg Mine is.

title: Mavandes Caravanserai
topic_desc: Mavandes Caravanserai is a fortified caravan stop situated on the trade route connecting Narsis and the Dejasyte within the Coronati Basin. Founded by the Mavandes family, the outpost provides essential lodging and a general goods store for traveling merchants. Great House Hlaalu has invested in the site's infrastructure, funding the construction of a defensive wall and tower and posting guards to secure the valuable trade corridor. The caravanserai also serves as a waypoint for retainers and agents of Great House Dres and the East Empire Company, reflecting its role in broader inter-house and imperial commerce. Enslaved Argonians labor at the stop, a common practice among the Dunmeri houses that profit from the route.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mavandes Caravanserai is.

title: Mawapi-Addon
topic_desc: Mawapi-Addon is a small cave situated on a cape along the southern shore of Lake Boethiah, between Alt Bosara and Tel Mothrivra in the Boethiah's Spine region. Its entrance lies set back from the shoreline among the rocks at the feet of the hills. The cave serves as a hideout for a band of smugglers who do not specialize in a single type of illicit trade. Their stored cargo includes crates of skooma, moon sugar, Dwemer artifacts, kwama eggs, and various miscellaneous goods, alongside a few beverages and a scroll of Battlecry.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mawapi-Addon is.

title: Mazkun
topic_desc: Mazkun is an encampment of Malahk Orcs situated in the Velothi Mountains above Hendor-Stardumz. The camp lies near the mountain peaks and consists of three caverns—designated as the clan dwellings, the chieftain's dwelling, and the shaman's dwelling—protected by a palisade at its entrance. It serves as the seat of a small Malahk community led by Chieftain Ughash gro-Mazkun and Shaman Lagabul gra-Yarnag.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mazkun is.

title: Melethi Lighthouse
topic_desc: Melethi Lighthouse is a navigational beacon guiding ships into Lake Boethiah. It stands on an island in the lake just east of Andar Mok within the Boethiah's Spine region. The lighthouse is maintained by its namesake, Lightkeeper Felos Melethi, who lives a simple existence provisioned only with basic food, drink, and a change of clothes. Among the sparse furnishings is a Captain's Log, likely recovered from a vessel that crashed upon the lighthouse's island and remains as a Trapped Shipwreck.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Melethi Lighthouse is.

title: Menaan
topic_desc: Menaan is a fortified House Hlaalu settlement situated in the Roth Roryn region. Despite its defenses, the town remains sleepy and only recently began developing a proper economy under the stewardship of Governor Dathlyn Vando, though rumors link him to the Camonna Tong. Services are sparse, limited to a blacksmith and silt strider transport connecting to Bal Foyen and Arvud. The settlement suffers from a notorious rate of assassinations, prompting some nobles to barricade themselves indoors. It lies southwest of Bal Foyen, near agricultural ventures like the Savrethi Distillery and Vathras Plantation, with the Monastery of St. Aralor to the north and the Armun Ashlands to the south.
topic_desc_basic: Menaan is a fortified House Hlaalu settlement in the Roth Roryn region, southwest of Bal Foyen. A sleepy town with few services, it can be reached by silt strider from Bal Foyen and Arvud.

title: Mendris Terif's Shack
topic_desc: Mendris Terif's Shack is a modest dwelling situated west of Tilmeth Manor in the Alt Orethan region. It serves as the home of Mendris Terif, a Dark Elf farmer who works the surrounding fields. The structure is a simple agricultural residence containing nothing of material value.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mendris Terif's Shack is.

title: Menuas-Ahhe
topic_desc: Menuas-Ahhe is a wild kwama nest in the Roth Roryn region that remains untapped by men or mer. The cave harbors a natural colony of kwama, though beyond the eggs themselves, the site offers little of value. Its remote location contributes to its undisturbed state, leaving the creatures to their natural cycles without the infrastructure of a settled egg mine.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Menuas-Ahhe is.

title: Meralag
topic_desc: Meralag is a sleepy town of House Indoril nobles and their retainers, nestled in a pleasant vale in the Alt Orethan region. Locals consider it a fine example of the refined Indoril way of life. The settlement serves as a common rest stop for pilgrims traveling south toward Almalexia, and for travelers journeying north toward the Telvannis District, Vvardenfell, or Old Ebonheart via Darvonis. The town features a small market plaza with an alchemist, clothier, and trader, and rooms at The Golden Glade tavern. Nearby sites include the Mansurabi smuggler tunnels west of town and the large, undead-infested ruin of Zanammu to the northeast.
topic_desc_basic: Meralag is a sleepy Indoril town in the Alt Orethan region, serving as a common rest stop for pilgrims and travelers journeying between Almalexia and the Telvannis District or Vvardenfell.

title: Merihayan
topic_desc: Merihayan is an ancient ruin situated in the Lan Orethan region, east of Dreynim. It formerly served as the den of a large vampire clan before being purged by Indoril forces in service to Almalexia an unknown number of years ago. Following the purge, only one vampire, Berelas, remains among the stronghold's undead occupants. The site lacks a functional propylon chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Merihayan is.

title: Mersavalu Grotto
topic_desc: Mersavalu Grotto is a small, flooded cave situated in the Aanthirin region, on the island immediately southeast of Roa Dyr's Statesmen's Hall. Its entrance lies above the waterline, opening into submerged passages. Though uninhabited, the grotto supports a population of kollops, making it a potential source of pearls for those willing to scavenge the underwater beds.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mersavalu Grotto is.

title: Meshenawia
topic_desc: Meshenawia is a small, partially flooded cave located in the Roth Roryn region. It serves as a habitat for kollops and kobolds. Pearls can be scavenged from the kollops residing in the depths of the cavern.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Meshenawia is.

title: Midannecne
topic_desc: Midannecne is a small cave situated along the eastern coast of Morrowind's mainland, lying just south of the Sunad Mora Lighthouse, east of Sarvanni, and north of Ashamul. The cavern serves as the lair for the necromancer Nevos Drelvi, an Oathman of Great House Telvanni, and his undead servants. The interior is guarded by skeletal remains and mummies, while the hoarded treasure consists primarily of uncommon components and dubious brews rather than wealth. The cave's furnishings include alchemical ingredients such as daedra and ghoul hearts, human flesh, and assorted unidentified potions, reflecting the sinister and esoteric pursuits of its occupant.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Midannecne is.

title: Milcoon
topic_desc: Milcoon is a small cave in the Sunad Mora region distinguished by its two separate entrances. The interior holds little of note, containing only a single crate storing several torches.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Milcoon is.

title: Mining Bunkhouse
topic_desc: A tavern in Helnim that serves as the primary gathering place for the local mining community.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mining Bunkhouse is.

title: Mirba
topic_desc: Mirba is a haunted Velothi tower situated on the southern shore of Lake Andaram, on the hill behind the Maar-Bani Crossing in the Aanthirin region. Decades ago, the tower served as a seat for Telvanni necromancers. The Tribunal Temple executed these wizards for their crimes, leaving the structure abandoned. It is now infested by rats and the undead remnants of its former occupants, including the necromancer Ondres Llerarys. A copy of the Alteration skill book "36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 13" rests on the floor at the top of the dome, and an Ebony Dagger lies within a skeleton's chest on the same floor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mirba is.

title: Mirhel Grotto
topic_desc: Mirhel Grotto is a small, submerged cave on the southern shoreline of Lake Coronati within the Coronati Basin. Its entrance lies southwest of the Daedric shrine of Ashishibishi. The grotto is home to common lake fauna such as mudcrabs and slaughterfish. At its deepest point rests a chest of raw ebony, pierced through by an iron sparksword. Scholars and treasure hunters have theorized Mirhel Grotto as a possible resting place for the legendary Benthic Mail, though these accounts are disputed and the artifact is more reliably believed to reside elsewhere.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mirhel Grotto is.

title: Mirou Grotto
topic_desc: Mirou Grotto is a large submerged cavern in the Aanthirin region, situated off the coast near Rilsoan. The entrance lies beneath the waterline of a rock formation reachable by swimming northwest from the settlement. The grotto is infested with slaughterfish, and kollops along its passages yield pearls. Within the flooded interior are traces of mining equipment and two exposed ebony veins, indicating that the cavern served as the flooded entrance to an ebony mine. The presence of an overturned minecart and scattered skeletal remains further attests to past mining activity. The southeastern chamber contains an underwater chest accompanied by potions of water breathing. The grotto's connection to ebony extraction makes it a site of both economic interest and considerable danger to divers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mirou Grotto is.

title: Misapit
topic_desc: Misapit is a smuggler's cave situated in the Sundered Scar region. The entrance lies inland from the coastal route north of Darvonis, branching off near Serim Derthi's Shack. The cave serves as a hideout for a small band of smugglers who store their contraband among crates and barrels within its single chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Misapit is.

title: Mjornir's Meadhouse
topic_desc: Mjornir's Meadhouse is a tavern in Helnim operated by its Nord proprietor, Mjornir. It caters to those seeking Nord mead and is known as an establishment where physical brawls readily erupt.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mjornir's Meadhouse is.

title: Molag Ruhn
topic_desc: Molag Ruhn is a region of rich pastures spanning portions of the Mournhold and Telvannis Districts. It borders Azura's Coast across the Inner Sea, Dagon Urul to the north, Boethiah's Spine to the east, and the Mephalan Vales to the south. Traditionally noted for its guar herds and the substantial Dwemer ruins of Kemel-Ze, the region has drawn heightened House Telvanni interest following the Empire's establishment of a foothold at Helnim. Ambitious Telvanni wizards now seek dominance over the Imperial presence and each other, creating an uncomfortable standoff in the mixed town of Helnim. The Telvanni towers of Tel Muthada and Marog anchor local magical authority, while Imperial influence centers on Helnim, an important trading center between the Empire and House Telvanni.
topic_desc_basic: Molag Ruhn is a region of rich pastures in the Mournhold and Telvannis Districts. It lies across the Inner Sea from Azura's Coast, bordered by Dagon Urul, Boethiah's Spine, and the Mephalan Vales. It is known for its guar herds and the Dwemer ruins of Kemel-Ze.

title: Molkadh Mountains
topic_desc: The Molkadh Mountains constitute a small, mountainous sub-region within Boethiah's Spine, bounded loosely by the road to Llothanis to the south and the coastal road to Tel Ouada to the east. Among the oldest settled portions of Boethiah's Spine, the area has seen most inhabitants relocate to more hospitable lands, leaving only three officially inhabited settlements: the troglodytic community of Ashamul, the molecrab farm of Sarvanni, and the Telvanni settlement of Ranyon-ruhn, from which Master Mithras governs the sub-region. The mountains harbor the formidable Aranyon Pass, alongside ancestral tombs, abandoned egg mines, and coastal infrastructure such as the Sunad Mora Lighthouse on the Sea of Ghosts.
topic_desc_basic: The Molkadh Mountains are a small, rugged sub-region within Boethiah's Spine in northeast Morrowind. Though among the oldest settled parts of the region, only three settlements remain inhabited: Ashamul, Sarvanni, and Ranyon-ruhn. The mountains are notable for the treacherous Aranyon Pass.

title: Molkobal
topic_desc: Molkobal is a small, unoccupied smugglers' cave situated on an island in the Aanthirin region, between Bal Foyen and the settlement of Gol Mok. The diminutive cavern currently serves as a secluded stash for contraband, evidenced by scattered moon sugar within its chambers. A locked interior section conceals the remains of a missing merchant, Gavros Falas, indicating the cave's recent use as a site for illicit, fatal dealings rather than active habitation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Molkobal is.

title: Monastery of St. Aralor
topic_desc: The Monastery of St. Aralor is a Tribunal Temple sanctuary in the Roth Roryn region, situated just north of Menaan. Dedicated to Saint Aralor the Penitent—a condemned criminal renowned for his repentance—the monastery serves as a retreat for those seeking to follow his example. Most acolytes are former members of the Camonna Tong who have come to live, work, and meditate to earn forgiveness for their past crimes. The head priest, Dram Marvos, emphasizes that true repentance requires suffering, a path he himself has walked. The site includes the main abbey and the Penitents Cavern, and it houses the Shrine of Forgiveness, a destination for Temple pilgrims seeking absolution.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Monastery of St. Aralor is.
aliases: Monastery of St. Aralor, Penitents Cavern

title: Monastery of St. Delyn
topic_desc: The Monastery of St. Delyn is a woodland retreat dedicated to St. Delyn the Wise, situated within the Othreleth Woods. Overseen by a small community of Tribunal Temple monks, the monastery maintains a well-stocked library and serves as a center for study and devotion. The settlement's master holds the rank of Diviner within the Temple hierarchy, while its inhabitants include scribes, an alchemist, and an enchanter, reflecting the retreat's scholarly purpose.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Monastery of St. Delyn is.

title: Monastery of St. Felms
topic_desc: The Monastery of St. Felms is a Tribunal Temple monastery dedicated to the warrior saint Felms, situated on a bend of the Pryai River atop the high cliffs of Roth Roryn. The complex comprises a dormitory, entry hall, infirmary, mess hall, a Tower of Contemplation, and underground passages. A glassmith's forge operates within the Tower of Contemplation, working the valuable material. The infirmary tends to the sick and wounded under dedicated healers. The monastery serves as a site of Temple duties and pilgrimage, particularly for members who have attained the rank of Curate. Its clifftop setting above the river bend gives it a defensible, secluded character suited to contemplation and martial devotion alike.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Monastery of St. Felms is.
aliases: Monastery of St. Felms, Mess Hall
Monastery of St. Felms, Tower of Contemplation

title: Moraib
topic_desc: Moraib is a small cave in the Shipal-Shin region, situated atop the mesa northeast of the Number Rooms Temple at the source of the Thirr River. It serves as a dwelling for the Ussiran clan of the Shinathi Ashlanders. The cave's inhabitants include members of varying standing within the clan, such as barbarians, archers, and healers. Among them, the healer Jiladisi provides training in Restoration, Mysticism, and Alchemy.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Moraib is.

title: Moril Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Moril Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Lan Orethan region, east of the settlement of Dreynim. The tomb is guarded by typical undead protectors, including bonewalkers, ancestor ghosts, and skeletons. Its interior consists of branching passageways: one path terminates in a pitfall, while the other requires bypassing locked doors to proceed. A flooded area lies at the bottom of the pitfall. Sarcophagi are present within the chambers, one of which rests adjacent to a balcony near interior waterfalls and holds a Prayer to Azura scroll invoking Azura's Light. The tomb contains burial goods and potions, including an exclusive rising force potion within the flooded pitfall, facilitating escape from the lower depths.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Moril Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Morvil Arelath's Shack
topic_desc: Morvil Arelath's Shack is an isolated farmstead situated in the Mephalan Vales, west of Tel Muthada and south of Marog. The dwelling suits a solitary hunter's lifestyle, stocked with weapons, arrows, and preserved food for extended hunts. A few books offer distraction during quiet moments, and a small chest holds a modest amount of gold.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Morvil Arelath's Shack is.

title: Mothran Plantation
topic_desc: Mothran Plantation is a Kuj Sprout and Corkbulb farm situated outside the walls of Hlerynhul in the Coronati Basin. The plantation lies immediately south of the town's southern gates. It is operated under the oversight of Hlana Mothran, a House Hlaalu cousin of noble standing, who resides in the manor alongside a commoner named Nara Selos. A Khajiit slave is held in the plantation's storage building. The estate's agricultural output centers on two staple crops of Morrowind: kuj sprout and corkbulb root. The plantation represents a typical Hlaalu-organized agricultural enterprise in the region, combining Dunmer landownership with enslaved labor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mothran Plantation is.

title: Mount Annu
topic_desc: Mount Annu is a sacred burial site of the Ashlanders situated in the Armun Ashlands. A crown of rock spikes encircles its crest. The ascending path is lined with numerous mummified remains, their worldly goods placed beside them as offerings. Some of these entombed dead are less inert than they appear and will rise to defend the hallowed ground against intruders. Gems and jewelry rest at the mountain's peak.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mount Annu is.

title: Mount Dunul
topic_desc: Mount Dunul is the highest peak of the southern Velothi Mountains. The mountain is riddled with a subterranean labyrinth known as Cavern, and a shrine placed within its farthest reaches suggests a connection with the faith of the Tribunal Temple.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mount Dunul is.

title: Mount Dunul, Cavern
topic_desc: Mount Dunul, Cavern is a labyrinthine cave system situated on the eastern flank of Mount Dunul, the highest peak in the southern Velothi Mountains. The cavern is vast but holds few material riches, distinguished primarily by an abundant growth of stinkhorn cap, a fungus valued for its restorative and magical properties. At the extreme western end of the cave lies a holy shrine, establishing the site as a place of pilgrimage watched over by a devotee of the Tribunal Temple.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mount Dunul, Cavern is.

title: Mount Sarrunabi
topic_desc: Mount Sarrunabi is a volcano and necromancer's haunt that looms over Firewatch in the Dagon Urul region. The mountain has been inhabited since the distant past, evidenced by the presence of the Dwemer ruin of Rthungzark and the ancient Dunmer stronghold of Koranyon. During the Imperial Simulacrum, the necromancer Shalath Abkala exploited the era's chaos to raise an army of the undead from fallen soldiers. She currently resides within Mount Sarrunabi, Cavern, making the mountain an active site of necromantic threat.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mount Sarrunabi is.

title: Mount Sarrunabi, Cavern
topic_desc: These lava-soaked tunnels beneath Mount Sarrunabi in the Dagon Urul region harbor an undead menace. Since the days of the Imperial Simulacrum, the caverns have hosted a small army of walking dead raised in the aftermath of the Battle of the Inner Sea. Many of these skeletons still wear their Imperial Legion uniforms. The necromancer responsible for this force maintains her residence within the depths.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mount Sarrunabi, Cavern is.

title: Mubura
topic_desc: Mubura is a small cave hollow situated in the eastern Coronati Basin. Its entrance is marked by wooden stakes. The cave serves as a habitat for dust beetles, including the notably larger and more dangerous specimen known as Bonescraper. A modest collection of valuables lies hidden in the straw behind this creature.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mubura is.

title: Muck Rat
topic_desc: The Muck Rat is a vessel berthed in the harbor of Enamor Dayn. It is operated by the Orc shipmaster Laga gra-Shogar, who offers passage aboard it to the isle of Gorne, lying east of the coast, and to the Temple city above Necrom. The ship's name is known primarily through its master's own words.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Muck Rat is.

title: Muddunshipal Egg Mine
topic_desc: Muddunshipal Egg Mine is a partially flooded kwama egg mine situated at Velonith in the Aanthirin region. While it does not serve as the sole source of Velonith's relatively meager prosperity, the mine provides steady employment for local Dunmer miners. The interior features flooded tunnels extending out from behind waterfalls, though these submerged passages hold little of interest. The mine yields a modest output of kwama eggs, sustaining the settlement's limited economy.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Muddunshipal Egg Mine is.

title: Mudflats
topic_desc: The Mudflats are a coastal region in the Deshaan District of Morrowind, where the salty Deshaan Plains crumble into the sea. The landscape is defined by shifting mud and sandbars, subject to regular tidal changes. Local flora and fauna are well-adapted to these conditions. The region borders the Arnesian Jungle, Salt Marsh, and Deshaan Plains to the west, and Lan Orethan to the north. Its largest settlement is Tear. Frequent fog and rain characterize the area's weather.
topic_desc_basic: The Mudflats are a coastal region in the Deshaan District of Morrowind, where the Deshaan Plains meet the sea. Defined by shifting mud and sandbars, the area experiences regular tidal changes. It borders the Arnesian Jungle, Salt Marsh, and Deshaan Plains to the west, and Lan Orethan to the north. Tear is its largest settlement.

title: Mugan Crypt
topic_desc: Mugan Crypt is a medium-sized crypt in the Sacred Lands region, situated in the Mephalan Vales northwest of Sailen and directly southeast of Akamora. The twisting terrain of the Vales makes direct approach from Akamora nearly impossible without levitation; the practical route follows the road north from Sailen to the fork near Geras Egg Mine, then west. The crypt's interior employs bone textures, a construction style rare enough to draw remark. Shrines to each of the Tribunal—Almalexia, Vivec, and Sotha Sil—are installed within. The northeastern chamber holds an urn containing assorted scrolls. Undead typical of Dunmer ancestral tombs occupy the passages.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mugan Crypt is.

title: Mulabaddon Grotto
topic_desc: Mulabaddon Grotto is a submerged cavern located deep beneath Lake Andaram, northwest of Aimrah in the Aanthirin region. The entrance lies at considerable depth on the lakebed, situated near a small shipwreck. The grotto serves as a habitat for dreugh and slaughterfish, and kollops within its waters occasionally yield pearls. Debris from the exterior wreck, including scattered crates, moon sugar, and raw glass, has settled inside the cave. The extreme depth of the entrance makes water-breathing equipment or potions essential for any exploration.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mulabaddon Grotto is.

title: Muld
topic_desc: Muld is a Hlaalu Velothi tower overlooking the city of Narsis in the Shipal-Shin region. It serves as the residence and workplace of Dovor Androth, a Hlaalu kinsman and mage, alongside his apprentice, Senise Uvalen. Dovor offers magical services including spellmaking, spell trading, and training to paying visitors.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Muld is.

title: Mulnabi Tunnel
topic_desc: Mulnabi Tunnel is a short, partially flooded cave in the Lan Orethan region, situated north of Bosmora near the Daedric ruins of Bushipananit. The cavern's eastern chamber contains strange rubble and is submerged, hosting kollops that yield pearls alongside predatory slaughterfish. A rocky ledge above these waters holds the remains of a thief and a securely locked chest containing a stolen Daedric naginata. A second flooded pool to the west similarly contains pearl-bearing kollops but poses a navigational hazard, as its depths require levitation or waterwalking to exit safely.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mulnabi Tunnel is.

title: Munat Egg Mine
topic_desc: Munat Egg Mine is an Indoril-owned kwama egg mine in the Aanthirin region, southeast of Balathren. It operates under the authority of Indoril Ilvi and is worked by slave labor. The mine contains a working kwama colony with a queen in the southwestern chamber. Two kwama foragers present a hazard to miners. The overseer, Fethus Llaram, a Great House Indoril retainer, manages operations from a chamber near the mine exit. The mine's workforce consists of enslaved Argonians, Khajiit, and Nords. A lava pit occupies the central chamber. Diamond deposits have been identified within the mine's depths.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Munat Egg Mine is.

title: Mundrethi Plantation
topic_desc: Mundrethi Plantation is a major agricultural and commercial estate in the Aanthirin region, situated on the west bank of the Thirr River southwest of Old Ebonheart. Owned by Lethys Mundrethi, a House Brother of Great House Hlaalu, the plantation's fields are modest, and its primary source of income derives from the slave trade rather than agriculture. The attached slave market is among the busiest in Morrowind, benefiting from its central location and a relatively large port. Lethys's wife, Tenisi Mundrethi, manages the plantation's finances and the slave market's operations. Camonna Tong members serve as bodyguards on the premises, though which spouse brought them in remains unclear. The estate includes a manor, a workers' house, warehouse facilities, and the slave market itself, all connected by a road running east from the plantation grounds.
topic_desc_basic: Mundrethi Plantation is a major estate on the west bank of the Thirr River in the Aanthirin region, southwest of Old Ebonheart. Owned by the Hlaalu-aligned Mundrethi family, it is best known for its slave market, one of the busiest in Morrowind.

title: Munsadirammus
topic_desc: Munsadirammus is a bone-ridden cave in the Shipal-Shin region, inhabited by canyon threshers. Its entrance lies east of the Velothi tower of Uddanu, appearing as a dark opening in the higher-level mesa opposite that location. The interior is littered with the scattered skeletal remains of past prey. Three canyon threshers dwell within the cave. Among the bones, a skeleton rests atop a ledge in the southwestern chamber, near an Orcish crossbow and dagger.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Munsadirammus is.

title: Murahn-Cithal Mine
topic_desc: Murahn-Cithal Mine is an abandoned iron mine situated in the Dagon Urul region, east of Firewatch. Formerly an operational site for iron extraction, the mine currently yields no economic output and stands deserted. The interior contains approximately twenty iron ore veins, though the value of these remaining deposits is offset by the severe hazards within. The tunnels are infested by wild animals and Daedra, rendering the location highly dangerous for any prospective traveler or entrepreneurial miner. Beyond the hostile inhabitants and the remaining iron deposits, the site holds no other notable features or significance.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Murahn-Cithal Mine is.

title: Murva Inveru's Shack
topic_desc: Murva Inveru's Shack is a modest dwelling located southeast of Nethil Farmhouse in the Alt Orethan region. The hut serves as the home of Murva Inveru, a Dark Elf commoner. It was apparently given to Murva by Theril Nethil, who seems to own little else beyond the farmhouse and this associated property.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Murva Inveru's Shack is.

title: Muthinis Cave
topic_desc: Muthinis Cave is a natural cavern located in the Mephalan Vales region of Morrowind. It is known to harbor beasts. The cave consists of a single zone.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Muthinis Cave is.

title: Mvelthngth-Schel
topic_desc: Mvelthngth-Schel is a Dwemer ruin situated in the Roth Roryn region, overlooking the Armun Ashlands. The site comprises two distinct sections: Heart's Wake, a flooded complex of deep pools and submerged passages, and an observatory. The architecture of Heart's Wake poses significant navigational hazards due to its extensive waterworks. The observatory retains recovered dwarven schematics, indicating its historical astronomical or mechanical function. The ruin is currently infested with Dwemer automata and serves as a lair for a reaver of the Berne vampire clan. A notable enchanted ebony blade, the Saint's Black Sword, lies deep within the spider-infested eastern chambers of Heart's Wake.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mvelthngth-Schel is.

title: Mzankh
topic_desc: Mzankh is a substantial Dwemer ruin situated in the Boethiah's Spine region, near Helnim. The site comprises two main sections: the Halls of Reason and the Brass Forge. Like many such sites, it remains guarded by active centurions and contains typical Dwemer machinery and alchemical ingredients. The ruin's interior mechanisms are currently in disrepair; several pieces of equipment have malfunctioned, including a burnt fuse in the Halls of Reason and sparking and burst pipes in the Brass Forge. Restoring these systems to operational status is necessary to unlock the final sealed treasury. This chamber holds standard Dwemer artifacts alongside the unique Noetic Sword and the Staff of Willful Eisegesis.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mzankh is.

title: Mzungleft
topic_desc: Mzungleft is a Dwemer ruin situated in the Mephalan Vales. The site comprises two distinct areas: the main halls of Mzungleft and the Destroyed Halls. The architecture bears signs of significant damage, including collapsed walls and dark, narrow passages that must be traversed to reach the lower Destroyed Halls. The ruin remains defended by active Dwemer automata, including steam centurions, centurion archers, and centurion spheres, alongside lingering Dwarven spectres. Past intruders have met fatal ends within its corridors; the remains of a looter and a skeleton are evidence of the site's persistent dangers. Scattered Dwemer coins, dishware, and surviving automata suggest the site retains some remnants of its original inhabitants, though no functional purpose for the complex is currently known.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Mzungleft is.

title: Naarshamsi
topic_desc: Naarshamsi is a small cavern on the southern fringe of the Armun Ashlands, currently serving as a hideout for bandits.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Naarshamsi is.

title: Nadin Mine
topic_desc: Nadin Mine is a small sapphire mine located in the Shipal-Shin region, west of Viri Ranch. Currently operated by hopeful Dunmer prospectors, the mine has yet to yield its valuable ore despite the miners' persistent digging. Unbeknownst to its occupants, several sapphire veins remain undiscovered in a chamber on the mine's western side, concealed behind rocks. The settlement contends with a vermin problem, as rats infest the tunnels alongside the laborers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nadin Mine is.

title: Naemunbatashpi
topic_desc: Naemunbatashpi is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Mehrunes Dagon, situated in the Coronati Basin overlooking the road along the west bank of the Thirr River, south and west of Idathren. The site comprises three interior zones: the Outer Shrine, the Inner Shrine, and the Antechamber. Cultists and Daedra occupy the interior. A Xivilai named Lotan holds the Antechamber, wielding the enchanted Daedric warhammer Shatterwright. The shrine holds notable wealth, including Daedric and Ebony armaments, ebonweave armor, and alchemical texts.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Naemunbatashpi is.

title: Nalad
topic_desc: Nalad is a three-zone cavern and shadowed tomb housing a fell Daedric shrine, situated in the Sacred Lands west of Necrom. The site is permanently infested with Daedra, who linger at the profaned altar. The shrine's desecrating presence stands in stark contrast to the nearby Tribunal Temple sanctuary, marking Nalad as a site of lingering corruption within the holy territory surrounding Necrom.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nalad is.

title: Nalmunabi
topic_desc: Nalmunabi is a cave in the Aanthirin region, situated at the source of the southeastern tributary of the river that flows east of Old Ebonheart before emptying into the Inner Sea. The cavern serves as a hideout for smugglers who have established a camp near the entrance, storing their contraband in crates and sacks. Beyond this encampment, the cave extends northward into a flooded chamber. Three submerged passages branch off from this room, leading to kollop beds that occasionally yield pearls. The cavern's depths are rumored to harbor a Longbow of Precision, an enchanted weapon that augments a marksman's accuracy at the cost of the wielder's vitality.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nalmunabi is.

title: Nalrin Vere's Shack
topic_desc: Nalrin Vere's Shack is a modest dwelling in the Dagon Urul region, situated along the road north of Helnim. It belongs to a flower farmer who tends his blooms outdoors rather than occupying the interior. The shack contains only simple provisions—basic clothing and foodstuffs—reflecting the spare lifestyle of its rural owner. The surrounding land serves as the farmer's primary workspace, where he spends his days among the flowers he cultivates.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nalrin Vere's Shack is.

title: Nalyn Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Nalyn Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral burial site situated in the Shipal-Shin region, north of Septim's Gate Pass. The tomb is divided into two distinct levels. Its upper floor features a main chamber and a side room, while the lower level contains two separate secured chambers. Like many such necropolises, the tomb is guarded by undead protectors. The lower chambers safeguard notable burial goods, including a Grand Soul Gem and an adamantium axe, reflecting the interred family's past status and wealth.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nalyn Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Namartyon
topic_desc: Namartyon is a cave situated in the Mephalan Vales of mainland Morrowind. The cave currently serves as a hold for slavers, who keep Argonian captives bound within its passages. The slaver band comprises individuals of several races—Dark Elf, Nord, Orc, Redguard, High Elf, and Wood Elf. The cave's position in the Mephalan Vales places it in the region associated with the Temple settlement of Akamora and the Windmoth Legion Fort.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Namartyon is.

title: Nameci Caverns
topic_desc: The Nameci Caverns are a large cavern system in the Boethiah's Spine region, situated above the waterline northwest of the Dwemer ruin of Mzungleft. The interior is distinguished by sweeping fungal spirals and shelf fungus arranged like natural stairways, a formation suggesting past magical cultivation. A Dridrea currently occupies the lower half of the cave. A northern tunnel leads to a pit of skulls and a Left Glass Bracer, while the matching Right Glass Bracer rests beneath a rock web in the flooded section, accessible only through telekinesis.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nameci Caverns is.

title: Namidan Egg Mine
topic_desc: Namidan Egg Mine is a medium-sized kwama egg mine situated in the Sunad Mora region. The site yields kwama eggs from its egg sacs and employs local Dark Elf miners. In addition to its dry tunnels, the mine features an underwater section. Its remote situation makes it difficult to reach. The mine's inhabitants include kwama and slaughterfish, typical hazards of such operations, alongside the laborers who work the sacs.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Namidan Egg Mine is.

title: Nan-Assali
topic_desc: Nan-Assali is a cavern in the Armun Ashlands, situated near the settlement of Arvud. Armun Kagouti have established a den within its passages. The cavern's notable feature is a doorway connecting it to the ancient ruins of Ald Erfoud, located high above a lava pool in the southwestern chamber. The ruins of Ald Erfoud are described as wealthy.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nan-Assali is.

title: Nan Iban
topic_desc: Nan Iban is a small Indoril community on an island in the Nedothril region, situated east of the mainland and south of Necrom. Accessible only by sea, it maintains regular ship passage to Enamor Dayn. The town functions as the clanstead and retirement home for House Indoril's Sedroth family, overseen by the retired councilor Ranalith Sedroth. The island is virtually devoid of wildlife, its animal population recently hunted to extinction. North of the settlement lies the Sedroth Ancestral Tomb, and further beyond is Vissamu, a cave containing the ruined holdings of pre-Tribunal House Dagoth. Submerged sites nearby include a looted shipwreck and the Gormoro Grotto entrance.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nan Iban is.

title: Nandiryon Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Nandiryon Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb situated on an island northwest of the docks of Firewatch, within the Dagon Urul region. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of its associated family. The interior is guarded by undead protectors, including skeleton archers positioned to fire through wall apertures at intruders entering the northern chamber. The southern chamber features a high recess holding a sarcophagus and a gem-filled chest, reflecting the funerary offerings interred within.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nandiryon Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Napali
topic_desc: Napali is a small cave situated at the northernmost extent of Lake Andaram within the Aanthirin region. The cavern's interior contains a pool where dead Dreugh float, suggesting the locale intersects with Dreugh habitat. The Redguard sorcerer Massitha presently occupies the cave as a temporary dwelling; her presence and a Dreugh Helm found in her camp connect her to the figure described in the account *Incident in Necrom*. The cave's proximity to Dreugh remains provides a potential source of Dreugh Wax.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Napali is.

title: Narad Ancestral Tomb
