topic_desc: Narad Ancestral Tomb is a compact Dunmer ancestral burial site situated on the island directly south of Tel Oren within the Dagon Urul region. Like many such tombs, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead, though it has become inhabited by undead guardians. The tomb's final chamber contains an enchanted Light Staff set upon a sarcophagus.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narad Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Narael Lookout
topic_desc: Narael Lookout is a watchtower guarding the Grand Hlaalu Ancestral Tomb. The tower rises out of the wall that rings the tomb, situated just east of the Narsis Waterfront within the Shipal-Shin region. Garrisoned by House Hlaalu, the outpost secures the perimeter of this significant burial site, reflecting the Great House's interest in protecting its ancestral legacies.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narael Lookout is.

title: Naram-Sin
topic_desc: Naram-Sin is a small cave in the Shipal-Shin region, serving as a lair for a canyon thresher. Its entrance, marked by bones, lies at the eastern end of a canyon reachable by traveling southeast from Septim's Gate Pass around a brown mesa. The cave's interior is strewn with remains, including those of Dunmer adventurers who previously sought to explore or clear the site.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Naram-Sin is.

title: Narasnabad
topic_desc: Narasnabad is a Daedric shrine dedicated to the Prince Azura, situated in the Alt Orethan region. The site consists of two zones: an outer cave serving as a modest antechamber, and the inner Lost Shrine. The Lost Shrine houses a statue of Azura and an offering cask. The cask exhibits a notable magical property: any filled soul gem placed within it is drained of its captured essence when the vessel is subsequently examined. The shrine is inhabited by Daedra.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narasnabad is.

title: Narcolepsy
topic_desc: The Narcolepsy is a vessel moored in the harbor of Necrom. Structured with an upper level, a lower level, and a cabin, the ship serves as a passenger and cargo transport. Under the ownership and operation of its shipmaster, the Narcolepsy provides seaborne passage to the destinations of Alt Bosara and Enamor Dayn.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narcolepsy is.

title: Narsis
topic_desc: Narsis is the capital and largest city of House Hlaalu's holdings, seated in the Shipal-Shin region. The Second Hlaalu Family, led by Grandmaster Athires Hlaalu, conducts the administrative and political affairs of the city and House from the Measurehall in the Council Quarter. Narsis is built on a large mesa encircled by the southern end of the Thirr River, providing waterfront access for ports and gondoliers. The city is divided into six districts: the Foreign Quarter, Council Quarter, Market Quarter, Old Quarter, St. Veloth Quarter, and Waterfront. The Council Quarter crowns the mesa's peak, housing the Measurehall and the Manor of the Second Hlaalu Family. The Market Quarter contains the Grand Bazaar and the Mesa Exchange, a joint innovation of the Hlaalu Council Company and the Empire allowing investors to trade in company stocks. Beneath the city's foundations lies an extensive sewer complex.
topic_desc_basic: The principal city of House Hlaalu, Narsis is widely known as the great mercantile center of Morrowind's southwestern reaches. It occupies a broad mesa along the Thirr River in the Shipal-Shin region, and its markets and ports draw merchants from across the provinces.

title: Narsis Catacombs
topic_desc: The Narsis Catacombs are an extensive subterranean necropolis beneath the Hlaalu capital of Narsis in the Shipal-Shin region. The burial network comprises several distinct chambers, including the Steps of Reverence, the Gallery of our Forefathers, the Chamber of Narsara, and Endeavor's Lament. The catacombs serve as the traditional resting place for the city's dead and are maintained by both House Hlaalu and Tribunal Temple diviners. The presence of a spellmaker and spell merchant among the Temple attendants indicates ongoing ritual significance. The depths host a guarded gateway, while smugglers occupy some lower passages, reflecting the complex's vast and partially uncontrolled expanse.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Catacombs is.

title: Narsis Council Quarter
topic_desc: The Council Quarter sits at the peak of the mesa of Narsis, serving as the administrative heart of House Hlaalu. The Measurehall is the center of House business across the province, where the most senior Hlaalu councilors conduct affairs of governance. The towering manor of the Second Hlaalu Family stands as the district's most prominent residence, traditionally housing the Grandmaster of the House. The Imperial Consulate maintains a presence here, reflecting the accommodation between Hlaalu and the Empire. The Eight-Bones Temple, crowned by a dome enshrining Muatra, the legendary spear of Vivec, serves the faithful. The Narsis Arena offers public spectacles including duels and sports, while the Hlaalu Theater provides more refined entertainment. Stairways link the Council Quarter to the surrounding city districts below.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Council Quarter is.

title: Narsis Foreign Quarter
topic_desc: The Foreign Quarter is one of six districts of Narsis, the great House Hlaalu seat in the Shipal-Shin region. It comprises the southern section of the city and serves as the primary locus of outlander commerce and Imperial administration. Before the Armistice, outlander merchants were permitted to trade only on the south flat, then flooded farmland worked by slaves. The shack town that grew there was gradually built into the city proper over the centuries. The quarter hosts outposts of the Mages Guild and Fighters Guild, the Census and Excise Office, and Heron Hall, the Imperial Legion's city headquarters. An Imperial Cult chapel dedicated to Zenithar stands nearby. The Purple Road terminates here, and the district is connected to other neighborhoods by gondolier and to Hlerynhul by silt strider. Local Dunmer trade halls also remain established in the quarter.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Foreign Quarter is.

title: Narsis Guild of Fighters
topic_desc: The Narsis chapter of the Fighters Guild maintains its hall in a large domed building situated just past the southern bridge within the city of Narsis. As one of the guild's regional branches, it provides the customary services of a Fighters Guild chapter: training in martial disciplines, a smithy, and contract postings for bounty work, pest control, and guard duty. The chapter's membership spans ranks from Associate to Master, reflecting a typical hierarchy of journeymen, warders, champions, and defenders under a chapter master. Its presence in Narsis underscores the reach of Imperial professional guilds into Hlaalu-held territories, though the chapter navigates the political tensions inherent in operating alongside Great House interests. The hall serves both local residents seeking hired arms and guild members pursuing advancement through contracted work.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Guild of Fighters is.

title: Narsis Market Quarter
topic_desc: The Market Quarter is one of six districts comprising Narsis, situated in the city's northwest. Bounded by a canal to the east and the Thirr River to the south, it lies along the Imperial Purple Road, which enters through Canyon Keep from Shipal-Shin. Originally an informal day-market for caravaners and local farmers, the district expanded into a full commercial hub following the Armistice. Its centerpiece is the Grand Bazaar, a large building housing numerous vendors and the Merchant's Purse cornerclub. The quarter also hosts the Mesa Exchange, a joint Hlaalu Council Company and Imperial innovation allowing stock trading; the nearby manor of House Hlaalu's Sixth Family; a sizable Slave Market supporting local farms; and the Shrine of the Hidden Saints, serving poorer congregants. Services range from alchemists and blacksmiths to enchanters and booksellers, with commerce even extending into the sewers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Market Quarter is.

title: Narsis Old Quarter
topic_desc: The Old Quarter is the oldest continuously inhabited part of Narsis and the smallest of the city's six districts in area. It lies in the eastern section of the city and is primarily residential. The Guide to Narsis describes it as essentially a road situated between the Council and Foreign Quarters, with its westernmost extent reaching the First Family Manor and its northernmost extent falling somewhere before the Seventh Family Manor. Stairs connect the Foreign Quarter below to the Council Quarter above, with the Old Quarter's street running between them; the street's northern terminus bends toward the Waterfront. Some discrepancy exists between the guidebook's description and the actual district boundaries as mapped on the ground, particularly regarding whether the Imperial Consulate building falls within the quarter. Narsis itself sits in the Shipal-Shin region and aligns with House Hlaalu.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Old Quarter is.

title: Narsis Sewers
topic_desc: The sewers of Narsis form a subterranean network beneath the great Hlaalu city situated in the Shipal-Shin region of Morrowind. They connect to several surface districts, including the Foreign Quarter, and encompass named passages such as the Haunted Drainway. As one of several underground systems serving the city—alongside the catacombs—the sewers function as drainage infrastructure for one of House Hlaalu's principal urban centers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Sewers is.

title: Narsis St. Veloth Quarter
topic_desc: The St. Veloth Quarter, sometimes called St. Veloth's Square, is one of the six districts of Narsis, lying directly north of the Council Quarter. As the city's third-oldest and poorest district, it houses much of Narsis's working class. Two large apartment buildings—Brevur Heights and The Velothi Tower, the latter owned by Great House Hlaalu's Second Family—dominate the area. Industry guildhalls for miners, tanners, tailors, dyers, and cat catchers operate here, while a destitute group known as the Beggar Tong resides in the sewers below. The Camonna Tong exerts heavy influence over the quarter, collecting rent from Brevur Heights and frequenting local cornerclubs. A concealed Morag Tong guildhall also enshrouds the district. The quarter connects to the Waterfront in the east and the Market Quarter to the west, but lacks direct stair access to the adjacent wealthy Council Quarter.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis St. Veloth Quarter is.

title: Narsis Waterfront
topic_desc: The Waterfront is the eastern district of Narsis, built against the cliffs of the Council Quarter along the Thirr River. Constructed at great expense by House Hlaalu, the port hosts ships from across the provinces. The district serves as the city's fishing hub, containing the Shipbuilders and Sailors Hall and the St. Veloth Fishery. The Fortuna, a casino and hotel, sits atop the cliffs, while East Empire Company offices operate by the port. The manor of the Seventh Family of House Hlaalu, led by Patriarch Belron Hlaalu, is also situated here. The quarter borders the Foreign and Old Quarters to the south, the St. Veloth Quarter to the west, and connects to the Council Quarter at its higher reaches. Gondolas and docked vessels provide river transport.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Narsis Waterfront is.

title: Naru Ouradas' Shack
topic_desc: Naru Ouradas' Shack is a modest dwelling in the Roth Roryn region, situated northeast of the settlement of Omaynis. It serves as the home of Naru Ouradas, a Dark Elf fisherman.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Naru Ouradas' Shack is.

title: Nasinammu
topic_desc: Nasinammu is a cavern in the Armun Ashlands, situated in the hills behind the southern side of the Dwemer ruin of Barzamthuand. The cave is occupied by Dunmer bandits who have discovered a means to turn the Dwemer automata of the adjacent ruin against intruders, making any descent into the cavern hazardous. A cave-in blocks direct access from Nasinammu into the main interior of Barzamthuand, though some of the ruin's flooded lower tunnels remain traversable. Aside from Dwarven armor worn by the bandits and the contents of Dwemer barrels, the cavern holds little of value.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nasinammu is.

title: Nassudan
topic_desc: Nassudan is a small Velothi tower on the peninsula northwest of Firewatch in the Dagon Urul region. Formerly inhabited by the necromancer Thalis Rervil, the ruin is now plagued by lingering undead. Following Rervil's death, a Fighters Guild operative dispatched to confront the necromancer became trapped within the entryway. Master alchemical apparatus remains on the top floor, and locked research cells require a dedicated key to access.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nassudan is.

title: Nassurdanami
topic_desc: Nassurdanami is a small, isolated cave in the Mephalan Vales. Shielded by rugged terrain and natural rock arches near the coast, it serves as the den of a Breton necromancer who keeps a stock of ingredients, potions, and books, including rare samples of human flesh. The cavern is occupied by the necromancer's undead creations.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nassurdanami is.

title: Nav Andaram
topic_desc: Nav Andaram is a tiny settlement situated on the shores of Lake Andaram within the Aanthirin region. Presently, the outpost consists of only two modest shacks housing a handful of Dark Elf commoners. Despite its current minimal footprint, the site is intended for major development by House Hlaalu, with plans to expand the outpost into a significant settlement, though these ambitions remain unrealized. The location can be reached by following the road south from Velonith.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nav Andaram is.

title: Nchal-Marschend
topic_desc: Nchal-Marschend is a Dwemer ruin built upon a substantial gold ore motherlode in the hills overlooking Veloth's Path, where the road runs east out of the Aanthirin region. Its tower rises prominently against the sky. The site was initially constructed as an outlying refinery of Bamz-Amschend. A considerable number of Dwemer constructs ward the upper halls against intruders. In the aurous caverns below, where the gold ore remains, hungering rats mingle with hostile automata.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nchal-Marschend is.

title: Nchazdrumn
topic_desc: Nchazdrumn is a substantial Dwemer ruin in the Sunad Mora region, dominating the surrounding landscape near Baldrahn. Above ground, it features a massive central tower linked by a great bridge to the remains of two smaller towers; the blackened ground near these ruined towers suggests a catastrophic fire or explosion in the distant past. The complex consists of six interior zones—Chasm's Head, Halls of Rest, Harvest Caverns, Land's Blood Depths, Roasting Hall, and Stone Gnaw Gallery—serving as an integrated industrial facility. Stone was extracted in the Harvest Caverns, crushed in the Stone Gnaw Gallery, and heated to extract minerals in the Roasting Hall. A colossal boiler submerged in lava within the Land's Blood Depths supplied steam power to the machinery above. The site remains heavily guarded by active Dwemer constructs.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nchazdrumn is.

title: Nchulark
topic_desc: Nchulark is a Dwemer ruin situated in the Sunad Mora region, southwest of Ranyon-ruhn. The site is distinguished by an unusually large concentration of operational Dwemer constructs, with numerous animunculi still actively patrolling the halls. These guardians protect typical Dwemer artifacts and provisions, including sealed chests of notable quality. The ruin's interior consists of a single excavated zone. The remains of a Breton knight, Magus Perdé, lie within the site, suggesting a prior expedition ended in failure. As with many such sites, the original Dwemer purpose of Nchulark remains obscure, though the robust construct presence implies the facility held some significance to its builders.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nchulark is.

title: Nchulegfth
topic_desc: Nchulegfth is a Dwemer ruin situated in the Mephalan Vales. The site comprises three distinct sections: the Caves, the Hall of Bthuchend, and the Broken Passages. Like many extant Dwemer strongholds, Nchulegfth retains functioning architectural elements and still-active Dwemer automatons that guard its halls. The ruin's structural division suggests a complex that once served significant industrial or habitation purposes before its abandonment, with the Broken Passages indicating severe structural collapse over the millennia. Its remote location leaves it susceptible to occupation by smugglers seeking shelter in the outer caves.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nchulegfth is.

title: Nebet Bay
topic_desc: Nebet Bay is a large expanse of water separating the Nebet Peninsula from the Ouadavohr region of mainland Sunad Mora. The city of Llothanis dominates the southern reaches of the bay, while the northern portion is characterized by a placid lake, fed by a waterfall descending from the northeastern hills. To the south, the bay opens into the broader Sea of Ghosts.
topic_desc_basic: Nebet Bay is a large body of water separating the Nebet Peninsula from the Ouadavohr area of mainland Sunad Mora. The city of Llothanis dominates its southern portion, and it opens into the Sea of Ghosts to the south.

title: Nebet Peninsula
topic_desc: The Nebet Peninsula is the promontory situated east of Llothanis and Nebet Bay. It occupies the mainland area closest to Vahn Isle, the largest of the Telvanni Isles, lying between the Ouadavohr region of Sunad Mora and the Sea of Ghosts. The peninsula's rugged Sunad Mora coast contains several secluded caves and tombs, including Maelasi Cavern, the conjurer's abode of Mansutarmus, and the Relvenim Ancestral Tomb. The more notorious Adadpaliki serves as a haven for vampires devoted to Molag Bal, while Astius Claenia's Hideout lies hidden in the Sunad Mora northeast of Llothanis.
topic_desc_basic: The Nebet Peninsula is a promontory east of Llothanis and Nebet Bay. It lies between the Ouadavohr area of Sunad Mora and the Sea of Ghosts, and forms the mainland closest to Vahn Isle.

title: Nebulud
topic_desc: Nebulud is a sprawling cavern in the Aanthirin region, situated east of Old Ebonheart. The cave network intersects both an ancestral tomb and the lower chambers of the Dwemer ruin Bthung. A bandit presence occupies the upper passages, where slaves are held confined. The tomb section, sealed behind a secure locked door, is guarded by undead and contains burial offerings including notable enchanted armaments. The adjoining Dwemer chambers conceal mechanized guardians and hidden caches of Dwemer weaponry and armor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nebulud is.

title: Nedothril
topic_desc: Nedothril is a coastal grassland region within the Mournhold District of Morrowind. Its former forests have long been cleared to accommodate Indoril industry, leaving a landscape dotted with fields and towns. Bordered by the Padomaic Ocean to the east, the Sacred Lands and Mephalan Vales to the north, and Lan Orethan to the west, the region's shores see ships traveling the Padomaic. The populace is industrious but inwardly focused; while their goods are transported far and wide, outside influences have had little impact on them. Its largest settlements are the secluded Indoril community of Enamor Dayn, which offers a ferry service to the island town of Gorne, and the coastal hamlet of Seitur.
topic_desc_basic: Nedothril is a coastal grassland region in the Mournhold District of Morrowind. Its former forests were cleared for Indoril industry, and it borders the Padomaic Ocean to the east. Its largest settlements are the port of Enamor Dayn and the island town of Gorne.

title: Neidweisra Peninsula
topic_desc: The Neidweisra Peninsula is a large landmass extending northwest from the eastern arm of mainland Morrowind into the Sea of Ghosts. It projects so far seaward that its tip lies due north of Vos on Vvardenfell, placing portions of the peninsula west of many Vvardenfell locations. Together with the Dolmolag Peninsula, it forms the shores of Noloubal Bay.
topic_desc_basic: The Neidweisra Peninsula is a large landmass jutting northwest from mainland Morrowind into the Sea of Ghosts. It extends so far that its tip lies due north of Vos on Vvardenfell. Along with the Dolmolag Peninsula, it bounds Noloubal Bay.

title: Neleni-Shalsar Egg Mine
topic_desc: Neleni-Shalsar Egg Mine is a Redoran-run kwama egg mine situated high in the Velothi Mountains. Its tunnels exhibit exposed Dwemer architectural elements within the queen's chamber, suggesting the rear of the mine borders the subterranean labyrinth of the nearby Dwemer ruin of Ngelfltingth. The mine is inhabited by kwama and worked by Dunmer miners.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Neleni-Shalsar Egg Mine is.

title: Nelyn Fathis' Shack
topic_desc: Nelyn Fathis' shack is a solitary dwelling situated in the hills east of the settlement of Evos, within the Sacred Lands region. The structure serves as the home of Nelyn Fathis, a reclusive Dark Elf widely characterized by locals as a madman responsible for terrorizing the nearby populace. The interior is filled with Fathis' scrawled notes, and contains a broken-off piece of Daedric architecture, suggesting an obsessive or disturbed preoccupation with Daedric matters. The hermit typically remains outside the dwelling.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nelyn Fathis' Shack is.

title: Nerebys Mine
topic_desc: Nerebys Mine is an ebony mine situated near the northern edge of the Armun Ashlands, its entrance lying on the hill east of the Daedric ruin of Essarnartes. The mine's ebony deposits remain accessible among bubbling lava pools, though the site is currently infested by vampires, rendering any extraction extremely hazardous.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nerebys Mine is.

title: Nerendus Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Nerendus Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb located on an isolated island northeast of Port Telvannis within the Telvanni Isles region. The site consists of two Velothi domes, with the entrance housed in the dome closest to the mainland. Inside, the tomb is guarded by undead protectors. Offerings are arranged around the interior ash-pits, incorporating rare gemstones such as jet, amethyst, opal, amber, and moonstone. The upper level of one dome contains a labeled urn holding the Ashes of D. McRae, alongside which rests the unique Helm of the Creative.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nerendus Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Nerethi Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Nerethi Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Sacred Lands, hidden among the rocks northeast of Sailen. The tomb contains the remains of an acrobat known as Fillimir the Lightfooted, who apparently fell to his death while practicing his arts. His skeleton rests at the bottom of a deep pit near the final chamber, alongside his will, suggesting his presence was an inadvertent end rather than a formal burial. The tomb is otherwise occupied by undead.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nerethi Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Nerethril Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Nerethril Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer burial site located in the Aanthirin region, northwest of the Oran Plantation. Like many ancestral tombs, it serves as the resting place for the Nerethril lineage and is inhabited by undead guardians. The tomb contains an enchanted belt that fortifies the wearer's strength.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nerethril Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Neriath Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Neriath Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral burial site located in the Sacred Lands, situated south of the Causeway Tower and west of Necrom. The tomb is overgrown and isolated, with no visible path leading to its entrance. Like many such sites, it is haunted by undead guardians. The interior consists of multiple levels and features sealed chambers; a locked door on the lowest level secures chests containing interred valuables, accessible only through hidden keys placed on sarcophagi and within urns deeper within the tomb. Among the burial goods is a soul gem containing the trapped spirit of a kagouti.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Neriath Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Nethil Farmhouse
topic_desc: Nethil Farmhouse is a small agricultural settlement situated in the Alt Orethan region. The farm cultivates comberry, corkbulb, and meadow rye. It is associated with House Indoril, serving as the home for Salvura and Theril Nethil, both Indoril Accorders.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nethil Farmhouse is.

title: Nethre-Pulu Egg Mine
topic_desc: Nethre-Pulu Egg Mine is a medium-sized kwama egg mine situated in the Telvanni Isles, along the road between Sadas Plantation and Port Telvannis. While geographically halfway between the two as the crow flies, the winding northern detour the road takes around the mountains places it much closer to the plantation by land. The site comprises four zones: the mine itself, an entrance shack, a miner's shack, and a storage shack. The mine is worked by Dunmer and Bosmer miners, some of whom hold rank within Great House Telvanni. The operation yields standard kwama eggs and little else of note, though the miners are known for their drinking habits.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nethre-Pulu Egg Mine is.

title: Nethril Plantation
topic_desc: Nethril Plantation is a comberry, corkbulb, and wickwheat plantation situated at the southern edge of the Mephalan Vales. The estate operates under the auspices of Great House Indoril, with its manor, chapel, guard tower, store room, and slave housing forming a self-sufficient Dunmer agricultural settlement. The Nethril family holds authority over the holding, maintaining their residence in the multi-story manor and its attached tower. A Tribunal Temple curate attends to the chapel, serving the spiritual needs of the Indoril Creedmen, Accorders, and commoners who reside there. The plantation's labor force consists of enslaved Argonians and Khajiit who work the surrounding fields.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nethril Plantation is.

title: Ngelfltingth
topic_desc: Ngelfltingth is a Dwemer ruin situated in the Velothi Mountains. The site is perched in a location that is only easily reached by levitation, rendering it highly inaccessible to common travelers. Its interior remains largely untouched, containing a larger than usual number of treasures scattered about, most commonly in the form of Dwemer weaponry and armor, raw ebony, and glass. The ruin's defenses consist of a few broken automata. A vampire of the Baluath clan, Sathram Volos, currently resides within the tower, having amassed additional valuables in his chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ngelfltingth is.

title: Nibabi
topic_desc: Nibabi is a cave in the Shipal-Shin region serving as a secure storehouse for the Hunzhi clan's raided treasures. Located a short distance northwest of Hunzhi Camp, the cave holds accumulated goods and captive slaves. It is guarded and managed by members of the Shinathi, including clanholders, smugglers, and warriors, reflecting the Ashlander clan's reliance on raiding to acquire wealth and labor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nibabi is.

title: Niben's Wind
topic_desc: Niben's Wind is an East Empire Company cargo vessel currently moored at the docks of Old Ebonheart in the Aanthirin region. Under the command of Captain Parulius Francius, the ship transports typical Morrowind foodstuffs as its primary cargo. The vessel is crewed by Company sailors and operates as a standard merchantman within Imperial trade routes. Its holds and cabin accommodate the crew and any passengers securing passage across the Inner Sea.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Niben's Wind is.

title: Nidipal Grotto
topic_desc: Nidipal Grotto is a submerged cavern situated in the Coronati Basin, resting in the shadow of Hlerynhul's bridge. It is known to harbor slaughterfish within its waters. The grotto is one of the theorized resting places of the Benthic Mail, though its actual treasures are limited to pearls. Accounts placing the artifact here remain unverified.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nidipal Grotto is.

title: Nilvendu Farmhouse
topic_desc: Nilvendu Farmhouse is a small agricultural homestead situated in the Nedothril region of mainland Morrowind. The dwelling is occupied by Soris Nilvendu, a Dunmer hunter. The property reflects the scattered, rural settlement patterns common to the broader Morrowind countryside, where isolated farmsteads sustain themselves through modest cultivation and local game.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nilvendu Farmhouse is.

title: Nim
topic_desc: Nim is a Velothi tower situated in a remote portion of the Coronati Basin. It serves as the secluded retreat of a reclusive master alchemist. The tower's mistress maintains a substantial guard force to repel intruders, reflecting both her antisocial disposition and the value of her research. Within the tower, she conducts advanced alchemical work, and the site holds her magnum opus, a valuable tome of alchemical knowledge. A captive Nord is also held within the complex.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nim is.

title: Nimmutnabanit
topic_desc: Nimmutnabanit is a cave situated in the Boethiah's Spine region. The site is known to harbor undead occupants, suggesting a history of death or burial within its confines. Its remote location in the rugged eastern highlands renders it a site of potential danger for travelers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nimmutnabanit is.

title: Ninabi
topic_desc: Ninabi is a large kwama nest situated in the Coronati Basin region of Morrowind mainland. The cavern entrance lies just north of Sarys Plantation and is marked by a pool of green kwama acid. The nest is rich in kwama eggs, though it holds little else of material value. Kwama nests such as this are a common feature of the Morrowind interior, worked by miners and egg miners who harvest the eggs as a staple foodstuff and trade good.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ninabi is.

title: Ninnimilk
topic_desc: Ninnimilk is a small cavern situated in the hills west of Arvud, within the Armun Ashlands. The cave serves as a refuge for outlaws, housing a group of Dunmer bandits who store their goods within its chambers. Its elevated position renders conventional foot travel from Arvud's northern entrance difficult without levitation, though a lengthy, winding path connecting eastward from Ushu-Kur Mine provides an alternative ground route. Beyond its role as a shelter for its occupants and their contraband, the cavern holds no noted historical or cultural significance.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ninnimilk is.

title: Ninurtamul
topic_desc: Ninurtamul is a cavern situated at the mouth of the Pryai River within the Roth Roryn region. The cave currently serves as a refuge for members of the Camonna Tong. Beyond this occupation, the cavern holds no notable treasures or distinctive features.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ninurtamul is.

title: Nirmissin
topic_desc: Nirmissin is a cave located in the Sundered Scar region, distinguished by bloatspore growths throughout its passages. The cavern is largely flooded and devoid of living inhabitants. A solitary skeleton rests in a chamber at the western end of the cave, bearing an enchanted artifact known as the Bloat-staff, which fortifies the wielder's intelligence and willpower while draining their magicka.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nirmissin is.

title: Nirnidan
topic_desc: Nirnidan is a small cave situated west of Ashushushi in the Mephalan Vales. The initial cavern is unremarkable, but it provides access to an unnamed Ancestral Tomb complex. The site is inhabited by aggressive wildlife in the upper reaches and undead guardians within the lower burial chambers. A significant vertical drop connects the cave to the deeper tomb area, which remains obscured on local maps. The lower tomb contains a unique funerary urn that consistently holds a Scroll of Almsivi Intervention, providing a reliable means of magical egress for those unable to ascend the drop.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nirnidan is.

title: Nirthfly
topic_desc: The Nirthfly is a cargo vessel currently docked at the quay in Nivalis. It is a multi-decked ship with an upper level carrying provisions including drinks, food, and kwama eggs, a lower deck with additional cargo, and a cabin. The vessel's captain is Marthas Dervenni, a Dunmer sailor who maintains a friendship with Galan Brandt, head of the Fighters Guild in Firewatch. The Nirthfly is preparing for a voyage to Anvil, transporting goods on Brandt's behalf. The ship's cabin contains a copy of the relatively rare book Bitter Heart. The Nirthfly represents a working merchant vessel of the kind that plies the routes between Morrowind's eastern ports and Cyrodiil's western coast.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nirthfly is.

title: Nissut Mine
topic_desc: Nissut Mine is a sapphire mine located off the Purple Road in the Shipal-Shin region. Though originally established for mineral extraction, the site currently serves as a fortified outlaw encampment. A wooden palisade guards the entrance, reflecting the bandits' defensive control over the former excavation site. The interior features elevated platforms and shelters adapted for the group's use. The mine's sapphire veins remain present but are no longer its primary function under its current occupants.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nissut Mine is.

title: Nivalis
topic_desc: Nivalis is an Imperial settlement on the isle of Althoa in the Sea of Ghosts, enclosed by strong walls and dominated by the fortress of Icebreaker Keep to the east. The keep was constructed by the Imperial Navy in anticipation of an Akaviri counterattack following Uriel V's invasion of Akavir; Nivalis likely sprang up subsequently to serve the garrison. Icebreaker Keep remains an active naval stronghold commanded by a Navy commander, with Imperial vessels such as TEM Ghostrunner docking at its harbor. The town supports a Mages Guild outpost offering guild guide travel, boat services connecting to Bahrammu, Bal Oyra, Dagon Fel, and Firewatch, two blacksmiths, a trade store, and The Black Ogre Tavern. The Daedric ruin of Yamandalkal lies along the coast to the southeast.
topic_desc_basic: Nivalis is a walled Imperial settlement on the isle of Althoa in the Sea of Ghosts. It serves the Imperial Navy's Icebreaker Keep fortress and offers boat and Mages Guild guide transport.

title: Noloubal Bay
topic_desc: Noloubal Bay is a large body of water situated north of the eastern arm of the Morrowind mainland. Its western shore is formed by the Nedweisra Peninsula, while the Dolmolag Peninsula defines its eastern edge. The isle of Althoa lies to the north of the bay.
topic_desc_basic: Noloubal Bay is a large body of water north of the eastern arm of the Morrowind mainland, situated between the Nedweisra and Dolmolag peninsulas.

title: Noran Grotto
topic_desc: Noran Grotto is a desolate, medium-sized bone grotto situated on the Nedothril coast, south of Enamor Dayn. The cave's walls bear the rare bone texture more commonly associated with Sixth House sites, though it holds no confirmed cultish significance. The interior is primarily flooded and inhabited by slaughterfish, offering little of material value. Scavengers might find a small number of pearls within the resident kollop beds, though the meager yield rarely justifies the expense of water-breathing provisions required for safe exploration.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Noran Grotto is.

title: Norem
topic_desc: Norem is a large Velothi tower situated in the Mephalan Vales. The structure comprises five distinct sections: an ancestral tomb, a camp, an interior, a lair, and a sanctuary. It is currently the site of an ongoing conflict between bandits and vampires, rendering the tower highly dangerous. The presence of the undead alongside these factions suggests the site has long been abandoned by its original inhabitants. The tower's former name was Merdekhes Noirim.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Norem is.

title: Northern Wind
topic_desc: The Northern Wind is a vessel moored in the Sea of Ghosts, southeast of Bal Oyra and above the sunken ruin of Manrizache. It serves as the floating headquarters for an Imperial Archaeological Society expedition investigating the underwater site. The ship's hold and cabin store substantial provisions, including a large quantity of alcohol such as Cyrodiilic and vintage brandy, historical texts, Dwemer curiosities, and crates of weapons and armor. The expedition's personnel, comprising diggers, assistants, a historian, a cook, and a senior excavator, live and work aboard the ship while overseeing the excavation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Northern Wind is.

title: Num-Ittu Mine
topic_desc: Num-Ittu Mine is a small East Empire Company sapphire mine in Shipal-Shin, east of Stormgate Pass. Its dense sapphire veins are worked by miners under Imperial oversight.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Num-Ittu Mine is.

title: Number Rooms Temple
topic_desc: The Number Rooms Temple is a Tribunal Temple monastery and pilgrimage site in the Shipal-Shin region, situated at the source of the Thirr River. Originally constructed to venerate the Philosopher's Armor, the complex later became a destination for the faithful to view the Bug Shield of Vivec, which rests at its top level under Buoyant Armiger guard. Pilgrims may receive a blessing at the Shrine of the River's Source by reciting Lord Vivec's message to his enemies. True to its name, the temple features numerous numbered subterranean chambers serving as waistworks and living quarters. Deep within, behind locked doors, a school of mystics led by the High Theologian meditates in seclusion alongside the Philosopher's Armor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Number Rooms Temple is.

title: Nunalabbi
topic_desc: Nunalabbi is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Malacath, situated on the southern fringe of the Othreleth Woods. The ruins are sheltered by a cliff wall of the nearby Shipal-Shin region, lying southwest of Hlerynhul. The site comprises two zones: an Outer Shrine and an Inner Shrine. Orcish cultists and Daedra occupy the grounds, and the Inner Shrine houses a statue beneath which notable armaments are kept. The shrine's remote, cliff-shielded setting reflects the reclusive character of Malacath's following in Morrowind.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nunalabbi is.

title: Nurgal
topic_desc: Nurgal is a large, waterlogged cavern in the Armun Ashlands, concealed behind a waterfall. Within lies a small settlement of shacks housing a secretive community of recluses—Dark Elves and an Argonian—who subsist by fishing the cavern waters. Ornada insects inhabit the cave's otherwise empty passages. The cavern's entrance is reached by traveling south from Menaan in Roth Roryn, past the Grey Lodge into the ashlands, then branching southeast where the road bends west. The community's origins and purpose remain obscure; the residents appear to have chosen isolation deliberately, dwelling in a cavern noted for its stark beauty despite the harsh ashland terrain surrounding it.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nurgal is.

title: Nurshadit
topic_desc: Nurshadit is a necromancer's cavern situated in the Armun Ashlands. The cave serves as the lair of Visthina the Half-Lich, a Dunmer necromancer who has raised hostile skeletons to guard the interior. Despite the undead presence, Visthina herself remains non-aggressive toward visitors. The cavern itself holds little of material value. A hostile Dunmer barbarian camps near the entrance, posing a threat to those approaching the site.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Nurshadit is.

title: Obainat Camp
topic_desc: Obainat Camp is an Ashlander encampment in the Roth Roryn region, southeast of Savrethi Distillery. It is the settlement of the Obainat, a recently formed tribe assembled by Ashkhan Asha-tara Undunbael from remnants of several clans—Adairenat, Damanu, Harambub, and Yeshorbat—displaced or nearly extinguished by expanding House Hlaalu settlement. The tribe currently lacks ancestors, a deficiency that undermines its cohesion and legitimacy. Divisions run through the camp: some members favor caution toward the neighboring Hlaalu, while others, led by Massur-Dan, advocate aggressive resistance. Wise-woman Musa Ashadallit counsels prudence. The Obainat's future as a viable tribe remains uncertain, shaped by internal disputes over identity and the pressure of Hlaalu encroachment on their lands.
topic_desc_basic: Obainat Camp is an Ashlander encampment in the Roth Roryn region, southeast of Savrethi Distillery. It houses the Obainat, a newly formed tribe drawn from remnants of several displaced clans.

title: Oda-Nammu Grotto
topic_desc: Oda-Nammu Grotto is a submerged cavern situated in the Sea of Ghosts, off the northern coast near Tel Ouada. It lies on the southern edge of an island within a small archipelago, positioned south of the region's largest island. The flooded interior is inhabited by typical sea creatures and features a modest amount of sunken treasure. Among the submerged finds is a drowned corpse bearing a netch leather helm, a bonemold shield, a cheap potion of swift swim, and a bottle of skooma. The grotto's fauna includes kollops—only one of which may yield a pearl—and three eyestars.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Oda-Nammu Grotto is.

title: Odimasadra
topic_desc: Odimasadra is a large cave in the Sunad Mora region, built into a range of hills northeast of Firewatch. It lies almost directly east of Koranyon. The cave is known to harbor Daedra, including daedroth. Within its passages rest the remains of a mage, alongside a copy of a text on Mysticism and an exclusive spell absorption potion. A golden dagger is embedded in a mushroom near the entrance, reachable only by levitation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Odimasadra is.

title: Odirnamus
topic_desc: Odirnamus is a cave in the Coronati Basin, west of the Velothi tower of Nim and southwest of Hlan Oek. Bandits operating from the encampment within have preyed upon pilgrims traveling nearby roads, taking captives. A journal found in the cave references payment for live prisoners by an unidentified signee using the initials A.P.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Odirnamus is.

title: Ogroth
topic_desc: Ogroth is a kobold-infested cavern in the Velothi Mountains, situated on a rocky plateau south of the Pryai River's highest waterfall. Accessible by no established path, it harbors murderous kobolds that have slain several adventurers, evidenced by remains within the cave. The site's primary significance lies in its western reaches, where Daedric architecture emerges. Since no known Daedric shrine exists in this section of the mountains, the structure suggests a long-buried, inaccessible shrine adjacent to the cavern. The presence of an ogrim and references to Malauch strongly imply the ruin is dedicated to Malacath.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ogroth is.

title: Ohimbi Mine
topic_desc: Ohimbi Mine is a topaz mine submerged beneath the waters of Lake Andaram in the Aanthirin region. Its entrance lies on the lakebed west of Paruddma's Maw. The interior is worked by Dreugh, some of which bear pickaxes, suggesting an organized extraction effort. The mine is notably rich in topaz, yielding abundant veins of the yellow gemstone, though its flooded depths and Dreugh presence make any harvesting endeavor a perilous undertaking.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ohimbi Mine is.

title: Ohishiran
topic_desc: Ohishiran is a medium-sized Velothi tower situated in the Molag Ruhn region of Morrowind. It is inhabited by a band of rogue Telvanni wizards who maintain a presence independent of the council seats at Sadrith Mora. The group is led by a young Altmer mage named Olcarya. The tower's interior is arranged across three antechambers preceding the main structure: an entry hall with a large planter, a slave holding area, and a storage room. The main tower itself contains a bookseller's quarters on the first floor and residential quarters above. A substantial collection of books is housed within. The inhabitants retain formal Great House Telvanni rank, and fellow house members are not attacked on approach, though outsiders are treated with hostility. The tower also holds Argonian slaves in its basement.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ohishiran is.

title: Okulanit
topic_desc: Okulanit is the burial site of an apparently extinct Ashlander tribe, situated in the Armun Ashlands a short distance southwest of Arvud. The cavern is divided into two sections: Klefki Burial and Anerut Burial. The Klefki Burial section contains the animated mummified remains of the tribe's dead, who rise to defend their grave goods. These goods include unique enchanted artifacts such as the Soul Dancer staff and a Ritualistic Chitin Dagger. Access to the deeper Anerut Burial is restricted by a magical barrier tied to the dagger. Within Anerut Burial, preserved corpses rest alongside valuable items, including a glass bracer, a Dreugh Shield, the enchanted Ring of the Okulanit, and the magical ebony bow Sanctum Seeker. The presence of such arms and armors indicates the substantial status held by the tribe's former members, now lost to time.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Okulanit is.

title: Old Dren Plantation
topic_desc: The Old Dren Plantation is a quiet agricultural estate situated on a cliff immediately southeast of Narsis in the Shipal-Shin region. Owned by the Dunmer noble Releniah Dren, the plantation ranches netches and cultivates Tanna and Hackle-Lo, relying on slave labor for its operations. Despite its unassuming status as a rural backwater, the holding commands significant political gravity through its owner: Releniah is the mother of both the Duke of Vvardenfell District and the kingpin of the Camonna Tong. The manor house oversees the surrounding fields and herds, staffed by Hlaalu retainers and agents alongside a Camonna Tong caretaker, reflecting the intertwined mercantile and underworld interests of the Dren family.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Old Dren Plantation is.

title: Olms Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Olms Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer burial site in the Aanthirin region, northeast of Aimrah and northwest of Gol Mok. It sits beneath an island watchtower. The tomb is divided into two zones: the main burial chambers and a sepulcher. Undead, including skeletons and ancestor guardians, ward the interior. The sepulcher houses the enshrined ashes of Saint Olms, accompanied by a large mural depicting the Tribunal. Saint Olms is venerated within Dunmer ancestral tradition, and the site constitutes a pilgrimage destination. The sepulcher's inner sanctum is secured behind a locked door associated with the Pilgrimage to the Tomb of Saint Olms. The tomb's construction reflects customary Dunmer funerary architecture, combining ancestral veneration with Tribunal-era devotional iconography.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Olms Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Olthan Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Olthan Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Roth Roryn region, west of Menaan. Like many such sites, it serves as a protected resting place for the honored dead of its founding family, and houses the undead guardians typical of these sealed necropolises. The tomb has recently drawn the attention of outlanders, reflecting a growing Imperial fascination with Dunmer funerary customs. The Olthan family maintains a connection to the site, as evidenced by the presence of the pilgrim Gilmaso Olthan. The tomb's accessibility from Menaan's roads, marked by signposts at a ridge junction, makes it unusually exposed to foreign visitors compared to more secluded ancestral vaults, creating cultural friction between traditional Dunmer reverence for the dead and Imperial curiosity.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Olthan Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Omathi Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Omathi Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Boethiah's Spine region, northwest of Andar Mok. The interior is distinguished by an unusual multi-tiered construction featuring pitfalls between levels designed to catch the unwary, alongside a dedicated ashpit. The tomb is inhabited by undead and a Nord warrior of the Quarra vampire bloodline named Njelfa. A Nickel Key rests within a skull embedded in the ashpit at the base of the pitfall.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Omathi Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Omaynis
topic_desc: Omaynis is a small House Hlaalu settlement in the Roth Roryn region, situated just east of the final stretch of the Pryai River. It formerly belonged to the Stones March, a House Redoran territory, and local Velothi townsfolk still claim many friends in Redoran lands. The settlement centers on its egg mine, which even houses the miners' tavern within its tunnels. The Hlaalu have recently begun paying miners in Company Scrip rather than gold, reducing the coin circulating in town. The wealthier upper district holds the governor's manor, while a statue of St. Felms stands on the southern edge above the settlement, a source of evident local pride. A smith and trader serve the eastern side of town. Silt strider services connect Omaynis to Bal Foyen and Bodrum.
topic_desc_basic: Omaynis is a small House Hlaalu settlement in the Roth Roryn region, east of the Pryai River. It was formerly part of the Stones March, a House Redoran territory. The town centers on its egg mine and is connected by silt strider to Bal Foyen and Bodrum.

title: Onimushili
topic_desc: Onimushili is a large Daedric ruin dedicated to Malacath, situated in the Dagon Urul region of mainland Morrowind. It lies roughly equidistant between the Imperial settlements of Helnim and Firewatch, a short distance northeast of the Dunmer stronghold of Mandaran. The ruin comprises two zones—an Outer Halls and an inner Shrine—and serves as an active place of worship for a community of Orc cultists devoted to the Daedric Lord. Clannfears and Ogrims inhabit the ruin alongside its worshippers. The inner Shrine houses a statue of Malacath before which offerings are laid. The site stands as one of the more prominent Malacath sanctuaries in the region, reflecting the enduring presence of Orcish Daedric veneration within mainland Morrowind's eastern territories.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Onimushili is.

title: Onosi Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Onosi Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Lan Orethan region of mainland Morrowind, south of Bosmora. It is a modest burial site of single construction. The tomb contains a Shrine of the Tribunal in its southern chamber, offering healing to the faithful. The northern chamber holds the remains of the dead, which restless undead may still inhabit. Like many ancestral tombs, it reflects the Dunmer practice of venerating forebears through maintained family burial sites, though its specific lineage is not widely recorded.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Onosi Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Oran Plantation
topic_desc: Oran Plantation is a large comberry plantation in the Aanthirin region, situated on the west side of the Thirr River. Owned by Atran Oran, a Council Elector of House Hlaalu, the estate comprises numerous agricultural fields, a walled main complex with a manor, several outlying buildings, and a highly secure underground vault. The plantation relies extensively on slave labor for its comberry harvest. The surrounding area includes the Indoril chapel ruin of Tur Julan to the west and the Uttumilk cave to the southwest.
topic_desc_basic: Oran Plantation is a large comberry plantation in the Aanthirin region, situated on the west side of the Thirr River. It is owned by Atran Oran of House Hlaalu.

title: Orando Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Orando Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Aanthirin region, southeast of Roa Dyr along the road running west of Vhul. The tomb features a single main chamber secured by a heavily locked and trapped door. Inside, three undead guardians stand watch over the interred. A Shrine to St. Olms and a copy of the Gospel of St. Olms are present within, reflecting veneration of that Tribunal saint. Sarcophagi in the chamber hold peridot and amethyst, and an Indoril helmet of notable value rests at the far end of the room.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Orando Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Orelu Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Orelu Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the mangroves west of Sadrathim, within the Coronati Basin. Its entrance lies in the northern portion of these swamps. Like many such sites, the crypt has become infested with undead, and it presently serves as the nest of a formidable Swamp Troll, making the inner chambers hazardous to approach. Such defilement is a persistent concern for the faithful of the Tribunal Temple, who regard the sanctity of ancestral resting places as a sacred duty.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Orelu Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Orelu Plantation
topic_desc: Orelu Plantation is a corkbulb and saltrice agricultural settlement situated east of Tel Ouada in the Sunad Mora region. The site comprises three structures: Nifum Othril's house by the saltrice fields, Dels Famori's hut near the corkbulb crop, and a slave dwelling carved into the northern hillside. Two Dunmer farmers oversee the operation, relying on the labor of enslaved Khajiit who work the fields. The plantation's harsh conditions are evidenced by the recent escape of two slaves. The dwellings are sparsely furnished, containing only basic cooking utensils and stored food and ingredients.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Orelu Plantation is.

title: Oreyn Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Oreyn Ancestral Tomb is a sizeable Dunmer ancestral tomb located within the Othreleth Woods. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the dead of the Oreyn lineage and is guarded by undead protectors. A powerful undead guardian watches over the westernmost chamber, identified as a skeletal orc named Kharag gro-Khar. A sarcophagus behind this guardian holds Kharag's pauldrons, and a Glass Long Bow is also present in the same room.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Oreyn Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Orothri Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Orothri Ancestral Tomb is a sizeable Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Dagon Urul region, east of the Dunmer stronghold of Mandaran. The tomb houses the remains of Taldys Orothri, venerated as a saint by the Imperial Cult. Taldys's bones rest in the tomb's final chamber, interred alongside the sacred artifact known as the Sword of Taldeus. The interior is guarded by undead and contains hidden passages and chambers, including rooms with barred windows overlooking the main hall. Beyond the saintly relics, the tomb holds other valuable items, including an ebony dagger and a copy of the 36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 16.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Orothri Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Orphaned Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Orphaned Shipwreck is a sunken slaving vessel resting in the Inner Sea north of Old Ebonheart, within the Aanthirin region. The wreck comprises three compartments: a main deck area, a hold, and a captain's cabin. Shackles on the lower deck attest to the ship's former use in transporting slaves. The presence of Moon Sugar in the captain's cabin suggests involvement in smuggling or personal substance abuse by the crew. The remaining cargo consists largely of commonplace foodstuffs, alongside occasional bottles of flin and Cyrodiilic brandy.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Orphaned Shipwreck is.

title: Osotla
topic_desc: Osotla is a two-zone cave in the Shipal-Shin region serving as the Sand Kwoom breeding ground for the Shinathi's Ussiran clan. Tame Sand Kwoom and Ussiran herders occupy the interior. The entrance lies a short distance from Casimor, a Reman Empire-era ruin visible from the Purple Road between Septim's Gate Pass and Shipal-Sharai.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Osotla is.

title: Ossu
topic_desc: Ossu is a small cavern in the Lan Orethan region of mainland Morrowind, situated on a cliff overlooking a river west-southwest of Dreynim. The cave serves as the lair of a Vermai, an obscure Daedric creature, and is guarded by two Scamps. Beyond the presence of these Daedra, the cavern holds no notable contents, though the Vermai itself yields a valuable heart and skin.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ossu is.

title: Ossurnashalit
topic_desc: Ossurnashalit is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Molag Bal, located in the Roth Roryn region. The ruin is infested with Clannfear. Before the shrine's statue of the Daedric Prince lies an adamantium shortsword.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ossurnashalit is.

title: Othmura
topic_desc: Othmura is a House Hlaalu settlement situated along the banks of the northern tongue of Lake Coronati in the Coronati Basin, holding the distinction of being the region's northernmost settlement. Originally a small fishing village, it has grown into a thriving merchant town positioned overland between Hlerynhul and Narsis. Perched on a cliff overlooking a narrow passage of the Thirr River, the town consists of twisting roads ascending from the port uphill to Rethan Manor, the seat of its governor. The settlement provides local chapters of both the Mages Guild and the Tribunal Temple, alongside commercial services and lodgings at the High Wall Cornerclub. Ship services connect it to Ald Iuval, Hlerynhul, Sadrathim, and the Maar-Bani Crossing, while the Mages Guild offers teleportation to Narsis.
topic_desc_basic: Othmura is a House Hlaalu merchant town in the Coronati Basin, situated on the northern tongue of Lake Coronati along the overland route between Hlerynhul and Narsis. Perched on a cliff overlooking the Thirr River, it evolved from a fishing village into a thriving trade hub.

title: Othrano
topic_desc: Othrano is a Velothi stronghold half-buried in a hillside within the Coronati Basin. The ruin comprises six distinct sections: the Lower Level, North Dome, South Dome, Upper Level, Vault, and a Propylon Chamber. The propylon chamber retains a functional connection to Hlorandus. The stronghold's index is kept at Withering Murk in Forsaken Fathom. Currently, the complex serves as a lair for bandits and smugglers, with only the propylon chamber remaining unguarded.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Othrano is.

title: Otori
topic_desc: Otori is a small cave situated in the hills north of Helnim, within the Boethiah's Spine region. It currently serves as a hideout for a bandit group that has been harassing local Telvanni traders. The cave is occupied by a half-dozen bandits led by Lucrete Ponius, alongside various creatures and Daedra. Among the occupants is Demetrius Muntian, an Imperial scout known to offer training in martial disciplines. The bandits have accumulated a modest hoard of contraband, including potions, scrolls, alchemical apparatus, skooma, moon sugar, and a copy of the skill book A Game at Dinner.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Otori is.

title: Ouadavohr
topic_desc: The Ouadavohr is a region of low-lying ground situated within the larger Sunad Mora territory. It is encircled by Boethiah's Spine, a geographic formation created by the area's two major waterways: the Bosouada river and its tributary, the Sirouada. The Ouadavohr spans between the small Telvanni settlement of Ranyon-ruhn at its western end and the Telvanni town of Llothanis to the east. The surrounding river valleys define the area's boundaries and shape its terrain. Notable sites within and around the Ouadavohr include the Palisnabat glass mine, which connects to the Dwemer ruin of Archtumz, and Drenim Ancestral Tomb.
topic_desc_basic: The Ouadavohr is an area of low-lying ground in the Sunad Mora region, bordered by Boethiah's Spine and situated between the Telvanni settlements of Ranyon-ruhn and Llothanis.

title: Overrun Shipwreck
topic_desc: An unfortunate vessel beached upon the walls of Andarannipal in the Aanthirin region. Accessible by swimming southwest across Lake Andaram from Aimrah or walking east along the shoreline from the Maar-Bani Crossing, the wreck is divided into three zones: an upper level, a lower level, and a cabin. Rats infest the lower decks, while a Scamp has claimed the captain's cabin. A chest of gold at the wreck's lowest point constitutes its most notable remaining cargo.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Overrun Shipwreck is.

title: Pagondha Cave
topic_desc: Pagondha Cave is a goblin warren of the Iron Claw tribe situated in the Velothi Mountains, equidistant between the frozen ruin of Anashbibi and Mount Dunul. The entrance is marked by a goblin campfire and palisade, guarded by tribe members. Within, the cave forms a maze of tunnels housing approximately twenty goblins. In the lower depths, the tribe mines iron ore from several exposed veins. A goblin chieftain occupies the northwestern chamber higher up, where a Goblin Helm is also present.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pagondha Cave is.

title: Pahunsabi
topic_desc: Pahunsabi is a large, two-zone cave situated on the northern coast of the Sunad Mora region, along the eastern shore of the great bay between Firewatch and Bal Oyra. It operates as a well-defended bandit stronghold, currently hosting a considerable number of outlaws, including smugglers, warriors, and mages. The first zone centers around a main cavern and a northwestern chamber that holds a copy of the Short Blade skill book *Unnamed Book*. The deeper section, designated as the Bandit Base, serves as the primary encampment. While the cave contains substantial quantities of general loot, the accumulated plunder is unremarkable in quality.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pahunsabi is.

title: Palamat Mine
topic_desc: Palamat Mine is a disused sapphire mine in the Shipal-Shin region, situated at the bottom of a canyon south of the Velothi tower of Uddanu. The upper workings are infested with skeletal undead. The Depths below harbor a band of necromancers who have claimed the abandoned tunnels for their own purposes. The mine once yielded sapphire from five ore veins before falling into disuse. Its remote canyon location and subterranean layout make it a natural refuge for those practicing the black arts away from settled authority. The necromancers occupying the Depths include practitioners of varied backgrounds drawn to the site's isolation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Palamat Mine is.

title: Palisnabat
topic_desc: Palisnabat is a small glass mine situated in the Sunad Mora region, southeast of Ranyon-ruhn. Seven veins of raw glass are worked within its tunnels. Recent excavation in the southwest has unearthed an entrance to the Dwemer ruin of Archtumz, and crates of Dwemer artifacts have been stored in the eastern cave. An Imperial guard patrols the interior, enforcing restricted access, alongside a Breton mage named Niran Fancelle.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Palisnabat is.

title: Pamashibabua
topic_desc: Pamashibabua is a large cavern occupying a lonely island within the Boethiah's Spine region. The cave's interior holds the monumental stone head of a gigantic Boethiah statue. A Daedric Right Pauldron rests at the bottom of a pit beneath this head, positioned out of normal reach. The site is infested with Daedra. The island is situated east of Edhryn Farothran's Lighthouse and lies close to Endelius' Shack.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pamashibabua is.

title: Pamonibu Mine
topic_desc: Pamonibu Mine is an ebony mine situated in the Mephalan Vales. The site yields limited quantities of ebony, extracted from a small number of mineral veins. The operation is maintained by a workforce of Dunmer, Imperial, and Redguard miners, alongside stationed guards who secure the valuable extraction site. As an active ebony mine, it represents a locally significant source of one of Tamriel's most precious and durable materials.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pamonibu Mine is.

title: Pamuni Tunnel
topic_desc: Pamuni Tunnel is a cave situated in the Mephalan Vales region. It features distinct northern and southern entrances, functioning as a passage through the terrain. The tunnel is known to harbor Spider Daedra within its confines.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pamuni Tunnel is.

title: Pangoa
topic_desc: Pangoa is a diminutive yet fertile cavern situated in the Roth Roryn region. Despite its appealing environment, the cave holds little of note, serving primarily as a modest habitat for a solitary kwama forager. A small flooded chamber in the western depths conceals a cache of glass throwing stars.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pangoa is.

title: Pansaranit
topic_desc: Pansaranit is a medium-sized cave situated in the Sunad Mora region, just east of the settlement of Baldrahn. The cavern currently serves as a hold for slavers, who imprison three enslaved Argonian and Khajiit individuals within its depths. The cave interior contains a mine extending to its southwest corner. Little else of note distinguishes the site, though an Orcish halberd has been observed stored against the northernmost wall, and a unique written note rests on a table at the mine's bottom.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pansaranit is.

title: Panshurra
topic_desc: Panshurra is a cave in the Shipal-Shin region, situated high on the mesa northeast of Narsis across the Thirr River. Its lower entrance overlooks the city, accessible by a winding trail around the mesa's middle, while a higher entrance opens atop the mesa itself. The cavern serves as a hold for hostile Shinathi, who occupy its upper reaches. The lower portion harbors beasts and the ghost of a slain adventurer. Within the cave, two slaves and captured Sharai Hoppers are confined behind a palisade. Internal Shinathi correspondence reveals a dispute over who must deal with the restless ghost below.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Panshurra is.

title: Panudanit
topic_desc: Panudanit is a cavern in the Shipal-Shin region, situated northwest of Teloseras. The cave features two entrances: a lower opening at the base of a northern-leading canyon and a second opening atop the local mesa. A gang of Dunmer outlaws currently occupies the cavern, using it as a redoubt to store their takings. You do not know where Panudanit is.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Panudanit is.

title: Para-Ad Grotto
topic_desc: Para-Ad Grotto is a submerged cavern situated in the early stretches of the Thirr River, with its entrance lying in the riverbed opposite the Chimer stronghold of Hlorandar within the Coronati Basin. The grotto serves as the habitat for blind slaughterfish. A small number of kollops reside within its waters, occasionally yielding pearls to intrepid divers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Para-Ad Grotto is.

title: Paruddma
topic_desc: Paruddma is a freighter vessel currently moored at the docks of Aimrah in the Aanthirin region. The ship is captained by Obedur Marvus, a Dunmer. Both the hull and interior of the vessel are studded with barnacles, suggesting long service in maritime conditions. The crew are noted for their decidedly unfriendly disposition. The name itself draws local remark; some claim Captain Obedur named the ship after his deceased mother, though observers note it is not a recognized Dunmer name. The freighter comprises three areas: an upper deck, a captain's cabin, and a hold.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Paruddma is.

title: Paruddma's Maw
topic_desc: Paruddma's Maw is a sprawling dreugh citadel submerged in the depths of Lake Andaram within the Aanthirin region. The labyrinthine structure winds deep into the rock and is entirely devoid of breathable air, thronged by dreugh and blind slaughterfish. Its organic architecture is divided into distinct zones: the Bolus Vestible, Tower of Chyme, Solar Pylorus, Duodenum Passage, Jejunum Descent, and the Ileum Chamber. The Ileum Chamber serves as the seat of the dreugh queen Paruddma. The interior contains significant quantities of human remains, flesh, and food sacs, alongside notable treasures including Dwemer artifacts, raw glass, and the Scepter of Violation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Paruddma's Maw is.

title: Passu
topic_desc: Passu is a small cave situated in the Lan Orethan region, north of Bosmora. It historically served as a base for a group of Breton dragon hunters. The cavern contains numerous kwama eggs, which the hunters mistakenly identified as dragon eggs. The skeletal remains of these hunters are scattered throughout the cave, and the journal of their leader lies at the end of the main passage, documenting their fatal error.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Passu is.

title: Passur-Sur Lookout
topic_desc: Passur-Sur Lookout is a small Hlaalu watchtower situated in the Aanthirin region, southeast of Oran Plantation. It serves as the southernmost of five lookout towers guarding the western bank of the Thirr River. Officially, the tower exists to maintain control over the vast Hlaalu plantations in the area by watching for escaped slaves. However, its strategic position suggests likely military applications amid ongoing tensions between Great House Hlaalu and Great House Indoril over these territories, which were once governed by Indoril Llathsa from nearby Tur Julan.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Passur-Sur Lookout is.

title: Pedivur's Tower
topic_desc: Pedivur's Tower is an isolated dwelling situated on the edge of the Mephalan Vales in the Molag Ruhn region. It serves as the home and workplace of Pedivur, a Breton alchemist who offers his services to travelers venturing deeper into the Vales. The tower's remote location makes it a solitary waypoint in an otherwise sparsely inhabited and foreboding landscape.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pedivur's Tower is.

title: Pilnusibi Egg Mine
topic_desc: Pilnusibi Egg Mine is a kwama egg mine situated in the Nedothril region. The interior consists of a single worked zone containing numerous egg sacks and additional egg stores in crates and barrels, reflecting a modest but active yield. The mine is worked by Dunmer miners who harvest the kwama eggs. The nearest Almsivi Intervention point is Sailen, and the nearest Divine Intervention destination is Fort Umbermoth.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pilnusibi Egg Mine is.

title: Pimmu
topic_desc: Pimmu is a medium-sized cave situated in the Boethiah's Spine region, serving as a hideout for a smuggler gang. The interior is crammed with crates and barrels containing their illicit cargo. A southeastern chamber serves as the group's sleeping quarters and houses a significant portion of the hoard.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pimmu is.

title: Pinsaritus
topic_desc: Pinsaritus is a cave located in a remote stretch of the Shipal-Shin region. It serves as a lair for canyon threshers, aggressive apex predators that inhabit the cavern's depths alongside the remains of their victims. The cave holds little of material value, containing chiefly corpses and a negligible amount of gold ore. Its isolation within the harsh Velothi badlands makes it an uninviting and dangerous site, frequented only by the territorial beasts that dwell within.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pinsaritus is.

title: Piransulit
topic_desc: Piransulit is a Velothi tower situated in the Armun Ashlands, southeast of the caravan town of Arvud. The dome structure currently serves as a hideout for a small bandit gang. Inside, the tower retains remnants of its past utility alongside the outlaws' accumulated stores, including a stockpile of enchanted arrows and silver ingots in a storeroom near the entrance, adamantium bracers by a lower-level bedroll, and a copy of the Sneak skill book The Wolf Queen, Book VI on a bookshelf by the entry.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Piransulit is.

title: Pride of Narusia
topic_desc: The Pride of Narusia is a Great House Hlaalu vessel currently docked at the Old Ebonheart docks in the Aanthirin region. The ship operates as a slaver, carrying a cargo of enslaved Khajiit confined to its lower deck. Its crew includes Hlaalu hirelings and enforcers who maintain order and guard the human cargo. The Bosmer merchant Haladroth serves as the ship's captain, commanding from the cabin. The vessel is divided across three zones: the captain's cabin, the upper deck, and the lower deck.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pride of Narusia is.
aliases: Old Ebonheart, Pride of Narusia: Cabin
Old Ebonheart, Pride of Narusia: Upper Deck
Old Ebonheart, Pride of Narusia: Lower Deck

title: Pryai-Nur Egg Mine
topic_desc: Pryai-Nur is a Redoran kwama egg mine situated on the riverside south of Bodrum in the Roth Roryn region. The interior features the expected acid pools and kwama egg clusters, alongside raw ebony veins in two southeastern chambers. Unusually for such an operation, the mine includes an accompanying store offering a wide range of goods for trade, distinguishing it from typical mining outposts.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pryai-Nur Egg Mine is.

title: Pryai River
topic_desc: The Pryai River cascades from the icebound Velothi Mountains above the tower of Hasarund, descending the slopes in a series of waterfalls before winding through Roth Roryn. Its upper reaches feature green riverbanks, small cascades, and pools, while its lower course broadens across flattening terrain. The river passes under the high bridge at Bodrum, where a shrine marks the site of Vivec's defeat of a Reman Empire army; rusting legionary armor reportedly remains in the waters. Further along, the Pryai flows beneath a natural rock arch topped by the Monastery of St. Felms, which maintains an elevator for supply access. Nearing the Inner Sea, the river is joined by a hot-spring cascade south of Omaynis before emptying near Llaram Plantation.
topic_desc_basic: The Pryai River flows from the Velothi Mountains through Roth Roryn to the Inner Sea. It passes Bodrum, site of Vivec's victory over a Reman army, and the Monastery of St. Felms before emptying near Llaram Plantation.

title: Pulu-Asha Egg Mine
topic_desc: Pulu-Asha Egg Mine is a kwama egg mine situated in the Mephalan Vales region. Like other such operations across Morrowind, it functions as an industrial site for the harvesting of kwama eggs, a staple of the Dunmer diet and a valuable trade good. The mine relies on the natural symbiosis between the kwama and the miners who manage the colony's scrib, worker, and warrior castes to sustain production.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pulu-Asha Egg Mine is.

title: Pulummu Mine
topic_desc: Pulummu Mine is an empty mine situated in the Mephalan Vales region of Morrowind. Its tunnels presently shelter wild beasts. The settlement of Akamora and the Windmoth Legion Fort lie within the surrounding area.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pulummu Mine is.

title: Puman
topic_desc: Puman is a smugglers' cavern situated in the Armun Ashlands, southwest of Ishanuran Camp. It serves as a hideout for rogue elements, housing a group of Dunmer rogues who operate away from mainstream settlements. The cavern contains an array of smuggled goods typical of such illicit refuges. Its remote location in the harsh ashlands provides natural isolation for covert operations.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Puman is.

title: Punudir Lookout
topic_desc: Punudir Lookout is a House Hlaalu guard tower situated in the Coronati Basin, positioned along the main road approaching the city of Narsis. The outpost monitors the primary overland route into the settlement, accessible by following the road from the city's drawbridge. As a fortified Hlaalu installation, it serves to secure the immediate vicinity of one of the house's major urban centers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Punudir Lookout is.

title: Puramindi
topic_desc: Puramindi is a large kwama cave situated in the Shipal-Shin region, northwest of the settlement of Kaladryon. The cavern serves as a kwama nest, housing a queen and numerous egg deposits alongside a solitary Dunmer herder. The cave's tunnels hold the remains of an Argonian, accompanied by scattered adamantium armaments. A notable exposed sapphire vein in the eastern section of the cave yields precious gems. The entrance lies at the southern end of a canyon to Kaladryon's northwest.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Puramindi is.

title: Purple Road
topic_desc: The Purple Road is an Imperial highway running from Narsis to Septim's Gate Pass, continuing over the border through the Cyrodiilic city of Mir Corrup. Its western terminus lies in the town of Sedita, where it meets the Yellow Road. Trade along the route has declined in recent years, hampered by the deterioration of Mir Corrup, whose encroaching marshlands threaten the path. Within Morrowind, the road shows clear signs of disrepair at multiple points along its length.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Purple Road is.

title: Puzur-Attin Egg Mine
topic_desc: Puzur-Attin Egg Mine is a Redoran-run kwama egg mine situated southeast of Bodrum, near the banks of the Pryai River in the Roth Roryn region. Like other such operations, it relies on Dunmer and foreign miners to harvest kwama eggs. The mine's interior is unremarkable, offering little of notable distinction beyond its standard industrial function.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Puzur-Attin Egg Mine is.

title: Pyr-Ilu Lookout
topic_desc: Pyr-Ilu Lookout is a small Hlaalu tower in the Aanthirin region, situated north of Mundrethi Plantation on the western bank of the Thirr River. It is one of five lookouts guarding the stretch of the Thirr between Almas Thirr and Old Ebonheart. The stated purpose of these towers is to maintain control over the vast Hlaalu plantations along the western bank, though other military applications seem likely. The Thirr River is a source of tension between Great House Hlaalu and Great House Indoril, as much of the land these towers now guard was formerly governed by the Indoril Llathsa from their seat at nearby Tur Julan. The tower is garrisoned by Hlaalu guards under a Nord captain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Pyr-Ilu Lookout is.

title: Quadrille
topic_desc: The Quadrille is an East Empire Company vessel currently docked in Narsis, moored just outside the Company's local office. Commanded by Shipmaster Sandeire Cipius, the ship operates with a crew of Company sailors and dockworkers. The vessel is divided into a cabin and a hold; the latter contains locked chambers securing a number of Dwemer items, with the key kept on the shipmaster's desk.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Quadrille is.

title: Raal Grotto
