topic_desc: Raal Grotto is a coastal cave in the Roth Roryn region, situated on the banks of the Thirr estuary southwest of Gol Mok. Slaughterfish inhabit its waters, some confined within a fenced compound for unclear purposes. A pier at the cave's southeast holds a chest containing the enchanted Utu-Ihha's Dreugh Club, and a Dreugh Shield rests inside a cabin built over the water. The cabin is occupied by a hostile Bosmer hunter named Uurathor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Raal Grotto is.

title: Raathim Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Raathim Ancestral Tomb is the atypical burial site of the royal Raathim clan, buried beneath the Imperial metropolis of Old Ebonheart. It incorporates the remnants of the Dark Elven city of Khalaan, which predated the Armistice on the same site. The Lichgate features a blend of Imperial, Old Mournhold, and ancient Dunmer stronghold architecture. A partially intact propylon chamber connects to the buried strongholds of Romayon and Idaverrano. Access to the deeper Hall of Kings Past and Burial of the Empress is restricted by blood-sealed guardian magic, permitting only those of Raathim descent. The Raathim clan historically held the High Kingship of Morrowind and controlled the region's lucrative mines. The Hall of Kings Past holds the urn of King Moraelyn. The deepest chamber serves as the tomb of Empress Katariah, a Raathim who rose to rule Tamriel, bearing her death mask and the fateful arrow within her sarcophagus.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Raathim Ancestral Tomb is.
aliases: Raathim Ancestral Tomb, Burial of the Empress
Raathim Ancestral Tomb, Hall of Kings Past

title: Rabawia Grotto
topic_desc: Rabawia Grotto is a coastal cave in the Aanthirin region, situated west of Nav Andaram. Its entrance lies hidden within a deep underwater ravine. The submerged passages teem with kollops and slaughterfish, while the emergent interior chambers host numerous hostile mudcrabs, including a notably massive and aggressive specimen. The grotto also serves as the abode of the Dark Elf trader Alvur Omaril, who styles himself the King of the Lake. Scattered across the cave floor are various valuable goods, including raw gold and adamantium items, either constituting Omaril's trade stock or the remnants of his acquisitions.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rabawia Grotto is.

title: Radobar Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Radobar Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb of middling size located in the Aanthirin region, south of the settlement of Idathren. Like many such tombs, it houses the honored dead of a particular lineage alongside assorted grave goods. The tomb is guarded by undead, as is customary for Dunmer burial sites, where revenants serve as eternal wardens against desecration and grave robbery. The presence of ancestral undead reflects the deep-rooted Dunmer practice of venerating forebears and maintaining the sanctity of ancestral resting places. Radobar is unremarkable among the countless ancestral tombs scattered across Morrowind, serving as a typical example of the modest, family-held crypts that dot the countryside near settled areas.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Radobar Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Ralaal Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Ralaal Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Coronati Basin, its entrance situated within a small hillock west of the Daedric shrine of Naemunbatashpi. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Ralaal family and is teeming with undead guardians, a common feature of ancestral tombs intended to protect the interred remains from disturbance and desecration.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ralaal Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Ralit Egg Mine
topic_desc: Ralit Egg Mine is an egg mine situated near the settlement of Bodrum within the Roth Roryn region. Unlike typical working mines, it currently operates without a miner presence. The deeper reaches of the mine are inhabited by hostile kwama that guard the egg deposits, while a locked storeroom secures the mine's harvested resources. The site yields a substantial number of egg samples.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ralit Egg Mine is.

title: Rallabala
topic_desc: Rallabala is a Velothi enchanter's tower on the eastern shore of Lake Coronati in the Coronati Basin, southeast of Ald Marak. Its occupants pursue various forms of magical research. Notable endeavors include alchemical experimentation with powdered soul gems and lethal conjuration studies involving scamps. The tower houses an enchanter's shop offering enchanted goods, alongside spellmaking and training services. A scamp capable of articulate speech is found within the tower, an unusual trait among lesser Daedra. The presence of multiple sorcerers and mages engaged in independent research suggests Rallabala serves as a communal site for arcane study rather than a single wizard's retreat. The tower's location in the Coronati Basin places it in the remote interior of Morrowind's Telvanni-influenced eastern territories.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rallabala is.

title: Raloran Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Raloran Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Roth Roryn region, northwest of Bodrum. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Raloran family. The tomb is currently inhabited by restless undead, a common affliction of Dunmer burial sites, which recently repulsed a raid by a pair of adventurers seeking entry.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Raloran Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Ramaniran
topic_desc: Ramaniran is a Velothi tower garrisoned by House Redoran's Eighth Watchman Patrol. The fortification stands along the road connecting the Redoran settlements of Bodrum and Uman, providing a guarded waypoint in the hostile Armun Ashlands. The Redoran soldiers stationed here offer limited training and permit travelers to rest within its walls, serving as a vital respite for those traversing the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ramaniran is.

title: Rangirth Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Rangirth Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb situated on the eastern edge of the Sunad Mora region, south of Ranyon-ruhn. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Rangirth family. The interior features a western ash-pit chamber and a separate southern chamber accessible via an inconspicuous mechanism—an odd sconce—concealing a guarded burial cache. The tomb's protectors are skeletal guardians, typical of Dunmer ancestral sites, which animate to defend against desecration. The hidden southern vault contains a notable burial offering, the Ring of Rising Fortunes, alongside precious gems and limeware, watched over by inert skeletons that stir only when their charge is disturbed.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rangirth Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Ranis Arthyn's House
topic_desc: Ranis Arthyn's House is a dwelling situated in the Lan Orethan region. It serves as the retirement home of an alchemist who formerly practiced in Almalexia. The residence contains a stock of potions and ingredients, reflecting the occupant's continued vocation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ranis Arthyn's House is.

title: Ranyon-ruhn
topic_desc: Ranyon-ruhn is a small House Telvanni settlement situated on a hillside in the Sunad Mora region. The town is primarily composed of traditional Velothi buildings, distinguished by a single Telothi dwelling and a Telvanni mushroom tower just outside its limits, which serves as the residence of the local Telvanni lord, Master Mithras. The settlement's economy centers on its ebony mine. Ranyon-ruhn provides a range of services, including a Tribunal Temple, a silt strider port offering transport to Bal Oyra, Tel Ouada, and Helnim, two alchemists, a healer, a pawnbroker, spellmakers, and a tavern called The Dancing Jug.
topic_desc_basic: Ranyon-ruhn is a small House Telvanni settlement on a hillside in the Sunad Mora region. Its economy relies on a local ebony mine. The town features Velothi architecture, a Tribunal Temple, and a silt strider port with routes to Bal Oyra, Tel Ouada, and Helnim.

title: Ranyon-ruhn, Mine
topic_desc: Ranyon-ruhn Mine is an ebony excavation situated beneath the settlement of Ranyon-ruhn in the Sunad Mora region. The operation is troubled, though the precise nature of its difficulties remains a matter of local circumstance. The complex consists of a surface office and the subterranean workings. The office serves as a guard station and repository for minor goods, including several pieces of bonemold armor. Within the mine itself, five ebony veins are worked for raw ebony, with a modest quantity of loose material present. The site operates under the authority of Great House Telvanni, which maintains a guard presence in the office, while Dark Elf miners extract the valuable ore.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ranyon-ruhn, Mine is.

title: Raran Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Raran Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb overlooking a popular pilgrim gathering place along Veloth's Path, the sacred road running from Kragenmoor to Necrom. It lies in the Coronati Basin near the settlement of Hlan Oek, its entrance situated above the slope where travelers congregate outside a local establishment called the Gourd Harp. The tomb is relatively large in scale and contains numerous locked doors and undead guardians. It serves as the ancestral resting place of the Raran family, whose living members periodically visit to tend to the dead. Its position along one of Morrowind's principal pilgrimage routes makes it a landmark for Temple faithful traveling the sacred path to Necrom, the great city of the dead.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Raran Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Rasdamassilu
topic_desc: Rasdamassilu is a cave situated in the Boethiah's Spine region. It houses a shrine to Mehrunes Dagon. The entrance is concealed at the top of a steep hill surrounded by large boulders, making it difficult to detect from the outside. The cave serves as a gathering place for Dagon's warlocks and their associates.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rasdamassilu is.

title: Ratharzak
topic_desc: Ratharzak is a Dwemer ruin in the Dagon Urul region, consisting of a single stout tower. It is the twin of the nearby Dwemer ruin Yaztaramz, sharing a similar size and active Dwemer centurion guardians. The tower is currently occupied by a Spellwright of Great House Telvanni, who appears to be researching the Dwemer remnants. Unlike its twin, Ratharzak possesses distinguishing internal features, including a shelf holding a copy of the philosophical text 36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 3.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ratharzak is.

title: Rathryon Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Rathryon Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb situated on the ridgeline separating the Aanthirin region from the Sundered Scar, directly east of the settlement of Dondril. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the dead of the Rathryon lineage. The tomb is guarded by undead protectors, including Greater Bonewalkers and Ancestor Ghosts. Its upper chambers contain deposits of rubies and bloodstone, as well as a shrine to Saint Veloth, reflecting the enduring ancestral veneration and Velothi piety of the Dunmer.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rathryon Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Ravalas Cavern
topic_desc: Ravalas Cavern is a medium-sized cave in the Telvanni Isles, situated in the hills above a ruined beach settlement on the Isle of Arches. Its entrance is concealed along an elevated path west of a broken landing. The interior holds several notable features: a hidden chamber in the northeast containing an unexplained corpse with valuable possessions, and a submerged southwestern passage concealing one of the rare raw gold veins found in the region. The cavern currently serves as a hideout for thieves who attack intruders on sight.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ravalas Cavern is.

title: Ravith Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Ravith Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Aanthirin region, southeast of the Mundrethi Plantation. It rests on the northern tip of an island across the river. The tomb is guarded by bonewalkers and an ancestor ghost. Its middle chamber contains a shrine to Saint Aralor. The tomb holds the spirit of Llevana Ravith, a Hlaalu who sought to join the Ashlanders. Her spectre remains bound to the site and holds significance in the lore of the Obainat, a traditional Ashlander artifact.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Ravith Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Relas Shack
topic_desc: Relas Shack is a pauper's dwelling situated in the Sundered Scar region. The structure is inhabited by the Dark Elf Seler Relas. It stands in proximity to the Dathren Shack. The site occupies ground designated for Id Vano, a settlement planned for construction under Great House Indoril's authority.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Relas Shack is.

title: Relvenim Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Relvenim Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer burial site located in the Sunad Mora region. The tomb lies east-southeast of Llothanis, on the eastern side of a road that skirts the northern end of a nearby ridge. Like many such necropolises, it is guarded by undead protectors and contains modest funerary offerings typical of an average ancestral tomb, including common armor, potions, and soul gems. Its remote situation and unremarkable contents distinguish it from more prominent ancestral tombs.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Relvenim Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Rethil Farm
topic_desc: Rethil Farm is a small hackle-lo plantation situated in the Aanthirin region, northeast of Oran Plantation. The settlement consists of a farmhouse and an accompanying storage outbuilding. The operation relies on enslaved Khajiit laborers overseen by guards and the Dunmer Rethil family. The household is marked by a stark ideological divide regarding the institution of slavery; one family member harbors deep suspicion toward beastfolk, while another privately holds sympathies for the enslaved and abhors the practice. The farm's slave bracers are secured within a locked bedroom.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rethil Farm is.

title: Revea Telam's Shack
topic_desc: Revea Telam's Shack is a modest dwelling in the Aanthirin region, situated west of the settlement of Vhul. It is the home of Revea Telam, a Dark Elf farmer who works the surrounding wickwheat fields. Despite her agrarian occupation, Revea is a proficient trainer in the schools of Alteration, Destruction, and Mysticism, a combination of skills whose origin she does not explain. The shack itself is unremarkable, serving as both residence and base for a woman whose magical competence stands in curious contrast to her declared trade.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Revea Telam's Shack is.

title: Rilramisnat
topic_desc: Rilramisnat is a cave situated in the Mephalan Vales. It currently serves as a refuge for outlaws, including individuals of varied backgrounds such as archers, spellswords, mages, and barbarians.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rilramisnat is.

title: Rilsoan
topic_desc: Rilsoan is a small fishing village situated on an island along the eastern bank of the Thirr River. It lies south of Almas Thirr within the Aanthirin region. The settlement falls under the administration of the Roa Dyr chapelry and aligns with Great House Indoril. Its inhabitants sustain themselves primarily through fishing.
topic_desc_basic: Rilsoan is a small fishing village on an island on the eastern bank of the Thirr River, south of Almas Thirr in the Aanthirin region.

title: Rimal
topic_desc: Rimal is a cavern in the Roth Roryn region inhabited by nix-hounds. The cave features a single exposed vein of raw gold and shows signs of ancient occupation. Its southern chamber contains architecture characteristic of Old Mournhold, suggesting a historical Indoril presence. The cavern holds notable enchanted artifacts: the Shirt of Prosperity, which fortifies mercantile ability, and the Spellweaver's Cuirass, a light armor piece providing constant spell absorption and fortifying intelligence.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rimal is.

title: Rivenwake
topic_desc: The Rivenwake is a vessel currently impounded at the docks of Bal Foyen, a settlement in the Roth Roryn region. The ship is confined indefinitely to port following irregularities in its paperwork, and its captain has threatened legal action against House Hlaalu over the detention. The vessel's crew remains aboard during the dispute. The Rivenwake is moored in Bal Foyen's harbor, where it sits awaiting resolution of the bureaucratic and legal questions surrounding its cargo and documentation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rivenwake is.

title: River Garivun
topic_desc: The River Garivun is a short watercourse winding through three mainland regions. It rises in the steeply-banked Boethian Mountains and flows south into Molag Ruhn, where the terrain flattens into arable floodplains. The river then curves southwest past the settlement of Helnim before venting into the Inner Sea. Its valley supports agriculture and hosts scattered dwellings, including a remote Telvanni tower and a cave known to house a skooma operation.
topic_desc_basic: The River Garivun is a short mainland river that rises in the Boethian Mountains and flows south through Molag Ruhn. It turns southwest past Helnim before emptying into the Inner Sea.

title: Riverbed Shipwreck
topic_desc: Riverbed Shipwreck lies in the Thirr River between Felms Ithul and Mundrethi Plantation. Slaughterfish swarm through the wreck, whose hold and cabin still contain pearls and raw gold from its former cargo.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Riverbed Shipwreck is.

title: Riverkeep
topic_desc: Riverkeep is a ducal palace situated in the Shipal-Shin region south of Narsis. It serves as the seat of Duke Fethas Hlaalu, the appointed Duke of the Narsis District, and functions as the administrative and military center of his authority. The palace is also the home of the Order of Narsis, a gathering of knights sworn to protect the duke and uphold the Emperor's laws throughout the district. The keep itself houses a garrison of Imperial Legion knights across its great hall, guard towers, ducal chambers, smithy, and a secure vault complex, reflecting its dual role as both a noble residence and a fortified administrative stronghold.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Riverkeep is.

title: Rivul Farmhouse
topic_desc: Rivul Farmhouse is a partially-ruined drumpear farm located in the Shipal-Shin region, near the Purple Road. The farm is currently undergoing reconstruction, spearheaded by Elaras Rivul, who hired workers to rebuild the site from its ruined state, including a wrecked barn. The site is accessible via a dirt track branching off the road to Shipal-Sharai.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rivul Farmhouse is.

title: Roa Dyr
topic_desc: Roa Dyr is House Indoril's chapel-port on the eastern bank of the Thirr River in Aanthirin. As an Indoril chapel, it functions as the administrative and religious center for the surrounding Velothi settlements—including Dondril, Felms Ithul, Vhul, Saveri, Rilsoan, Selyn, and Velonith—which sustain the chapel through tribute. Lord Indoril Ilvi rules from the Warriors' Hall and operates ships transporting goods and slaves through the harbor. The settlement is built around the needs of its lord rather than commerce, featuring the Crossing of Lamps tower, a Sanctum, and a Morag Tong tower known as Black Hand Hall on the harbor island. It lies along Veloth's Path east of Almas Thirr, though access from the road is indirect, requiring passage by ferry. The Daedric ruins of Hadrumnibibi and Drothril Ancestral Tomb occupy an island to the northwest.
topic_desc_basic: Roa Dyr is House Indoril's port on the Thirr River in Aanthirin. It lies along Veloth's Path east of Almas Thirr, accessible by ferry from the main road.

title: Robed Warden
topic_desc: The Robed Warden is a cargo ship currently docked in Bal Foyen's harbor, within the Roth Roryn region. The vessel comprises three distinct zones: a cabin, a lower level, and an upper level. As a merchant vessel, it serves the maritime trade routes connecting the settlements along Morrowind's coast. The ship's presence at Bal Foyen's docks reflects the routine commercial traffic passing through the region's harbors.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Robed Warden is.

title: Romavel Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Romavel Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Velothi Mountains, in the shadow of Ngelfltingth. Accessible via a long, winding mountain path, the tomb serves as the resting place for the Romavel lineage. It currently houses undead occupants and the separated skull of Rilas Romavel, who seeks assistance in completing his second burial.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Romavel Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Romayon
topic_desc: Romayon is an ancient Dunmer stronghold buried beneath the Velothi tower of Ald Virak in the Roth Roryn region. It is accessible through Ald Virak above or through the old iron mines of Anbarsud. The stronghold contains a library, a propylon chamber, and a vault. Romayon is the haunt of a vampire ancient and is inhabited by undead and Daedra. The library preserves a collection of treasures and skill books. The stronghold's propylon index is held by the vampire ancient who resides in the library. Romayon's propylon chamber connects it to the network of ancient Dunmer strongholds linked by propylon indices.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Romayon is.

title: Romithren Monastery
topic_desc: Romithren Monastery is an isolated Tribunal Temple sanctuary situated high on the hills east of Lan Orethan. The complex includes a chapel, cloister, dormitory, library, and scriptorium. It houses an apothecary providing potion services and a substantial library containing several volumes of the 36 Lessons of Vivec alongside other instructional texts. The monastery holds the Plume of Saint Llothis, a relic lacking monetary value, and preserves a full set of bells used in conjunction with the correct scroll to access Khalaan. Monks and Temple adepts maintain the grounds and its shrines.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Romithren Monastery is.

title: Rorissud
topic_desc: Rorissud is a summoner's enclave situated within a cave in the Roth Roryn region. The entrance lies a short distance west of Menaan, accessible via a wooden bridge and a signposted path into the hills. A locked door separates the outer chamber from the inner complex. Beyond this barrier, a gang of conjurers and their summoned creatures reside, including the High Elf sorcerer Lannenrionvus, who is attended by storm atronachs. The enclave holds texts of magical instruction, including copies of The Final Lesson and Breathing Water, alongside alchemical apparatus.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rorissud is.

title: Rotten Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Rotten Shipwreck is a vessel that came to grief among the islands of the Sea of Ghosts, lying partly submerged north of Bal Oyra. Its weathered hull holds little of value; most chests and sacks within are empty or hold only mundane miscellany. A significant portion of the remaining cargo consists of cloth and spools of thread, a shipment that may be of concern to Merlador.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rotten Shipwreck is.

title: Rthungzark
topic_desc: Rthungzark is a Dwemer ruin clinging to the volcanic slopes of Mount Sarrunabi in the Dagon Urul region. Its original approach spanned a Dwemer bridge, now broken, forcing any modern ascent to scale the mountainside directly. The site's single interior zone houses numerous active Dwemer centurions. Within its chambers, the Deep Elves left exposed ruby veins and caches of Dwemer armor. As a source of Dwemer scrap metal, the ruin holds practical alchemical value.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rthungzark is.

title: Runat
topic_desc: Runat is a cave in the Armun Ashlands, situated northwest of Arvud. It currently serves as a hideout for a bandit gang engaged in slaving operations. The group holds two Khajiit slaves captive within the cavern. A sentry is posted outside the entrance, keeping watch over the surrounding ashlands for threats or potential targets. The gang's leader carries a key to the slaves' restraints.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Runat is.

title: Rurvyn Egg Mine
topic_desc: Rurvyn Egg Mine is an egg mine located in the Sacred Lands. It is presumably owned by Bereldas Rurvyn, an Indoril Concordant Minister residing at Rurvyn Manor in nearby Sailen. The mine is worked by slaves who are watched over by Indoril guards. A member of the Rurvyn family, Ervona, oversees operations at the site, assisted by Garer Rothril. The entrance lies at the end of a small path branching east from the road south of Sailen, past Fort Umbermoth.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Rurvyn Egg Mine is.

title: Sacred Lands
topic_desc: The Sacred Lands comprise a peninsular region in the Mournhold District of Morrowind, encompassing the rugged coast and rocky ridges surrounding the Dunmer holy city of Necrom. The hallowed terrain appears dour and sparsely vegetated, with winds said to carry whispers of the Dunmer dead. The spirits of ancestors manifest here, notoriously xenophobic and even less tolerant of outsiders than their living descendants. Necrom's stark white architecture contrasts sharply against the browns and greens of the surrounding landscape. The region borders Nedothril to the south, the Mephalan Vales to the west, and the Padomaic Ocean on all other sides. Beyond the metropolis, settlements include the Indoril farming village of Sailen, which accommodates pilgrims, and the hamlet of Evos. The peninsula also holds numerous ancestral tombs, Velothi towers, a Daedric shrine to Boethiah, Dwemer ruins, and an old Dunmer stronghold.
topic_desc_basic: A peninsular region in the Mournhold District of Morrowind, surrounding the holy city of Necrom on the Padomaic coast.

title: Sad
topic_desc: Sad is a smugglers' cavern situated in the Roth Roryn region, on the banks of the Pryai River west of Omaynis. The cave serves as a hidden outpost for the provincial underworld, housing a band of smugglers who store their illicit goods within its chambers. The site contains the standard array of contraband expected of such an operation, alongside a notable cache of diamonds secured in its southwest chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sad is.

title: Sadalvel Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sadalvel Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer burial site situated southwest of Necrom, across the river on the western side of the southern road from the great bridge connecting the holy city to the mainland. Like many such tombs, it is guarded by undead and holds modest funerary offerings of common armor, potions, and scrolls. The tomb currently serves as the lair of the newly turned vampire Velyn Alari.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sadalvel Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Sadas Plantation
topic_desc: Sadas Plantation is a House Telvanni settlement occupying the westernmost point of Vahn Isle in the Telvanni Isles. Controlled by the Telvanni noble Angon Sadas, the plantation breeds netch and silt striders, serving as a backbone of the local economy. Its stronghold, Tel Sadas, blends Velothi and Telvanni architectural traditions. The population consists primarily of farmers and slaves, supplemented by a few resident specialists: a Tribunal Temple priest, Telvanni sorcerers offering magical services, and a blacksmith. A river strider transport service connects the plantation to Port Telvannis to the east.
topic_desc_basic: Sadas Plantation is a House Telvanni settlement at the westernmost point of Vahn Isle in the Telvanni Isles. It breeds netch and silt striders and offers river strider transport to Port Telvannis.

title: Sadavel Plantation
topic_desc: Sadavel Plantation is a corkbulb and wickwheat agricultural estate located in the Lan Orethan region, north of Dreynim. The property operates under the ownership of Neremsi Sadavel, a Concordant Minister of Great House Indoril, with the fields worked by enslaved Argonians. Tulthos Arenim, an Indoril Oathman, serves as the plantation's overseer. The estate comprises a manor house, a slave shack, and a separate storage shack.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sadavel Plantation is.

title: Sadrapit Mine
topic_desc: Sadrapit Mine is an abandoned ruby mine in the Roth Roryn region, situated along the coast of the Inner Sea near the settlement of Teyn. The sea has breached the mine's workings, leaving the entrance as a dark opening at the waterline. The interior consists of a single chamber where a large waterfall cascades from the breach down to sea level. Ruby veins remain exposed along the walls, though the operation has long since ceased. The flooding and verticality of the chamber make access difficult despite the valuable deposits that remain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sadrapit Mine is.

title: Sadras Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sadras Ancestral Tomb is a sizeable Dunmer burial site situated opposite the western gate of Sadrathim in the Coronati Basin. The tomb houses an altar to the Nine Divines, an unusual feature for traditional Dunmer ancestral crypts. Its chambers are guarded by summoned daedra and restless undead. Among the funerary offerings interred within are a dreugh cuirass resting on a sarcophagus in a southern chamber and an ebony dagger in another guarded by a storm atronach.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sadras Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Sadrathim
topic_desc: Sadrathim is a House Hlaalu town in the Coronati Basin, northeast of Narsis, set between cliffs in two districts. The upper district holds the Chapel of Stendarr, the inn Vulam's Net, and shops; the lower district contains residences and a boat landing connecting to Ald Iuval, Hlerynhul, Narsis, and Othmura. Founded by the Sadras family following the Armistice, the town was established to protect the nearby Sadras Ancestral Tomb during the post-Armistice tumult. Sadras Manor overlooks the settlement from a bridge spanning the two cliffs. Derayna Sadras presides over the town and regards her stewardship of the ancestral tomb as equal in weight to her governance of the settlement itself. The town's relatively recent founding and protective purpose distinguish it from older Hlaalu holdings in the region.
topic_desc_basic: Sadrathim is a House Hlaalu settlement in the Coronati Basin, northeast of Narsis. The town occupies two districts set between cliffs, with an upper district containing a chapel, inn, and shops, and a lower district of residences with boat access to regional transit.

title: Sadratus
topic_desc: Sadratus is a small, secluded cave in the Sunad Mora region. Hidden within a range of hills, the entrance is carved into a northern rock face and is difficult to find without direction. The interior serves as a makeshift skooma manufacturing den, containing little more than an alchemy apparatus and a modest stock of moon sugar and finished skooma. A single Breton alchemist currently operates the illicit refinery.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sadratus is.

title: Sadreno Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sadreno Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Shipal-Shin region, where the trees of the Othreleth Woods meet the desert sands northeast of the Daedric Shrine of Assukilunend. The tomb is currently occupied by the Grave Maggot goblin tribe. A sole surviving bonewalker remains trapped behind a locked door within the interior, alongside a glass sparkslayer. The goblins have established their own crude hierarchy within the tomb, with a chieftain residing in the final cavern chamber and a literate goblin maintaining records of accumulated spoils.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sadreno Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Sadri Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sadri Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb situated high above the source of a northeastern tributary of the river east of Old Ebonheart in the Aanthirin region. The entrance is suspended on a lofty cliff face, rendering conventional access nearly impossible without levitation or significant athletic prowess. Within, the main chambers are secured by formidable locked doors. Beyond these lies a Shrine of Vivec's Fury and a bridge spanning a flooded subterranean cavern. The tomb serves as the resting place for the Sadri lineage's dead, who are guarded by bound undead protectors including bonewalkers and bonelords. The interior holds a notable accumulation of precious gems—such as rubies, emeralds, and sapphires—alongside bonemold armaments and a silver saber, suggesting the interred were of considerable means.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sadri Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Saekim-Sur Grotto
topic_desc: Saekim-Sur Grotto is an underwater cavern in the Sunad Mora region, situated near Tel Ouada and its guar farm. The submerged entrance leads through flooded passages to a main chamber containing a memorial shrine. Within this shrine rests a skeleton wearing a Telvanni cephalopod helm, accompanied by a note offering a few words about the deceased's identity. The memorial is dedicated to a lute player. The grotto is inhabited by sea creatures. The cavern was formerly known by the name Ba'nal.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Saekim-Sur Grotto is.

title: Sael-Hla
topic_desc: Sael-Hla is a burial cavern overlooking the road between Narsis and Sadrathim in the Coronati Basin. Its inner chambers hold undead remains and scattered grave goods.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sael-Hla is.

title: Sagea
topic_desc: Sagea is a medium-sized cave situated in the heart of Sunad Mora, the rugged region east of Firewatch. The cave serves as the lair of Zaritan Renyl, a rogue Telvanni necromancer, who commands a small force of undead guardians. Within the cave, Zaritan has amassed a collection of alchemical apparatus, including a complete set of master's-grade equipment, alongside a copy of the Mysticism treatise Mystery of Talara, Part 5. The necromancer also keeps a rare piece of amber close at hand. The cave's entrance lies a short distance into the foothills beyond a natural rock arch, reachable by bearing east-southeast from the point where the Firewatch road turns north, past the Murahn-Cithal Mine toward the mountains.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sagea is.

title: Sailen
topic_desc: Sailen is an Indoril settlement in the Sacred Lands of mainland Morrowind, situated along the pilgrim route to Necrom. Also called Sailen Vulgate or Sailenmora, it is a farming town built in typical Indoril architectural style across two streets. The northern street holds the town's sole tavern, several merchants, and a pilgrim hostel, while the southern street contains residential homes, the local Tribunal Temple, and the silt strider port. Sailen sustains contact with the wider world primarily through the steady flow of pilgrims passing eastward toward Necrom, the city of the dead. A Tribunal Temple presence serves the spiritual needs of both residents and travelers. The nearby Imperial garrison of Fort Umbermoth and the small mining settlement of Evos to the south provide additional regional context. The town's economy centers on agriculture, with numerous farmsteads surrounding its modest commercial and religious infrastructure.
topic_desc_basic: Sailen is an Indoril farming town in the Sacred Lands of mainland Morrowind, known as a waypoint for pilgrims traveling east to Necrom. It lies near Fort Umbermoth.

title: Salandus
topic_desc: Salandus is a Dunmer stronghold situated in the Alt Orethan region. The surrounding ruins of former houses indicate that the site was once a modest population center. Currently, the stronghold serves as a base for slaving bandits and holds an unusually large number of enslaved individuals within its two slave cells. The complex comprises two distinct interior zones, including an exterior hut. While the fortress possesses a designated propylon index, the chamber itself remains incomplete and unlinked to the wider network.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Salandus is.

title: Salavel Cave Dwelling
topic_desc: Salavel Cave Dwelling is a humble cavern home situated in the Roth Roryn region of Morrowind. It lies opposite the Athemiran Cave Dwelling, to the southeast of Llaram Plantation. The dwelling offers poor pickings for any would-be robber and holds little to attract visitors, serving as a modest refuge for its Dunmer fisherman inhabitant, Raynil Salavel.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Salavel Cave Dwelling is.

title: Saldro Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Saldro Ancestral Tomb is a partially flooded Dunmer burial site in the Aanthirin region, east of the settlement of Vhul. Its lowest level is submerged, accessible through a flooded tunnel. The tomb is inhabited by undead, including a lesser bonewalker and an ancestor ghost. Among its contents is a valuable volume attributed to Sharai-Saldro, suggesting the Saldro lineage maintained scholarly interests. The tomb's state of partial inundation indicates either gradual subsidence or the encroachment of regional waterways into the original burial chambers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Saldro Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Salerys Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Salerys Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer burial site located near the southern shore of Lake Andaram, south of the Daedric Shrine of Andarannipal in the Aanthirin region. It serves as the resting place of a family now divided between competing allegiances. The tomb's lower chamber houses the Salerys Family Cuirass upon a sarcophagus. Like many ancestral tombs, it is inhabited by undead guardians.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Salerys Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Salka Cave
topic_desc: Salka Cave is a small cavern in the Aanthirin region, situated on the lakeside south of Andarannipal. The interior supports abundant fungal growth, particularly Violet Coprinus and Luminous Russula specimens, and hosts mole crabs among scattered dead rats. A chest at the cavern's rear holds minor goods.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Salka Cave is.

title: Salvarys Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Salvarys Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Sacred Lands region, on the island north of Necrom. The tomb is oriented northward and comprises two distinct zones: an initial burial section and a deeper cavern network connected to a family shrine. A ghostfence bars the western passage into the caverns, a barrier that can only be deactivated by removing a sacrificial dagger from a skeleton in the eastern chamber. Beyond this barrier, a lich named Llovyn Salvarys guards the approach to the shrine area. The Family Shrine of House Salvarys lies at the eastern end of the complex. The tomb contains master alchemy apparatuses, filled soul gems, and notable armaments including an Adamantium dagger and a Dwemer helm.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Salvarys Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Salvu Manor
topic_desc: Salvu Manor is the estate of Indoril Councilor Ienen Salvu, situated in the Lan Orethan region near the settlement of Dreynim. The property comprises a manor house and an adjacent garden. As a seat of an Indoril seneschal, the residence reflects the standing of its owner within Great House Indoril, housing retainers, guests, and household slaves. The manor's bookshelves hold volumes of the Thirty-Six Lessons of Vivec alongside pieces of the valuable Indoril armor set, underscoring the orthodox Dunmer cultural character of the household.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Salvu Manor is.

title: Samalsi Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Samalsi Ancestral Tomb is a large, near-symmetrical Dunmer ancestral tomb located along the Purple Road in the Shipal-Shin region, a short distance from the town of Shipal-Sharai. Within its central chamber, an ashpit holds two notable relics: a Glass Stormblade and the Boots of the First Settler. The tomb is currently occupied by restless undead.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Samalsi Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Samapwi
topic_desc: Samapwi is a deserted cave situated at the southeastern end of the Boethiah's Spine region, near Alt Bosara. The cavern formerly served as an amethyst mine before suffering a catastrophic flood. The remains of five drowned miners and two skeletons within the tunnels indicate the inundation occurred with lethal suddenness. The submerged workings still contain amethyst deposits, but the site holds no other known value and remains abandoned.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Samapwi is.

title: Sambussu Tunnel
topic_desc: Sambussu Tunnel is a cave situated in the Mephalan Vales region of Morrowind. The passage features both an upper and a lower entrance, suggesting a descending or sloping interior path connecting different elevations of the surrounding terrain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sambussu Tunnel is.

title: Samori Farmhouse
topic_desc: Samori Farmhouse is a tanna farm nestled within a canyon in the Shipal-Shin region. It lies immediately north of Septim's Gate Pass. The farmhouse and its surrounding grounds are occupied by four members of the Samori family and a single enslaved Ohmes.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Samori Farmhouse is.

title: Samursi
topic_desc: Samursi is a large cave situated east of Tel Mothrivra in the Boethiah's Spine region. The cavern harbors the ruins of Valandus, a site currently undergoing excavation by a band of sorcerers and battlemages. These treasure-seekers imported Argonian slaves to perform the digging, though the laborers have since perished. The excavators' progress and grim fortunes are recorded in an excavation log found within. The site is perilous; Daedra and slaughterfish infest the cave alongside the sorcerous expedition.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Samursi is.

title: Sanammasour
topic_desc: Sanammasour is a medium-sized cave situated in the Sunad Mora region, north of Tel Oren across the water and within the sandy hills. Its entrance lies at the base of a large hill, screened by rocks. The cave currently serves as a smugglers' hideout, holding stores of drink and copies of thief-related literature.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sanammasour is.

title: Sandil Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sandil Ancestral Tomb is the ancestral tomb of the rulers of Gorne, situated in the Nedothril region. It houses the remains of those who once lived in Sandil Manor. The tomb is guarded by undead, including skeletons and a bonelord, with a lesser bonewalker protecting the deeper chambers. A locked door secures the interior sanctums, one of which contains jet alongside displayed skulls.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sandil Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Sannisaran Egg Mine
topic_desc: Sannisaran Egg Mine is a kwama egg mine situated in the Mephalan Vales. The operation encompasses two distinct zones: the primary mine and the Queen's Lair. With sixty-eight kwama egg sacks documented within its tunnels, the mine yields a substantial harvest. A crew of Dunmer miners works the tunnels, tending to the kwama and gathering the valuable eggs. The settlement of Akamora lies close enough that an Almsivi Intervention from the mine deposits the traveler there, while Divine Intervention reaches Windmoth Legion Fort.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sannisaran Egg Mine is.

title: Sarahu
topic_desc: Sarahu is a Velothi tower situated in a canyon within the Shipal-Shin region, east of Narsis. The entrance opens into a long, winding corridor guarded by nix-hounds before reaching the main chambers. The tower currently serves as the isolated stronghold of a reclusive researcher who fiercely protects his work, keeping the interior populated by summoned Daedra. A prisoner is also held within the depths of the tower.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarahu is.

title: Sarat-Libali
topic_desc: Sarat-Libali is a small cavern in the Coronati Basin, situated near Ald Marak. It currently serves as a hideout for a band of outlaws who appear to have accumulated some wealth from their activities. Internal friction exists among the bandits, as evidenced by a letter from one member, Dolyn, addressed to another, Amozghar, complaining about unpaid chores. Among the group is Falena Llaren, who possesses an enchanted bow named Kindheart.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarat-Libali is.

title: Sarbiri
topic_desc: Sarbiri is a smugglers' cave situated in the Lan Orethan region, north of Bosmora. The cavern serves as a hideout for outlaw bands. Beyond the occupied chambers, the cave extends into a scenic underground river cascade. This subterranean waterway ultimately connects to the sewers of Veremmu, providing discreet access to those ancient Indoril ruins. The proximity of Sarbiri to the Dwemer ruin of Alencheth marks the local landscape, though the cave itself is defined by its illicit inhabitants and its structural link to the forgotten Indoril infrastructure below.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarbiri is.

title: Sarmabael
topic_desc: Sarmabael is a cavern in the Armun Ashlands serving as a hideout for a bandit gang engaged in gold extraction. The cave's flooded southwestern reaches contain exposed veins of raw gold ore, which the outlaws have been attempting to mine from beneath the water's surface. Their efforts include experimental alchemical work on water-breathing potions, tested on enslaved Khajiit forced into the submerged passages. The central chamber forms a rocky labyrinth with elevated positions, and the bandits maintain archers among their number to defend against intruders. The presence of both gold deposits and enslaved laborers suggests the operation has been ongoing for some time, though the remote location of the cavern in the ashlands has kept it largely hidden from outside attention.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarmabael is.

title: Sarnat Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sarnat Ancestral Tomb is a flooded Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Sundered Scar, north of Darvonis. The interior has been claimed by Dreugh, including a notably voracious specimen, rendering the site inhospitable to its original funerary purpose. A Shrine of Almalexia's Mercy stands in the southern room, before which a pearl remains as an offering. The tomb's primary interments consist of five sealed funerary urns, though these vessels are sometimes displaced by standard jars. The presence of the Dreugh squatters and the inundated conditions suggest the Sarnat family has long been unable to properly maintain or access the site.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarnat Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Saros Archipelago
topic_desc: The Saros Archipelago is a caldera situated within the Inner Sea. Formerly of strategic importance to the Empire, the archipelago fell to the lich Grurn in the aftermath of the Simulacrum and now hosts an undead army. Its largest island holds the ruined Fort Firemoth, while Sulfurwatch Keep and its lighthouse guard the bay's inner docks. The western caldera wall contains the Saros Mine, which yields ebony and glass, and the wreck of the vessel Chrysanthippus rests along the eastern side.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Saros Archipelago is.

title: Saros Mine
topic_desc: Saros Mine is a multi-level excavation within the Saros Archipelago, situated in the cliffside west of Fort Firemoth in the Clambering Moor region. Unusually, it yields both glass ore on its upper levels and ebony on its lower levels. Currently, the mine serves as the lair of the lich Grurn, who has filled the tunnels with undead. The deepest section, the Sunken Tower, houses the lich, while a sole living resident, a Khajiit named J'Hanir, survives in the eastern reaches of the Lower Level. The mine's lucrative dual-ore deposits make it a point of contention among the Great Houses of Vvardenfell.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Saros Mine is.

title: Sarvanni Molecrab Farm
topic_desc: Sarvanni Molecrab Farm is a House Telvanni settlement situated in the Boethiah's Spine region, positioned at the north entrance to Aranyon Pass. The facility operates as a specialized breeding and harvesting site for mole crabs, which are reared in a large, waterlogged cave. The interior contains separate cave dwellings that house the farm's workers. The site yields mole crab eggs, meat, and shells as its primary products. A local blacksmith crafts and sells mole crab armor from the harvested shells. The farm is managed by Muldyne Ienit. The surrounding road network connects the farm to the Telvanni settlements of Ranyon-ruhn and Llothanis to the south via the pass, Tel Ouada to the west, and the Sunad Mora Lighthouse to the northeast.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarvanni Molecrab Farm is.

title: Sarvayn Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sarvayn Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral burial site situated in the Aanthirin region, along the road connecting Velonith and Aimrah. The tomb lies directly west of the ancient stronghold of Hlorandus, with the settlement of Balathren visible to the north. Like many such sites, it is guarded by undead protectors. A northwestern chamber within the tomb houses a small chest containing the Ring of Lifebloom, an enchanted ring that fortifies health and fatigue. The chest is warded by an Ancestor Ghost that manifests upon its opening.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarvayn Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Sarys Plantation
topic_desc: Sarys Plantation is a farm practicing mixed agriculture in the eastern Coronati Basin. It produces Ash Yam, Hackle-Lo, and Hamum Root, and herds guar. The plantation lies in the remote, agriculture-heavy hinterland of the basin, along the road network leading out of Ald Marak. It is owned by Adas Sarys, who sells produce from the grounds. The estate includes a manor and separate quarters, and supports a small workforce of farmers, a carpenter, and a herder. The surrounding basin region contains other farming settlements and at least one Daedric shrine along the same route. The plantation's isolation and mixed output typify the agrarian character of the eastern basin hinterlands.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sarys Plantation is.

title: Sasamsi Egg Mine
topic_desc: Sasamsi Egg Mine is an abandoned egg mine in the Coronati Basin. Once operational for kwama egg harvesting, it has since been claimed by swamp trolls, rendering it inaccessible to miners. The site lies across the mangroves south of Raran Ancestral Tomb. Its abandonment reflects the persistent hazards that deter exploitation of such resources in the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sasamsi Egg Mine is.

title: Sassanibat's Yurt
topic_desc: Sassanibat's Yurt is a small Ashlander tent situated in the fields of the Sundered Scar, east-northeast of Darvonis. The dwelling serves as the home for two Ashlanders, Hannab, a herder, and Sassanibat, a hunter. Like many such structures in the region, it represents the transient yet enduring presence of the Ashlander people within the Sundered Scar's landscape.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sassanibat's Yurt is.

title: Sassur-Dari Mine
topic_desc: Sassur-Dari Mine is an iron ore mine located in the Lan Orethan region near Bosmora. The site yields three samples of iron ore. It is currently occupied by a band of five smugglers who exploit enslaved Argonian miners. Crates within the mine hold skooma, indicating the group's involvement in the illicit drug trade. An underwater passageway in the mine leads to a submerged skeleton bearing an extravagant amulet and a chest of valuables.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sassur-Dari Mine is.

title: Satunabi
topic_desc: Satunabi is a cave in the Shipal-Shin region serving as a refuge for a small group of free Argonians who dwell there in voluntary isolation, seeking to live unmolested.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Satunabi is.

title: Savani Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Savani Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer burial site situated on a hilltop in the Roth Roryn region, southwest of Omaynis. Reached by a path winding upward past cascading waterfalls to the hill's summit, the tomb adheres to traditional ancestor-veneration practices. Its interior is guarded by undead protectors, a common defensive measure in such tombs. Like many modest ancestral shrines, it holds limited material wealth.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Savani Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Saveri
topic_desc: Saveri is a small Indoril agricultural settlement in the Aanthirin region, situated along a track branching north from Veloth's Path into the hills. The settlement is a hetman village under the authority of Indoril Ilvi of Roa Dyr, administered locally by Hetman Felvi Envano. Its economy relies on the cultivation of ash yams and corkbulbs, worked by a population of enslaved Argonians and Khajiit whose bracer keys are held at Roa Dyr. Saveri offers no services to travelers. It can be reached by road east of Vhul or via Veloth's Path east from Almas Thirr.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Saveri is.

title: Savrethi Distillery
topic_desc: Savrethi Distillery is a House Hlaalu plantation and brewing facility located in Roth Roryn. The estate's fields are cultivated with comberry and ash yam, tended by a slave workforce. The distillery produces sujamma and greef, aging its stock within a small cavern on the grounds. The Savrethi family governs the operation from their manor house, supported by distinct facilities including a brandy distillery, offices, and workers' shacks. The plantation's operations are currently strained by disputes with the nearby Obainat Ashlander camp over water access. The facility employs specialized staff, including an alchemist and a scribe, alongside the family's overseers and agents.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Savrethi Distillery is.

title: Sebarmul
topic_desc: Sebarmul is a small cavern in the Roth Roryn region, situated southwest of Teyn. It currently serves as a base of operations for Camonna Tong smugglers. The cave's notable feature lies in its geology: emerald veins run through its flooded chambers, offering valuable mineral deposits. The presence of Camonna Tong activity within the cave draws the attention of the Imperial Legion, which identifies the site as a significant operational node for the criminal organization's local smuggling endeavors.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sebarmul is.

title: Sedothran Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sedothran Ancestral Tomb is a modest Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the eastern Othreleth Woods. Its entrance lies a short distance inland from the southern shore of the Kanit River, along the path running southwest from Hladri Winery. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of its founding family and is presently inhabited by undead guardians typical of disturbed or neglected Dunmer crypts.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sedothran Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Seherbal Camp
topic_desc: Seherbal Camp is a small Ashlander outpost in the Sacred Lands, situated west of Necrom. The camp's inhabitants maintain a herd of blue beetles. Its proximity to Necrom brings persistent unease; the Ashlanders are wary of provoking the settled Dunmer surrounding them, having already endured Temple preachers from nearby farming communities. The camp holds a relic coveted by the Tribunal Temple, a secret that further strains the fragile peace with the Ordinators.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Seherbal Camp is.

title: Sehutu
topic_desc: Sehutu is a cavern complex in the Armun Ashlands, situated directly southwest of the Dunmer stronghold of Volenfaryon. It serves as the abode of Master Bel-Betu, a powerful enchanter. The heart of the complex is protected by a magical labyrinth whose doors teleport intruders between chambers, often returning them to their starting point. The innermost chambers include the Sanctum of Souls, where Bel-Betu resides among undead guardians, and the deeper Tabernacle. Undead hosts emerging from Sehutu have lately raided Volenfaryon, drawing the attention of the stronghold's eldest Mabrigash. An aspiring apprentice, Vildaryn Terano, remains outside, having failed to penetrate the labyrinth.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sehutu is.

title: Seitur
topic_desc: Seitur is a coastal Indoril village situated along the shore of Nedothril, the mainland region lying south-southwest of Necrom. It stands directly south of both Sailen and Fort Umbermoth along Morrowind's eastern coast. The village sustains a modest population of Dark Elf residents and offers limited local services, including healing and martial training. Its position on the Nedothril coast places it within the network of Indoril settlements and Temple-affiliated sites that characterize this stretch of the mainland. The proximity to Fort Umbermoth underscores the integration of Indoril and Temple authority in the region.
topic_desc_basic: Seitur is a small coastal Indoril village in Nedothril, the mainland region south-southwest of Necrom. It lies directly south of Sailen and Fort Umbermoth along Morrowind's eastern shore.

title: Selal Grotto
topic_desc: Selal Grotto is a freshwater cave situated along the riverbed west of Maar-Bani Crossing in the Aanthirin region. Its entrance lies submerged at the bottom of the river. While the grotto is largely flooded, a sizeable air pocket occupies its western portion. The cave currently serves as the refuge of an Argonian slave, Wanders-With-Sky, who claims to have escaped from a vessel near Hlan Oek during a storm. An enchanted stave known as the Hermit Staff rests in her vicinity.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Selal Grotto is.

title: Selanasteris
topic_desc: Selanasteris is a small cave situated in the Sunad Mora region. It currently serves as a lair for the necromancer Elvas Relarys and the undead under his control. The interior holds typical necromantic accoutrements, including scrolls, ingredients, and books, clustered near Relarys's station within the cave.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Selanasteris is.

title: Selas Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Selas Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Sacred Lands. Like other such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead and is inhabited by undead guardians. The tomb contains few notable possessions beyond a few spinels placed near its entrance.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Selas Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Seles Ranch
topic_desc: Seles Ranch is a netch ranch situated in the Shipal-Shin region, near the Cyrodiil border and a short distance down the hill from Septim's Gate Pass. The Seles family operates the ranch as tenants, renting the property from Belron Hlaalu of Narsis. The site consists of a farmhouse, a worker's lodge, and a storage building. As Hlaalu leaseholders rather than landowners, the family's tenure remains dependent on their landlord's arrangements.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Seles Ranch is.

title: Selroth Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Selroth Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the hillside beneath Umalor Plantation within the Coronati Basin. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Selroth family. The interior is guarded by undead protectors. Among the interred remains, a rare Necrom Indoril Helmet remains mounted upon the skull of its owner, suggesting a member of the Indoril order was laid to rest within these halls.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Selroth Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Selvilo Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Selvilo Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized, linear Dunmer ancestral tomb situated on the edge of the Othreleth Woods within the Coronati Basin. The entrance lies north of Hladri Winery, across the river. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Selvilo family and is currently inhabited by restless undead. A Silver Viperslayer rests in the tomb's final chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Selvilo Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Selyn
topic_desc: Selyn is a small comberry and meadow rye farming settlement in the Aanthirin region, aligned with House Indoril. Situated south of Roa Dyr, the village lacks dedicated shops or inns. Its limited commercial activity consists of a hetman who provides inexpensive potions and foodstuffs, and an enslaved Orc who offers repair services and martial training. Selyn functions as a quiet agricultural locale within the Indoril heartland.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Selyn is.

title: Sennahanib Camp
topic_desc: Sennahanib Camp is a small Ashlander settlement in the Alt Orethan region, consisting of three yurts. The camp includes the yurt of Nirmimmi Haserua, who serves as its wise woman.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sennahanib Camp is.

title: Septim's Gate Pass
topic_desc: Septim's Gate Pass is an Imperial Legion fort and border checkpoint on the Purple Road, one of two such passages between Cyrodiil and Morrowind alongside Stormgate Pass. Commanded by Quinctius Maelius, the outpost regulates traffic along the route connecting Narsis to the Nibenay and traders from Mir Corrup. The fort contains a main keep housing a trader, alchemist, and smiths, a northern structure hosting an Imperial Cult shrine and Census and Excise office, and a southern building stationing the garrison. Two watchtowers guard the western end, and the Scent of Niben inn operates within the walls. The fort serves as a firm boundary demarcating Imperial authority at the provincial border.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Septim's Gate Pass is.

title: Seradan Grotto
topic_desc: Seradan Grotto is a submerged cavern network in the Sea of Ghosts, accessed via a passage just beneath the waterline of a small, unnamed island off the coast of Urlis Rock. The cave system consists of dark, twisting tunnels that are notoriously difficult to navigate. Dreugh, including a Man O'War, inhabit these confined depths. The grotto holds notable mineral wealth: several raw glass veins and kollops that may yield pearls. A sunken chest sits in the northern reaches, secured by a formidable lock. You do not know where Seradan Grotto is.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Seradan Grotto is.

title: Seranassid
topic_desc: Seranassid is a cave situated in the Mephalan Vales, positioned east-southeast of the Inn Between and directly east of the ruins of Arkgnthleft. The cavern serves as a fortified hideout for a bandit gang, who have constructed a wooden barricade to defend the entrance. Access beyond this barricade is restricted by a trapped, high-security locked door, though keys to this gate are hidden within the cave's entry areas. The interior contains a pit and a mid-cave grating that renders a small lower section inaccessible under normal circumstances. Bloatspore fungi grow within the cavern's depths.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Seranassid is.

title: Serasith Cavern
topic_desc: Serasith Cavern is a flooded cavern in the Sundered Scar, its entrance directly overlooking the Inner Sea. The cave appears to have flooded suddenly and violently, scattering the bones of its previous occupants throughout the water of its first section. The second section features a deep pit down which water plummets. Bluefoot mushrooms grow plentifully within the cavern. Slaughterfish inhabit the flooded chambers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Serasith Cavern is.

title: Serim Derthi's Shack
topic_desc: A pearl diver's shack raised on stilts above the waters of the Inner Sea, situated along the coast north of Darvonis in the Sundered Scar region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Serim Derthi's Shack is.

title: Seris
topic_desc: Seris is a cave situated on the road north of Kragenmoor, along the southern fringe of the Armun Ashlands. Adjacent to the Daedric shrine of Balititashpi, it serves as a hideout for a bandit group. Their plunder is relatively meager. Among their number is Hinammu Eraishah, the last survivor of the Malawius Ashlander tribe, which was recently slaughtered by Baluath vampires at Malawius Camp.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Seris is.

title: Serrudan
topic_desc: Serrudan is a remote, single-zone cavern in the Molag Ruhn region, located a considerable distance southeast of Tel Muthada. It serves as an isolated den for a group of skooma smugglers, who maintain stores of skooma and moon sugar within the cave. The smugglers keep a tamed scamp as a pet and hold three slaves behind a locked gate in a southwestern cavern. Due to its concealed position beyond a low ridge, Serrudan is difficult to locate.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Serrudan is.

title: Serynthul
topic_desc: Serynthul is a Tribunal Temple infirmary housed within a cliffside Velothi tower in the Aanthirin region, directly east of Old Ebonheart. Despite lacking formal Temple rank, the Dark Elf Alv Llethros governs the site. The healer Taris Temeris, a Temple initiate, provides potions and spells to visitors. The infirmary serves pilgrims and those in need of care, and its dome area holds a significant number of healing scrolls. A copy of the Restoration skill book *Withershins* rests behind Llethros's table.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Serynthul is.

title: Sevadartus
topic_desc: Sevadartus is a medium-sized cave in the Sunad Mora region, situated in a river valley between Bal Oyra and Tel Ouada. Its winding cavern hallways lead to two partly flooded chambers where wooden bridges and walkways provide passage over the water. The cave currently serves as a hideout for a band of smugglers and witches. Evidence of a prior mining operation lingers; miner corpses are scattered throughout the passages and submerged in the final chamber's pond. Among the scattered contraband and crates are a Dreugh left bracer, a bone charm, and a rare spell book.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sevadartus is.

title: Sevenas Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sevenas Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Lan Orethan region of mainland Morrowind, north of the settlement of Dreynim. The tomb is situated near a bridge spanning the river toward the Indoril settlement-stronghold of Bisandryon, with its entrance directly west of that crossing. Like many ancestral tombs, it is guarded by undead, including skeleton champions. The lower chamber houses a notable shield of Indoril craftsmanship, reflecting the cultural presence of House Indoril in the surrounding region. The tomb's proximity to both Dreynim and Bisandryon places it within the sphere of Indoril influence characteristic of Lan Orethan.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sevenas Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Sevil Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Sevil Ancestral Tomb is a two-room Dunmer ancestral burial site located in the Aanthirin region, northwest of the Mundrethi Plantation. In recent times, smugglers have occupied the interior, converting the tomb into a staging area for their illicit trade and storing skooma within its chambers. The lower room contains two notable texts: Hallgerd's Tale and the 36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 17. The tomb's proximity to the Pyr-Ilu Lookout, which lies to the west, marks the local terrain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sevil Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Sevilo Raboban's Shack
topic_desc: Sevilo Raboban's Shack is a miner's stilted shack situated in a twisting canyon within the Mephalan Vales region, southeast of Pamonibu Mine. The dwelling consists of a hammock and a shelf holding personal valuables, alongside a copy of the book The Most Cruel Trade kept beneath the sleeping area. Its owner, the miner Sevilo Raboban, is presently absent, leaving the shack and its contents unguarded.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sevilo Raboban's Shack is.

title: Sha-Sudiran
topic_desc: Sha-Sudiran is a small outlaw cave situated in the southeastern reaches of the Shipal-Shin region, near the Chimer stronghold of Indomarano. The cavern serves as a modest hideout for a handful of smugglers and bandits. Though few in number, the occupants have accumulated a notable cache of valuables, including gold, gems, a collection of Glass Darts, and a crate of greydust. The cave's remote location and defensible position within the local canyon terrain make it a practical refuge for those seeking to avoid the authorities of nearby Narsis.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sha-Sudiran is.

title: Shaden
topic_desc: Shaden is a cave in the Roth Roryn region where natural cavern tunnels give way to a Velothi ancestral tomb. The site bears evidence of an archaeological expedition: support struts and guide ropes line the passages, and the remains of archaeologists lie within. The interior is occupied by undead. An encampment associated with the expedition sits in the northeastern chamber. The surrounding terrain resembles the Armun Ashlands.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shaden is.

title: Shalmurat
topic_desc: Shalmurat is a Velothi tower situated in the Roth Roryn region, within territory claimed by House Hlaalu. Presently, it hosts a covert garrison of House Redoran soldiers operating under a long-range patrol mission. The Redoran presence is deliberately concealed from the Hlaalu, who remain unaware of the incursion. The tower's proximity to the Hlaalu settlement of Menaan makes the encampment a sensitive military foothold deep in rival domain. The garrison is commanded by Akser Arobar and includes scouts, warriors, and a smith among its retainer ranks.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shalmurat is.

title: Shambalu
topic_desc: Shambalu is a sprawling Daedric shrine dedicated to the Prince Mephala, situated in the Mephalan Vales. Dominating the western half of its vale, the site serves as the centerpiece of the valley. The cavernous complex houses Spider Daedra and holds notable relics, including a Glass Poisonsword, an Ebony Tanto, an enchanted Daedric Dagger called the Webspinner's Blade, an Adamantium Halberd, and a Daedric Dart. The deepest sanctum of the shrine is believed to harbor the legendary Ebony Blade, an artifact strongly associated with Mephala's cult. The shrine's significance to the Morag Tong is well established, as the guild of assassins traditionally seeks Mephala's favor and artifacts within its halls.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shambalu is.

title: Shamsi
topic_desc: Shamsi is a medium-sized cave in the Coronati Basin, situated a short distance west of Othmura near the western bend of the northern mouth of Lake Coronati. It currently serves as a hideout for a bandit group that supplements its income through the illegal mining of silver ore from veins within the cave.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shamsi is.

title: Shan-Ahhe
topic_desc: Shan-Ahhe is a cave in the Armun Ashlands, situated a short distance north-northwest of the Armun Pass Outpost. It serves as a dwelling and workshop for leatherworkers who capture Armun Kagouti native to the area and process their hides into clothing. Kagouti hide is scattered throughout the cavern, and cured skins hang on racks in the sleeping quarters. Despite engaging in an apparently honest craft, the occupants are hostile to outsiders, attacking any who approach. The captured kagouti themselves remain dangerous and may turn on their handlers if given the opportunity. The cave thus functions as both a tannery and a bandit stronghold, where the trade in kagouti leather sustains a group that robs travelers passing through the ashlands.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shan-Ahhe is.

title: Shanan Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Shanan Ancestral Tomb is a large Dunmer ancestral tomb in the Armun Ashlands, situated northwest of the Daedric shrine Balititashpi and opposite the Velothi tower of Udai. The site is extremely haunted, housing a considerable number of ancestor ghosts and reanimated mummies. Near its lower depths, a tunnel connects the tomb chambers to a large cavern complex and ancient burial ground. The tomb holds notable funerary offerings, including an ebony tanto draped on a sarcophagus and several weapons clutched by mummified dead, such as an ebony warscythe, a glass spear, and a daedric dart.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shanan Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Shapes-Beginning-To-Take-Form's Shack
topic_desc: Shapes-Beginning-To-Take-Form's Shack is a hunter's dwelling in the Roth Roryn region, situated on a hill overlooking Volenfaryon to the south, near the edge of the Armun Ashlands. The interior is decorated with alit and nix-hound heads, consistent with the occupant's hunting trade. A fresh kill rests outside the front steps. The shack is the home of Shapes-Beginning-To-Take-Form, an Argonian hunter.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shapes-Beginning-To-Take-Form's Shack is.

title: Shasharanit
topic_desc: Shasharanit is a medium-sized cave situated in the Sunad Mora region of mainland Morrowind. The entrance lies just east of Ranyon-ruhn, accessible by following the main road south from the city, then east and north, where it appears on the left before the road forks. The cave serves as a lair for indigenous fauna, specifically parastyli, horned beetles, and small slaughterfish. The remains of three previous adventurers indicate the location's danger, with their recovered possessions constituting the cave's only notable artifacts, including a Steel Crossbow of Ghostlight.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shasharanit is.

title: Shashmassadan
topic_desc: Shashmassadan is a cave situated in the Sunad Mora region, built into the eastern wall of a mountain range. The interior presents an unexplained mystery: the remains of five individuals—an Orc, an Argonian, a Wood Elf, and two High Elves—lie within without any apparent cause of death. A pool inhabited by slaughterfish occupies the cave's southern section, and a golden dagger alongside a few coins rests in a southeastern cleft. Otherwise, the cavern holds little of value.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shashmassadan is.

title: Shirel
topic_desc: Shirel is an extensive, icy cavern situated high in the Velothi Mountains, its entrance lying west of the Dwemer ruin of Ngelfltingth. The cave serves as a well-populated stronghold for a gang of murderous bandits and smugglers. Within its chambers, the cavern holds notable treasures: a corpse studded with Daedric Arrows and bearing a Glass Closed Helm rests upon an ice ledge in the northeast, while an Adamantium Shardaxe and an Orcish Open Helm lie secured behind a wooden palisade alongside the gang's hoard in the northernmost chamber. A copy of the Destruction skill book Mystery of Talara, Part 3 sits upon a lectern in the southern chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shirel is.

title: Shubattu Mine
topic_desc: Shubattu Mine is an abandoned mining complex on the eastern fringe of Aanthirin, comprising access tunnels, a main shaft, flooded tunnels, and a natural grotto. Records left on a wooden platform near the entrance document the mine's poor safety record and eventual abandonment. The upper veins and access tunnels are now entirely depleted of adamantium ore. The main shaft descends to a central pool, while the flooded tunnels to the north require extended submersion to navigate. The bulk of the remaining adamantium, found in veins and minecarts, lies deep within the natural grotto beyond the flooded passages; reaching the grotto's second chamber necessitates levitation. The mine is overrun with vermin and undead, including skeleton warriors and war-wizards, leaving its depths dark and perilous.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shubattu Mine is.

title: Shul
topic_desc: Shul is a cave situated in the Shipal-Shin region, overlooking the eastern passage to the Daedric ruin of Essurnashpi and lying west of Ussiran Camp. It serves as a lair for a band of Shinathi raiders. This group has been responsible for attacking East Empire Company caravans traveling through the region, as evidenced by a recovered caravan schedule detailing company movements. The raiders consist of Dark Elf warriors, hunters, and barbarians operating from this defensible position.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shul is.

title: Shularon
topic_desc: Shularon is a Velothi tower situated in the hills of the Sunad Mora region, behind the source of the River Garivun that flows past the Imperial colony of Helnim. The tower serves as the residence of the Telvanni spellwright Talver Dolmyn, whose presence and activities are a persistent irritant to the Firewatch Mages Guild. Daedra summoned by the wizard guard the interior. Notable items within the tower include the Mandaran Propylon Index, found atop a copy of Liminal Bridges, and documents concerning the Court of Razors.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shularon is.

title: Shumalkashudanit
topic_desc: Shumalkashudanit is a flooded Daedric ruin located in the Shipal-Shin region of Morrowind. The shrine is dedicated to an unknown Daedric Prince. The ruin's interior, known as the Flooded Halls, is partially submerged and harbors aquatic life. The site has fallen into disrepair and no longer functions as an active place of worship; its deeper chambers are inundated, suggesting prolonged abandonment or structural collapse. The surrounding canyon terrain characterizes the approach to the ruin. Shumalkashudanit is one of numerous Daedric shrines scattered across the Morrowind mainland, though the specific Prince venerated there is no longer recorded in any known source.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shumalkashudanit is.

title: Shutaddipal
topic_desc: Shutaddipal is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Namira, situated in the sewers beneath the city of Narsis in the region of the same name. Accessible from the Old Quarter sewer network, the small sanctuary features a central statue of the Daedric Prince alongside her worshipers and numerous corrupted rats. The shrine serves as a site for the veneration of Namira and the conduct of her ancient rituals.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Shutaddipal is.

title: Sihiltu Hive
topic_desc: Sihiltu Hive is a Skyrender nest bridging a canyon in the Shipal-Shin region. The small cave structure lies northwest of Adavrin Plantation, accessible via the main road east from Stormgate Pass. The western chambers contain a sapphire vein and the remains of a past explorer bearing an ebony dagger. A short northeastern tunnel holds a pot of Meat Honey and the Amulet of Air Dominance, a relic sought by a Shinathi scout for managing the local Skyrender threat.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sihiltu Hive is.

title: Silkun-Tirlo Egg Mine
topic_desc: Silkun-Tirlo is a kwama egg mine situated in the Sundered Scar region. The operation yields kwama eggs from roughly three dozen egg sacks. The mine's workforce consists of Dunmer miners. Its proximity aligns with the Almsivi Intervention point at Akamora and the Divine Intervention destination at Windmoth Legion Fort, placing the site within the broader settled and garrisoned perimeter of the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Silkun-Tirlo Egg Mine is.
