title: Silted Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Silted Shipwreck is a vessel wrecked in the Padomaic Ocean, now inhabited by dreugh across its three interior levels.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Silted Shipwreck is.

title: Silver Serpent
topic_desc: The Silver Serpent is a tavern in Firewatch, noted as the cheapest such establishment in the city. Its lowly reputation brings concerns of seasickness alongside alcohol poisoning. The Khajiit publican Polanna runs the premises, selling a range of drinks including Cyrodiilic imports and offering beds for a single septim. The tavern also serves as a gathering place for local paupers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Silver Serpent is.

title: Silvin's Shack
topic_desc: Silvin's Shack is a modest dwelling situated in the Alt Orethan region of Morrowind. It serves as the residence of Silvin Neriem, a Dunmer commoner. The structure stands as a typical example of the sparse rural habitation found within the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Silvin's Shack is.

title: Sinister Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Sinister Shipwreck is the sunken remainder of a vessel that foundered in the Padomaic Ocean between the mainland and the largest of the Telvanni Isles, resting on the seabed southwest of Bthzundcheft. Its cabin holds a modest scattering of gold and beverages, while the lower decks are now inhabited by slaughterfish. The most notable feature is a grim cargo: slave bracers, some still fastened around the skeletal wrists of the ship's unfortunate captives, pointing to the vessel's likely role as a slaver before its demise.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sinister Shipwreck is.

title: Sinramen Monastery
topic_desc: Sinramen Monastery is an isolated Velothi tower situated in the Nedothril region. The remote spire serves as a retreat for members of the Tribunal Temple, housing monks of varying rank alongside a Buoyant Armiger. Its seclusion along the northern coast makes the monastery difficult to locate despite lying a considerable distance north of Seitur.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sinramen Monastery is.

title: Sinsi
topic_desc: Sinsi is a cave situated in the Shipal-Shin region of Morrowind. It currently serves as a lair for a band of Shinathi raiders, who hold several Argonian slaves captive within its chambers. The presence of Imperial Templar equipment inside, including a helmet and war axe, suggests the outlaws have encountered—or waylaid—forces of the Empire. The cave's entrance lies on a ledge west of Sadreno Ancestral Tomb.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sinsi is.

title: Siridunbal
topic_desc: Siridunbal is a medium-sized cave situated in the Telvanni Isles, located at the back of a large beach on the eastern end of an island north of Sadas Plantation. The cave serves as a lair for a significant undead presence, currently inhabited by numerous skeletons led by a powerful lich. The undead have claimed the lives of multiple adventurers, whose corpses litter the interior. An old journal found among the dead partially chronicles one such ill-fated expedition. The lich guards a hoard of treasure in two chests at the western end of the cave, containing skill books, arrows, gems, and gold. Among the relics within the cave is the Glass Dai-Katana of the Leech.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Siridunbal is.

title: Sirouada
topic_desc: The Sirouada is the largest tributary of the Bosouada. It originates from a large waterfall north of Hla Bulor, flowing generally east before heading north. Along its course, it carves two huge meanders through Boethiah's Spine, where the riverbanks are incredibly steep, before turning east to join the Bosouada just outside Ranyon-ruhn. At its source and mouth, the banks slope gently, flanked by fertile land. Notable landmarks near its path include the Veniroth Ancestral Tomb, close to the waterfall, and the submerged grotto of Kitanga, hidden beneath the river's surface further downstream.
topic_desc_basic: The Sirouada is the largest tributary of the Bosouada, joining it just outside Ranyon-ruhn. Originating from a waterfall north of Hla Bulor, it features steep banks through Boethiah's Spine and fertile, gently-sloping land near its source and mouth.

title: Sirrilash
topic_desc: Sirrilash is a Velothi tower situated in the Othreleth Woods. It currently serves as a necromancer's lair, its upper levels guarded by undead entities including skeletal warriors, bonelords, and ghosts. The lower cells hold a captive Fighters Guild member, reflecting the site's hostile occupation. The tower's resident necromancer possesses notable enchanted items, including a Warding Amulet.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sirrilash is.

title: Sirsadrorran
topic_desc: Sirsadrorran is a cave shrine dedicated to the Daedric Prince Sheogorath, situated in the Sundered Scar region between Darvonis and Old Ebonheart. The cave system is secured by locked doors and old gates, with Daedric guardians including scamps and a Golden Saint defending the passages. The Sheogorath shrine occupies the innermost chamber, where offerings such as a copy of the Sixteen Accords of Madness, a Daedric dagger, raw ebony, and various alchemical ingredients are arranged. Alchemy equipment and provisions are present within the cave. Human remains lie behind locked gates in the deeper passages.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sirsadrorran is.

title: Sittali
topic_desc: Sittali is a Velothi tower occupying a hill in the Aanthirin region, situated along the road between Roa Dyr and Vhul. Indoril-style culdems within the structure attest to a past presence by that Great House, though only undead currently inhabit the premises. The tower's most notable guardian is the Wraith of Raldis Darothril, who haunts the upper dome.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sittali is.

title: Skaarling Queen
topic_desc: The Skaarling Queen is a small vessel berthed at the Old Ebonheart docks in the Aanthirin region. Under the command of Aeta the Spear, the ship serves as a transport service offering passage to settlements along the Thirr River and across the Inner Sea. The hold accommodates a modest crew and merchant presence, reflecting the Nordic maritime tradition of its operators.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Skaarling Queen is.

title: Slave Market
topic_desc: Slave markets are a widespread commercial institution across mainland Morrowind, reflecting the legal practice of slavery under Dunmer custom. Enslaved peoples—predominantly Khajiit and Argonians, but also Wood Elves, Orcs, Nords, Bretons, and occasionally Dunmer—are traded at dedicated market stalls within settlements and on plantations. Notable markets operate in Narsis's Market Quarter, at the Mundrethi Plantation on the Thirr River, and at Arvud and Marog. Additional settlements hosting slave trade include Almas Thirr, Hlan Oek, Port Telvannis, Tel Muthada, and Tel Ouada. Most markets conduct business only with recognized buyers rather than casual travelers. The trade supplies labor for mining, plantation agriculture, and household service in Dunmer manors throughout the region.
topic_desc_basic: Slave markets are commercial venues found throughout mainland Morrowind where enslaved peoples are bought and sold. They operate within settlements and on plantations, supplying labor for mines, agriculture, and domestic service in Dunmer manors. Most restrict sales to established clientele rather than passing travelers.

title: Sobbitana Grotto
topic_desc: Sobbitana Grotto is a cavernous, multi-chambered grotto occupying the bed of Lake Andaram in the Aanthirin region, its entrance situated between Nav Andaram and Maar-Bani Crossing. The flooded cavern system harbors aggressive aquatic life, predominantly dreugh and slaughterfish. The cave floor is littered with the bones of victims and, curiously, cattle. While the grotto's size limits the density of valuables, dreugh wax can be harvested from the inhabitants, and a dreugh helm rests upon a stalagmite in the southeasternmost chamber. The floating corpse of an escaped Argonian slave drifts above a cluster of gemstones in one of the southern chambers, including a peridot that summons a Dremora Lord when disturbed.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sobbitana Grotto is.

title: Sobhidaz
topic_desc: Sobhidaz is a small fungal cavern on the eastern fringes of the Othreleth Woods, where the ground slopes upward into the Coronati Basin. The cavern's interior supports fungal growth typical of the Othreleth region's subterranean spaces. It lies west of Naemunbatashpi and southwest of Nim. Its secluded position at the woodland's edge, where the terrain transitions from dense forest to rising basin country, makes it a natural refuge for those wishing to avoid detection.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sobhidaz is.

title: Sodri-Tilur Egg Mine
topic_desc: Sodri-Tilur Egg Mine is a medium-sized kwama egg mine situated south of Tel Ouada in the Sunad Mora region. The mine lies at the foot of the hills southwest of the river crossing. Despite its moderate size, the mine is unusually barren, yielding far fewer eggs than typical workings. A pair of Dunmer miners tends the operation, though the scarcity of egg sacs and loose harvest suggests the kwama colony within is either depleted or failing to produce at expected levels. The mine contains no notable features beyond its basic excavation and the meager egg deposits that remain.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sodri-Tilur Egg Mine is.

title: Soludanni Egg Mine
topic_desc: Soludanni Egg Mine is a medium-sized kwama egg mine located in the Sunad Mora region. It operates as a working site where Dunmer miners harvest kwama eggs from the resident colony's egg sacs. The mine yields a steady supply of eggs, stored alongside shipping crates and barrels, though it holds no other notable features or resources.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Soludanni Egg Mine is.

title: Soramil and Rothera Galdavo's House
topic_desc: Soramil and Rothera Galdavo's House is a Corkbulb and Meadow Rye farm situated in the Lan Orethan region. The dwelling is inhabited by Rothera Galdavo, a Dunmer farmer, and Soramil, an Altmer commoner who works the surrounding fields. The settlement reflects the agrarian character of the Lan Orethan countryside, where mixed households cultivate the traditional crops of Morrowind's settled heartlands.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Soramil and Rothera Galdavo's House is.

title: Soril Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Soril Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral tomb located in the Lan Orethan region, situated across a river from the Dwemer pier of Alencheth, northwest of Bosmora. Like many such sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Soril family. The interior consists of a first chamber branching into flooded western sections. The tomb is heavily warded, with a level 20 lock securing its entrance, and remains actively guarded by undead protectors, including a Bonelord. Sarcophagi within the chambers hold funerary offerings, among them a Scroll of Elemental Burst: Fire and an Amulet of Frost.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Soril Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Soudi
topic_desc: Soudi is a large river cave in the Aanthirin region, situated on the left bank of a river south-southwest of Indal-ruhn. The cavern features an attractive interior with a notable large chamber containing stepping stones arranged in a circle. A side passage near this chamber serves as a secluded hideaway. The cave is inhabited by rats and slaughterfish.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Soudi is.

title: Stalled Shipwreck
topic_desc: The Stalled Shipwreck is the remains of a vessel that misjudged the entrance to Lake Boethiah and foundered on the lake's western coast. The wreck is divided into a cabin, an upper level, and a lower level. The cabin holds scant coins and a historical text, while the upper level contains modest provisions of food and clothing. The lower hold stores barrels of drink and holds the body of Ulla, a Wood Elf slave who perished unable to escape the sinking ship.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Stalled Shipwreck is.

title: Stormgate Pass
topic_desc: Stormgate Pass is a small Imperial settlement and checkpoint in the Shipal-Shin region, serving as one of two major thoroughfares connecting Morrowind to Black Marsh. Its Legion garrison, led by Knight-Protector Dew-Before-Dawn, includes a notable Argonian contingent. The outpost comprises a Census and Excise office, a guardhouse, and The Saxhleel Balladeer inn. The Ayleid ruin of Mala Tor overlooks the pass. A guar-drawn carriage links the settlement to Narsis' Market Quarter, and a cobbled road connects it to Narsis' Foreign Quarter.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Stormgate Pass is.

title: Subdilla
topic_desc: Subdilla is a natural kwama den situated in the Othreleth Woods. The cave contains kwama, their eggs, and acid pools. Its entrance lies roughly midway between the Edalvel Plantation and the Daedric Shrine of Kalkusara, west-southwest of the plantation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Subdilla is.

title: Suldun Egg Mine
topic_desc: Suldun Egg Mine is an egg mine located in the Aanthirin region, west of Indal-ruhn. Unlike typical operational kwama mines, Suldun lacks a living workforce. The tunnels are overrun by a high number of hostile kwama warriors and foragers, indicating severe disruption of the colony. The mine's kwama queen is dead, further confirming the mine's non-functional state. Behind the queen's chamber, a trio of Orc vampires of the Berne clan has claimed the lair, presumably responsible for agitating the kwama and killing the queen. The upper tunnels feature a wooden balcony overlooking the surrounding region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Suldun Egg Mine is.

title: Suldunanit
topic_desc: Suldunanit is a cavern in the Roth Roryn region, serving as the encampment of Bone-Eater's Gang, a group of cannibals and troll-worshipers. The cave lies southeast of the Daedric ruins of Ossurnashalit. The gang's practices include offering human remains to their leader, Bone-Eater, who consumes the marrow of the dead. The interior contains numerous human remains and at least one cave troll, which the gang reveres. The group is considered bestial and dangerous, extorting or killing those who approach their territory.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Suldunanit is.

title: Sulfurwatch Keep
topic_desc: Sulfurwatch Keep is an Imperial Navy fortress situated in the Clambering Moor. It is one of two Imperial bastions on the Inner Sea that fell to an assault led by the lich Grurn, alongside Fort Firemoth. The keep currently harbors a skeletal legion of raised dead and holds little beyond remaining Imperial equipment. The site includes a lighthouse and interior ruins. If the keep is restored, the Imperial Navy cutter TEM Ashrunner docks at its piers, offering passage to Roth Roryn.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sulfurwatch Keep is.

title: Sulindon
topic_desc: Sulindon is a secretive fisherman's hideaway situated on the western side of an island south of Idathren, within the Aanthirin region. The cave's sole known occupant is Mabilette, a Breton fisherman who offers no explanation for her presence. The interior holds the remains of dead mole crabs and mudcrabs, though the circumstances of their abrupt demise remain unclear. Mabilette appears conscious of the odor within the cave, yet the nature of her secretive activities and the exact cause of the crustacean deaths remain unknown.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sulindon is.

title: Sulnwipu Grotto
topic_desc: Sulnwipu Grotto is a large, submerged cavern in Lake Boethiah, situated west of Tel Mothrivra in the Boethiah's Spine region. Its entrance lies just beneath the water's surface, concealed under a substantial rock arch. The interior is populated by aquatic creatures and pearl-bearing kollops. Within the central cavity rests the drowned corpse of a warrior, bearing ancient armaments and an old key. At the grotto's eastern extent sits a ruined, abandoned Daedric shrine housing a locked chest that the ancient key opens.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sulnwipu Grotto is.

title: Sunad Mora
topic_desc: Sunad Mora, meaning Blessed Forest and alternatively called Molagreahd, is a region in the Telvannis District of Morrowind characterized by rolling hills and fertile pastures. Boethiah's Spine divides the region into two distinct parts. It is bordered by Boethiah's Spine to the south, Dagon Urul to the west, the Telvanni Isles to the east, and the Sea of Ghosts to the north. The region hosts numerous Telvanni settlements, including the town of Llothanis spanning Nebet Bay, the ebony-mining settlement of Ranyon-ruhn, and Tel Ouada. Master Mithras rules from the tower of Tel Aranyon. The landscape contains significant Dwemer ruins such as Nchazdrumn, which retains working automata, and Daedric ruins including the prominent Yamuninisharn shrine on Aegondo Point. The area also features multiple egg and gem mines, ancestral tombs, Velothi towers, and natural cave networks.
topic_desc_basic: Sunad Mora, also called Molagreahd, is a region of rolling hills and fertile pastures in the Telvannis District of Morrowind. Divided by Boethiah's Spine, it lies between Dagon Urul, the Sea of Ghosts, and the Telvanni Isles. It contains several Telvanni settlements, including Llothanis, Ranyon-ruhn, and Tel Ouada.

title: Sunad Mora Lighthouse
topic_desc: The Sunad Mora Lighthouse stands as a beacon of light on the western shore of the Sea of Ghosts, within the region of Boethiah's Spine. It lies east of the settlement of Sarvanni, reachable by a road that runs north from Sarvanni before turning eastward toward the coast. The structure serves as a navigational aid for vessels and travelers along the perilous northern coast of Morrowind. Its interior is spartan, provisioned with only modest stores of food in crates and barrels. The lighthouse is maintained by a sole keeper, a Nord of common standing, who resides within the tower to tend its light. Little else of note distinguishes the premises beyond this solitary function.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sunad Mora Lighthouse is.

title: Sunat
topic_desc: Sunat is a cave in the Shipal-Shin region of Morrowind, located northeast of Stormgate Pass past Furam Ancestral Tomb. It serves as a hideout for a mixed band of outlaws, including Nords, Orcs, Argonians, and Dunmer. Nix-hounds and rats also occupy the cavern. The gang recently raided a caravan carrying Cyrodiilic brandy, securing a substantial haul of the imported spirit.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sunat is.

title: Suppiluliumas Grotto
topic_desc: Suppiluliumas Grotto is a flooded cavern in the Aanthirin region, distinguished by massive subterranean fungi. The cave network is submerged, requiring water-breathing measures for full exploration. It serves as a habitat for Dreugh and slaughterfish. The main chamber opens into a broad, waterlogged expanse, while a northern tunnel loops around to an eastern chamber; the southernmost flooded chamber conceals a cache of high-quality potions. A small rocky platform within the eastern section holds the remains of a thief and two pages of their journal, suggesting an ill-fated expedition.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Suppiluliumas Grotto is.

title: Suraritu
topic_desc: Suraritu is a cave in the Shipal-Shin region serving as a hideout for outlaw Argonians. It lies south-southeast of the eastern gate of Septim's Gate Pass. The inhabitants are formidable combatants, including warriors, assassins, and nightblades, who aggressively attack any who approach their refuge.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Suraritu is.

title: Surathi Cave Dwelling
topic_desc: Surathi Cave Dwelling is a cave home in the Roth Roryn region, situated on a cliff-face south of Omaynis. It serves as the residence of Andor Surathi, a Dark Elf savant. The dwelling is isolated, with no immediate neighbors save for another cave dwelling on the same cliff-face occupied by the trainer Abaalu Essurdan. The location is reached by following the southeastern road out of Omaynis and turning at the first fork.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Surathi Cave Dwelling is.

title: Surimintu
topic_desc: Surimintu is a medium-sized cave located north of Andar Mok within the Boethiah's Spine region. The cave currently serves as a refuge and base of operations for a band of smugglers, drawn to its relative isolation along the rugged spine of Boethiah's coast.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Surimintu is.

title: Surol Suth's Shack
topic_desc: Surol Suth's Shack is an alchemist's store situated in the rural Roth Roryn region of mainland Morrowind. The establishment provides a good range of ingredients and potions. A second alchemist, Vilenu Uvaren, maintains a camp just outside the shack, where she watches over her formulations.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Surol Suth's Shack is.

title: Surpu
topic_desc: Surpu is a Velothi tower serving as a hermitage on the north bank of the Kanit River within the Othreleth Woods. The residence is currently inhabited by Nalmen Drinith, a Dark Elf priest and Tribunal Temple acolyte who offers spellmaking and training services from the secluded site. Accessible by following the river westward, the tower's remote location suits its function as a withdrawn dwelling for a solitary Temple devotee.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Surpu is.

title: Suryn Hamanour's Shack
topic_desc: Suryn Hamanour's Shack is a pondside dwelling in the Mephalan Vales. The structure currently stands unoccupied, as Suryn Hamanour is away at Pamonibu Mine.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Suryn Hamanour's Shack is.

title: Sut-Yakibal Hive
topic_desc: Sut-Yakibal Hive is a small skyrender nest situated on a cliff in the Shipal-Shin region, far to the east of Narsis. It lies east of the Kundasirai Hive, with both nests located just east of Vedas Plantation. The interior offers little of value, harboring only skyrenders whose stings are both painful and poisonous.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Sut-Yakibal Hive is.

title: Suvales Grotto
topic_desc: Suvales Grotto is a small, submerged cavern situated in the Sundered Scar region. Its entrance lies beneath the shallow waters of the Inner Sea, a short swim northwest of Darvonis. The grotto serves as a habitat for aquatic predators, notably Dreugh and Slaughterfish, and contains several Kollops colonies within its single zone. The submerged and hostile nature of the cave makes it a hazardous site for underwater exploration.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Suvales Grotto is.

title: Swimming Alit
topic_desc: The Swimming Alit is a sunken vessel resting on the seabed of the Padomaic Ocean, just northwest of the island of Pamashibabua off the eastern coast of the mainland. The ship's cabin is largely empty, holding little of note beyond a Nordic fur helm. The lower decks contain cargo of kwama eggs, weapons, and armor scattered among barrels and crates, now inhabited by minor sea creatures.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Swimming Alit is.

title: Syndros
topic_desc: Syndros is a fugitive's cavern situated high in the Velothi Mountains, overlooking the Dwemer ruin of Hendor-Stardumz to the east. The cave serves as a secluded campsite, with stored crates indicating a prolonged occupation. It currently shelters a single inhabitant, the pilgrim Dira Folvani, who is accused of heresy and murder by a bounty notice posted in the nearby settlement of Uman. Beyond serving as this hideout, the cavern holds no other notable features.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Syndros is.

title: Tabiash Egg Mine
topic_desc: Tabiash Egg Mine is a House Redoran kwama egg mine situated in the Coronati Basin, with its entrance located northwest of Ald Marak and south of Drals Farmhouse. The interior is modest and typical of Vvardenfell's egg mines, featuring a sleeping area where a notable scrib resides. The operation is maintained by Redoran-affiliated miners and is overseen by a kwama expert stationed at a tent outside the entrance, who is accompanied by a Redoran guard. The mine yields kwama eggs, a dietary staple and trade good of Morrowind.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tabiash Egg Mine is.

title: Tahvel
topic_desc: Tahvel is a large mining operation in the Mephalan Vales. The settlement encompasses two distinct excavations—an egg mine and an iron mine—along with an extensive mining camp that includes a mess hall and miners' shacks. A Tribunal Temple initiate tends to a shrine there, reflecting the settlement's Dunmer cultural presence. Tahvel's proximity to Fort Umbermoth for Divine Intervention and to Akamora for Almsivi Intervention connects it to broader regional infrastructure.
topic_desc_basic: Tahvel is a large mining settlement in the Mephalan Vales, consisting of both an egg mine and an iron mine, along with an associated mining camp.

title: Taldrun Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Taldrun Ancestral Tomb is a medium-sized Dunmer ancestral burial site situated in the Sunad Mora region, east of Tel Ouada. The tomb lies at the far end of a path running through the Orelu Plantation. Its interior is guarded by skeletons and other undead, typical protectors of Dunmer ancestral sites. The tomb contains an ashpit surrounded by four altars, a standard feature of ancestor veneration. A locked small chest rests on the ashpit, and a nearby room holds a grand soul gem and a devil tanto alongside the chest. A small key on one of the altars in the northwestern-most room unlocks the door to this chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Taldrun Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Talmahre Cavern
topic_desc: Talmahre Cavern is a natural cave in the Sundered Scar. It initially presents as a modest space of two pits and an overlying passage, but a secret door—activated by a button on a firepit in the western pit—reveals a deeper extent. This hidden passage contains adamantium veins and leads to an underground lake. A small crevice beneath the lake's ledge provides further access into the ruined Dunmer stronghold of Baan Urlai, marking the cavern as a site of ancient Dunmer habitation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Talmahre Cavern is.

title: Talsilit
topic_desc: Talsilit is a cave situated on a high ledge in the Shipal-Shin region, east of Narsis. Its entrance lies on a cliff face east of the Grand Hlaalu Ancestral Tomb. Access on foot requires navigating a hairpin bend on the road toward Vedas Plantation and then following a narrow ledge northward; levitation offers a more direct route. The cave's interior contains multiple vertical drops that necessitate levitation to ascend. Among its inhabitants are Sharai Hoppers, which may respond aggressively to close approach. A partially flooded chamber at the cave's lowest level holds an ebony halberd alongside a chest containing gold, gems, and glass greaves.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Talsilit is.

title: Tananta
topic_desc: Tananta is a cave in the Coronati Basin currently serving as a hideout for outlaws. The occupants include rogues, smugglers, and warriors, alongside foraging rats, indicating the site's use by those living outside the law. The cave offers shelter for such individuals operating within the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tananta is.

title: Tansumiran
topic_desc: Tansumiran is a cave in the Sunad Mora region south of Ranyon-ruhn, serving as a refuge for rogue Telvanni wizards. Each inhabitant maintains a private study chamber carved from the cavern, connected by winding corridors to a large central room that is partly flooded. The cave's layout requires command of levitation or jump magic to reach one of the western chambers, reflecting the magical aptitude of its occupants. The wizards gathered here pursue their arts in isolation—enchantment, necromancy, alchemy, and sorcery—though their presence is not sanctioned as an official Telvanni holding. Daedra and undead may be found within, drawn by the arcane practices of the residents. The cave is of interest to magically inclined travelers for its concentration of soul gems and other arcane resources.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tansumiran is.

title: Teknilashashulpi
topic_desc: Teknilashashulpi is a Daedric shrine dedicated to Azura situated in the Sundered Scar. The sprawling ruins extend across the swamp, featuring an exterior statue of Azura and an interior complex guarded by frost atronachs, winged twilights, and hostile cultists. The inner sanctuary houses an altar bearing an ebony dagger, though other offerings are cursed to summon a Dremora Lord upon contact. The site contains a copy of The Sixteen Tones of Padhome, which provides access to Khalaan, alongside various other texts and artifacts. The presence of hostile cultists at a shrine to Azura, traditionally venerated as one of the 'good Daedra,' is a noted anomaly.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Teknilashashulpi is.

title: Tel Aranyon
topic_desc: Tel Aranyon is a Telvanni tower situated directly east of the settlement of Ranyon-ruhn, ruled by Master Mithras. Modest in size, the tower is distinctive among Telvanni strongholds because its lower and upper levels are connected by winding hallways rather than requiring levitation to navigate. However, Mithras's private quarters are an exception: suspended on a root south of the main structure, they can only be reached by levitating from the large terrace near the top of the tower. The master's throne room sits across from the terrace entrance. The tower itself offers no services and little of material note, as the nearby town fulfills those needs.
topic_desc_basic: A modest Telvanni tower east of Ranyon-ruhn, ruled by Master Mithras. Unlike many such towers, its main levels do not require levitation to navigate.

title: Tel Darys
topic_desc: Tel Darys is the large Telvanni tower overlooking the settlement of Gah Sadrith. It comprises three areas: the Lower Tower, the Upper Tower, and ancestral tombs. The Lower Tower houses a small library, an alchemy lab, Telvanni Guard quarters, and storage. The Upper Tower is reached by levitation through vertical shafts and contains the living quarters and audience chamber of its current mistress. The tombs, accessible from the Lower Tower, hold valuable artifacts. Tel Darys was formerly the ancestral seat of House Darys. Mistress Eldale, a High Elf and Telvanni councilor, seized the tower after disposing of the Darys lineage with the assistance of Mistress Rathra. Eldale now rules from the Upper Tower as the tower's mistress and a sitting member of the Telvanni Council.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Darys is.
aliases: Gah Sadrith, Tel Darys Lower Tower
Gah Sadrith, Tel Darys Upper Tower

title: Tel Drevis
topic_desc: Tel Drevis is a Telvanni tower situated in the Boethiah's Spine region. It serves as the secluded residence of a Telvanni spellwright who favors a quiet existence away from the mainstream affairs of Great House Telvanni. The tower comprises three distinct zones: a cellar, a staff annex, and the main tower. The household includes a caretaker and a fisherman who operates a boat from the premises, alongside an enslaved Wood Elf.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Drevis is.

title: Tel Gilan
topic_desc: Tel Gilan is a Great House Telvanni tower and town in the Molag Ruhn region, ruled by Master Nisa Darythi. It lies a short walk east of the Imperial city of Helnim. The Imperial settlement was established to exploit Tel Gilan's relative willingness to trade with outlanders, an unusual openness for a Telvanni community. The town supports a large kwama egg mine and offers silt strider transport connecting it to Ranyon-ruhn and Tel Muthada. Its services include an alchemist, apothecary, enchanter, and a tavern called the Cliff Racer's Rest.
topic_desc_basic: Tel Gilan is a Telvanni tower and town located just northeast of the Imperial city of Helnim. Unusually for a Telvanni settlement, its inhabitants are relatively willing to trade with outlanders.

title: Tel Gilan Egg Mine
topic_desc: Tel Gilan Egg Mine is a large kwama egg mine situated in the settlement of Tel Gilan, within the Molag Ruhn region. Despite its considerable size, the mine yields only a small quantity of eggs. It is worked by miners in the employ of Great House Telvanni. The tunnels include submerged sections; near the kwama queen's domain underwater lie the skeletal remains of an adventurer, accompanied by an iron viperslayer. The site was formerly known as the Helnim Kwama Mine and the Helnim Egg Mine.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Gilan Egg Mine is.

title: Tel Mothrivra
topic_desc: Tel Mothrivra is a settlement in the Boethiah's Spine region, aligned with House Telvanni. It occupies a former Tribunal Temple fortress and monastery dedicated to Saint Delyn the Wise. The compound lost military significance after Morrowind joined the Empire and was captured by Akaviri invaders during their invasion. Long abandoned to decay with only monks remaining, the Temple eventually sold the empty monastery to Dralothas Omothran, a Telvanni wizard who now rules the settlement. The lower courtyard retains a statue of Saint Delyn and serves secular functions, while the upper square centers on the decommissioned monastery building, now converted into a Telvanni tower. Tensions persist between the new Telvanni occupants and remaining Temple faithful, as monk cells have been transformed into prisons and slave holdings, and sacred Velothi ritual ash pits used for storage. An egg mine beneath the town supports the local economy.
topic_desc_basic: Tel Mothrivra is a Telvanni-aligned settlement in the Boethiah's Spine region. It occupies a former Tribunal Temple fortress and monastery dedicated to Saint Delyn. The Temple sold the site to a Telvanni wizard after long abandonment, and it now serves as a Telvanni lord's seat, though Temple faithful remain in residence.

title: Tel Muthada
topic_desc: Tel Muthada is a sprawling House Telvanni tower settlement in the Molag Ruhn region. Originally a small farming village, the settlement retains evidence of its agricultural roots through ruined houses to the east. Its contemporary wealth derives from trade routes connecting Helnim, Necrom, and Alt Bosara. The tower is ruled by Llevari Telsaran, a House Telvanni Wizard, who governs with the aid of Aren Sinn. Llevari credits the settlement's success to her family, though whether this refers to blood relations or House Telvanni broadly remains unclear. The populace values honesty, a trait they attribute to Llevari and which distinguishes Tel Muthada from other Telvanni domains such as Port Telvannis. Silt strider transport connects the settlement to Akamora and Tel Gilan.
topic_desc_basic: Tel Muthada is a House Telvanni tower settlement in the Molag Ruhn region. Originally a farming village, it now prospers from trade routes connecting Helnim, Necrom, and Alt Bosara. Silt strider services link it to Akamora and Tel Gilan.

title: Tel Onoria
topic_desc: Tel Onoria is a small Telvanni tower precariously perched on a cliff within the settlement of Marog. It serves as the seat of the Telvanni Wizard Rilmas Athyrion, who rules over Marog from his private chambers. The tower contains an alchemy chamber, a living chamber, and the Marog Registry. It houses retainers, lawmen, and oathmen of Great House Telvanni, alongside enslaved laborers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Onoria is.
aliases: Marog, Tel Onoria: Lord Athyrion's Chambers

title: Tel Oren
topic_desc: Tel Oren is an isolated Telvanni tower on the eastern coast of the Inner Sea, situated along the Dagon Urul coastline southwest of Ebunammidan. It serves as the study of Mistress Faruna, a Telvanni Councilor whose scholarly focus is the collection and study of rare plant species. The tower's interior is largely given over to this botanical pursuit, with Faruna's upper chamber filled with potted specimens. Below, a single large room at the entrance provides living quarters, connected by corridors and a levitation shaft. The reclusive Faruna is attended by her caretaker, who offers spellmaking and spell merchant services to visitors.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Oren is.

title: Tel Ouada
topic_desc: Tel Ouada is a Telvanni settlement in the Sunad Mora region, dominated by the tower of the local Telvanni mage lord. It serves as a hub for overland and river transport connecting nearby Telvanni holdings and Imperial outposts.
topic_desc_basic: Tel Ouada is a Telvanni settlement in the Sunad Mora region of eastern Morrowind, dominated by a mage lord's tower. It offers silt strider, river strider, and boat transport to nearby settlements including Bal Oyra, Port Telvannis, and Firewatch.

title: Tel Ouada Guar Farm
topic_desc: A small guar ranching settlement situated just north of Tel Ouada in the Sunad Mora region. The farm consists of two shacks: one serving as the residence of the rancher, a Dark Elf farmer and Telvanni retainer, and the other housing a Khajiit slave along with stored crates of various ingredients. The operation raises domesticated guar, and the animals can become dangerously aggressive during mating season, prompting the rancher to seek hired assistance from the Fighters Guild on such occasions. Life at the farm is otherwise described as quiet. The settlement reflects the rural economy of the Telvanni hinterlands, where livestock husbandry and slave labor support the produce trade feeding nearby tower communities.
topic_desc_basic: A small guar ranching settlement just north of Tel Ouada in the Sunad Mora region. It consists of two shacks and raises domesticated guar for the surrounding Telvanni communities.

title: Tel Ouada, Tower
topic_desc: Tel Ouada Tower is the central stronghold of the Telvanni settlement of Tel Ouada in the Sunad Mora region and the seat of Mistress Rathra, a Master of Great House Telvanni. The extensive tower features a multi-leveled great hall, a connecting shaft, lower quarters, living quarters, and Rathra's elevated chambers. The exterior living quarters balcony provides access to separate east and west wings. Reaching the upper stories and many interior platforms requires levitation, a typical Telvanni architectural defense. The tower serves as a significant hub for magical services, housing practitioners who offer alchemy, enchanting, healing, spellmaking, and spell vending, alongside a Tribunal Temple priest in the west wing.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Ouada, Tower is.

title: Tel Rivus
topic_desc: Tel Rivus is a young Telvanni tower sprouted from the Dunmer stronghold of Andvaryon, situated at the southeastern tip of the isle of Althoa. The tower's master is Mistress Nira Uldram, a necromancer whose arrival is recent enough to draw remark from the Imperial colony of Nivalis at the island's other end. As is typical for Great House Telvanni mages, the tower itself is accessible only via levitation. Service providers and retainers largely inhabit the upper level of Andvaryon, while the lower level houses additional inhabitants and a vault. The location is a short hop west across the sea from Bal Oyra, or reachable by road running southeast from Nivalis and Bahrammu.
topic_desc_basic: Tel Rivus is a young Telvanni tower sprouted from the Dunmer stronghold of Andvaryon, located at the southeastern tip of the isle of Althoa. It lies a short distance west across the sea from Bal Oyra, or reachable by road southeast from Nivalis and Bahrammu.

title: Tel Sadas
topic_desc: Tel Sadas is a medium-sized Telvanni tower serving as the village center of Sadas Plantation. The structure combines a Velothi tower with Telvanni root growth, a hybrid form seen in lesser Telvanni holdings. The tower and surrounding plantation are governed by Spellwright Angon Sadas of Great House Telvanni. The settlement supports enchanting, alchemy, smithing, and spellcraft services, and includes a Tribunal Temple presence among its Telvanni-aligned population. Argonian slaves form part of the plantation workforce, consistent with Telvanni labor practices on remote holdings. Tel Sadas stands as a modest but self-sufficient Telvanni outpost where a spellwright's authority extends over both the tower and its dependent settlement.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Sadas is.

title: Tel Vaerin
topic_desc: Tel Vaerin is a Telvanni tower rising over the waterfall at Alt Bosara, ruled by Telvanni Councilor Master Vaerin. The central structure encompasses four stories accessible only by levitation, with branching bedrooms, a small office, and a mystically decorated upper chamber where Master Vaerin resides upon a flowery pedestal. The tower houses members of his household and retainers, including an apothecary offering alchemical services on the first floor and a mage tending trinkets on the second. Master Vaerin's sister Varasi resides in the west bedroom. The office contains fine alchemical equipment and expensive potions. As the seat of a sitting Councilor, Tel Vaerin functions as both a wizard's residence and a center of Telvanni authority in the region.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tel Vaerin is.

title: Telomas Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Telomas Ancestral Tomb is a Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Roth Roryn region, near the settlement of Menaan. Unlike traditional resting places maintained by dedicated caretakers, Telomas currently serves as the refuge and operating base for the necromancer Diram Beldros. Hostile undead inhabit the chambers, defending the lair alongside their master. Among the possessions stored within the central chamber is a copy of The Warrior's Charge, a conjuration treatise.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Telomas Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Teloseras
topic_desc: Teloseras is an ancient stronghold situated on the border of the Shipal-Shin region and the southern Othreleth Woods, directly north of the Reman Empire ruin Casimor. The main complex features an unusual vertical layout; its Keep contains rooms accessible only by levitation up central shafts, and its chambers are guarded by undead and bear traps. A vault within the stronghold houses a bandit force and their accumulated treasure, secured behind a locked door requiring the Teloseras Vault Key. The propylon chamber provides transport links to Kaladryon and another destination, and currently serves as the refuge of Dro'Jaaban, a Khajiiti master of Destruction magic.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Teloseras is.

title: Telvan Grotto
topic_desc: Telvan Grotto is a well-hidden underwater grotto located northeast of Alt Bosara in the Boethiah's Spine region. Its entrance is concealed beneath an innocuous pool reachable by following the northeastern path from the settlement. The grotto's submerged passage requires negotiation before reaching the interior, which harbors colonies of kollops and other sea creatures. Within lie the remains of ill-fated visitors, including a corpse bearing a Daedric dagger and a drowned adventurer clad in an Imperial dragonscale cuirass and adamantium bracers. A dry southern section, accessible only through levitation or considerable acrobatic skill, contains further remains surrounded by cached chests and crates holding gold and weaponry. The grotto's combination of concealment, aquatic hazards, and accumulated valuables suggests it has drawn multiple fortune-seekers over time, few of whom survived the journey.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Telvan Grotto is.

title: Telvanni Council House
topic_desc: The Telvanni Council House is the meeting place for the ruling council of House Telvanni on the mainland, housed within a giant orb at the center of Port Telvannis. In theory, the politics of House Telvanni are decided here, though each Telvanni Master often pursues a separate agenda; within the council house, compromises are reached toward common decisions. The Mouths—spokespeople for each Councilor—debate from balconies high within a large domed chamber. The entrance level houses administrative offices handling advancement of lower House ranks alongside a small enchanting shop. Beneath the structure lie the Vaults, accessible through winding cavern passages and heavily guarded, containing significant treasures.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Telvanni Council House is.
aliases: Port Telvannis, Telvanni Council House: Entrance

title: Telvanni Waystation
topic_desc: The Telvanni Waystation is a small Telvanni outpost located in the Boethiah's Spine region, just north of Alt Bosara. It guards the main road leading into the city and sits adjacent to a bridge spanning the northern river. The tower's interior holds standard provisions for travelers and garrison members, including food, clothing, books, and a modest selection of weapons, alongside several miner's picks.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Telvanni Waystation is.

title: TEM Ashrunner
topic_desc: The TEM Ashrunner is an Imperial Navy vessel constructed at the Anvil Shipworks in Cyrodiil and launched in 3E 419. It is currently moored at the docks of Fort Ancylis in the Roth Roryn region. The ship is well-stocked with steel weapons and armor, reflecting its role as a military vessel. It operates under the command of Captain Avelia Dacian, with Lieutenant Leite Cloud-Fletched serving among its crew.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Ashrunner is.

title: TEM Chrysanthippus
topic_desc: The TEM Chrysanthippus is an Imperial Navy galleon of the Thorn Fleet, built at the Hurricane of the North yards in Black Marsh in 3E 371. It ran aground in the Saros Archipelago near Fort Firemoth. The wrecked vessel carried a cargo of wine and Dwemer goods, including Dwarven arms and armor secured in its hold. Imperial Navy soldiers perished during the sinking, their corpses still floating in the surrounding waters. The ship's demise is tied to the fall of Firemoth to the undead army of Grurn, though surviving accounts disagree on specifics: one log records the vessel sinking during the undead assault on the fort, while another describes a failed mission to retake the archipelago, suggesting the garrison may have held out after the initial attack.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Chrysanthippus is.

title: TEM Emperor Antiochus
topic_desc: The TEM Emperor Antiochus is a sunken Imperial Navy galleon resting in the Sea of Ghosts, west of Leviathan Keep. Unusually for a vessel of the Imperial fleet, it lacks a construction plaque detailing its date and place of origin. The wreck's interior comprises a cabin and hold, now inhabited by dreugh and slaughterfish. A locked chest within the cabin contains an ebony weapon, though the vessel otherwise holds little of value. The absence of standard naval records adds an enduring mystery to the ship's service history and the circumstances of its sinking.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Emperor Antiochus is.

title: TEM General Symmachus
topic_desc: TEM General Symmachus is a sunken Imperial galleon resting deep in the waters southwest of Firewatch, in the Dagon Urul region. Constructed at the Sarialos Fleet Yards in Cyrodiil in 3E 362, this warship was lost during the Battle of the Inner Sea. At the time of its sinking, the vessel served in the fleet commanded by General Casik during his assault on Firewatch. The wreck now lies near another casualty of the same engagement, TEM Predator's Gold. The ship's cabin retains a builder's plaque bearing the motto 'Step Forth and Earn It'. Little else of value remains aboard the submerged hulk beyond a few pieces of newtscale armor.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM General Symmachus is.

title: TEM Ghostrunner
topic_desc: The TEM Ghostrunner is a fast vessel of the Imperial Navy currently docked in Nivalis. Constructed at the Anvil Shipworks in Cyrodiil and commissioned in 3E 412, the ship serves the Empire's maritime interests. Its crew includes Imperial Navy personnel such as Midshipman Khori and Mariners Nurion Tilerius and Olfim gro-Gluk. The Ghostrunner recently apprehended the Orc Lish gro-Garrok for piracy; the captive is now imprisoned in the dungeons of Icebreaker Keep, while his confiscated axe remains secured in the ship's hold.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Ghostrunner is.

title: TEM Icerunner
topic_desc: The TEM Icerunner is the wreck of an Imperial Navy vessel, grounded in a small coastal inlet on the isle of Althoa in the Sea of Ghosts. Built at the Thorn Fleet Yards in Black Marsh in 3E 423, the ship now lies broken along the northern coastline east of Nivalis. Little remains within the hull except bones. The surrounding waters harbor slaughterfish, and land dreugh stalk the exterior, making the site perilous to approach. A plaque in the ship's cabin attests to its Imperial origin and construction date.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Icerunner is.

title: TEM Predator's Gold
topic_desc: TEM Predator's Gold is a sunken vessel that once served in defense of Firewatch during the Battle of the Inner Sea. The wreck rests in the Dagon Urul region, a short swim south of Firewatch and the intact galleon TEM Saber of the Straits moored there. Another wreck from the opposing side of the same battle, TEM General Symmachus, lies to the west. The Predator's Gold itself offers little of value to salvagers. A plaque in the ship's cabin bears the inscription 'Onward Into the Blind Dark,' attributed to the Firewatch Dockyards and dated 3E 397 under the Empire of Tamriel. The wreck is now inhabited by slaughterfish, consistent with the fate of many abandoned hulks in Morrowind's coastal waters.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Predator's Gold is.

title: TEM Prince Helseth
topic_desc: The TEM Prince Helseth is the sunken wreckage of an Imperial Navy galleon that foundered in the delta of the Thirr River. Built at the Sarialos Fleet Yards in Cyrodiil in 3E 425, the vessel bears a cabin plaque reading "All In Good Time." Rocks have breached and split the damaged hull, dividing the interior into separate stern and bow sections. The stern contains an Imperial saber, while the bow holds a copy of the skill book "The Wolf Queen, Book VIII." Pearls can be gathered from kollops in and around the remains.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Prince Helseth is.

title: TEM Princess Morgiah
topic_desc: The TEM Princess Morgiah is an Imperial Navy galleon constructed at the Sarialos Fleet Yards in Cyrodiil in 3E 389. It is presently docked at the Old Ebonheart harbor in the Aanthirin region. The vessel is divided into two primary zones: a cabin and a hold. A plaque within the cabin bears the ship's motto, 'Leave Nothing to Chance', alongside its commissioning details. The warship operates under the Empire of Tamriel and maintains a full Imperial Navy complement, including a captain, commander, mariners, deckhands, a smith, and a cook.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Princess Morgiah is.

title: TEM Saber of the Straits
topic_desc: The TEM Saber of the Straits is an Imperial Navy galleon currently docked at Firewatch. Built at the Sarialos Fleet Yards in Cyrodiil in 3E 387, the vessel bears the motto 'Courage Through the Narrows'. Under the command of Captain Garius Rulo, the warship is actively engaged in suppressing smuggling routes across the Inner Sea. The galleon is divided into a cabin and a hold; the cabin houses a locked display case containing the unique blade Saber of the Straits.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where TEM Saber of the Straits is.
aliases: TEM Saber of the Straits: Cabin
TEM Saber of the Straits: Hold

title: Terendas Mine
topic_desc: Terendas Mine is a rich raw gold mine located in the Telvanni Isles, a short distance east of the Sadas Plantation. The site yields abundant gold veins, reflecting the mineral wealth of the region. A small staff operates the facility, including a miner and three guards retained to protect the valuable deposits and the large stash of extracted raw gold held within.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Terendas Mine is.

title: Teriviel Ancestral Tomb
topic_desc: Teriviel Ancestral Tomb is a small Dunmer ancestral tomb situated in the Sacred Lands region. Like similar sites, it serves as a resting place for the honored dead of the Teriviel lineage. The interior consists of a single zone containing undead occupants and minimal interred wealth, limited to a modest cache of gems kept in an alcove within its largest chamber.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Teriviel Ancestral Tomb is.

title: Teyn
topic_desc: Teyn is a small Imperial settlement in the Roth Roryn region, built in the shadow of Fort Ancylis, a stronghold overlooking the Inner Sea. Its population is cosmopolitan; native Dark Elves reside chiefly in impoverished shacks on the water's edge, while Imperial citizens and other newcomers occupy sturdier structures. The settlement's sole significant services are found in Cirifae's Tradehouse, which offers lodging and assorted goods. Imperial authority manifests through a Census and Excise Office and a Customs and Contraband Warehouse, reflecting the Empire's administrative and commercial interests. A lonely lighthouse stands to the north, guiding maritime traffic. Teyn sits along the road leading west from Bal Foyen and maintains boat transport links to Bal Foyen and Ebonheart.
topic_desc_basic: Teyn is a small Imperial settlement in the Roth Roryn region, situated on the road west of Bal Foyen along the Inner Sea. It lies in the shadow of Fort Ancylis and offers boat services to Bal Foyen and Ebonheart. A tradehouse provides lodging and basic goods.

title: Thalotheran Manor
topic_desc: Thalotheran Manor is the countryside retreat of the Thalotheran family, situated northwest of Bosmora in the Lan Orethan region. The estate is overseen by Dralani Thalotheran, who manages its affairs on behalf of her sister, Councilor Ereveri Thalotheran, whose duties keep her in the capital. The property includes a manor house and an adjoining garden. A short distance to the west lies the Thalotheran Quarry, a profitable open-cast gold mine owned by the family. The household includes Dralani's kinsman Dolyn Thalotheran and enslaved Khajiit. A copy of the Block skill book, 36 Lessons of Vivec, Sermon 7, rests on a bookshelf in the ground floor bedroom.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Thalotheran Manor is.

title: Thalotheran Quarry
topic_desc: Thalotheran Quarry is an open-cast gold mine situated in the Alt Orethan region, owned by Eretheri Thalotheran of Great House Indoril. The site yields raw gold from exposed veins and a flooded pit. A cave-in concealing bones beneath the water and blocked tunnels indicate a perilous working environment with little regard for miner safety. An Indoril-style platform overlooks the eastern edge of the quarry, providing the Indoril overseers and their guests a vantage point over the excavation.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Thalotheran Quarry is.

title: Tharonen Manor
topic_desc: Tharonen Manor is a mansion situated within the wooded Lan Orethan region. It serves as the seat for members of House Indoril bearing the Tharonen name. The household includes lay elders, kinsmen, and accorders of the Great House, alongside a Tribunal Temple acolyte, reflecting the deeply orthodox Indoril culture of the region. The manor's secluded woodland setting aligns with traditional Indoril preference for estates removed from secular urban centers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Tharonen Manor is.

title: Thavas Farm
topic_desc: Thavas Farm is a small corkbulb farm in the Coronati Basin, situated on the road that follows the Thirr River south from Idathren. The Dunmer family of Ervysa and Naldyn Thavas operates it. A single field is given over to corkbulb cultivation, and Naldyn supplements the household's livelihood by fishing, selling portions of his catch to travelers. Two Khajiit slaves labor at the farm, having been purchased together in nearby Hlan Oek. The ruin of Othrano stands on the heights above the farm to the north. The farmstead consists of an owner's shack, a shed, and a separate slave shack.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where Thavas Farm is.

title: The Avenue
topic_desc: The Avenue is a large tavern that serves as a gateway into Port Telvannis. The establishment is divided into an East Wing and a West Wing, accommodating a diverse populace that includes Telvanni retainers and wizards alongside commoners and enslaved Argonians and Khajiit.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Avenue is.
aliases: Port Telvannis, The Avenue: East Wing
Port Telvannis, The Avenue: West Wing

title: The Black Ogre Tavern
topic_desc: The Black Ogre Tavern is the sole inn of Nivalis. It is a substantial enterprise spanning multiple floors rather than a modest provincial taproom. The ground floor houses a public bar where rooms may be rented, while the upper story contains bedrooms and storage. A second bar operates from the basement, where a locked door secures a private store of alcohol. Beyond lodging and drink, the establishment offers basic trading services and training to travelers.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Black Ogre Tavern is.

title: The Cliff Racer's Rest
topic_desc: The Cliff Racer's Rest is a tavern in the Telvanni settlement of Tel Gilan, distinguished by sleeping quarters elevated to heights inaccessible without levitation. The establishment's publican sells Rising Force potions so that patrons unskilled in magicka or athletics may still reach their beds. This architectural peculiarity reflects a distinctly Telvanni sensibility, where magical aptitude is assumed even in the mundane matter of lodging. The tavern serves as a gathering place for retainers, oathmen, and hirelings of Great House Telvanni, consistent with the settlement's affiliation with that House. The combination of elevated beds and the ready availability of levitation aids embodies the integrated role of magic in daily Telvanni life, where the boundary between convenience and arcane necessity is deliberately blurred.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Cliff Racer's Rest is.
aliases: Tel Gilan, The Cliff Racer's Rest

title: The Dancing Jug
topic_desc: The Dancing Jug is a tavern located in the settlement of Ranyon-ruhn. It is a modest establishment serving the local community, with a publican named Alasha Kori operating the premises.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Dancing Jug is.

title: The Ghostly Lady
topic_desc: The Ghostly Lady is a vessel moored in the harbor of Gorne. Owned by Rellus Delano, the ship offers transport services. The vessel is structured across an upper deck, a lower deck, and a cabin.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Ghostly Lady is.
aliases: Gorne, The Ghostly Lady, Lower Deck
Gorne, The Ghostly Lady, Upper Deck

title: The Glass Goblet
topic_desc: The Glass Goblet is a medium-sized hostel and tavern situated in the settlement of Tel Mothrivra. The establishment is operated by its publican, Gadave Sethan. As a place of commerce and lodging, it serves the local populace and wayfarers, offering wares through its proprietor and other resident merchants. The tavern also functions as a known haunt for the Thieves Guild, which maintains a presence within its walls.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Glass Goblet is.

title: The Golden Glade
topic_desc: The Golden Glade is the sole inn serving the village of Meralag. It provides standard lodging and refreshment for travelers, with beds available for rent and a publican tending to the establishment's food and drink trade.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Golden Glade is.

title: The Grey Lodge
topic_desc: The Grey Lodge is a tavern and trading outpost constructed to serve travelers traversing the harsh Armun Ashlands. The establishment is owned and operated by Kraki the Grey, who tends the bar, while the trader Gulvu Dreth offers weapons, potions, and armor to wayfarers preparing for the desolate roads. The lodge provides a vital refuge and commercial waypoint in an otherwise inhospitable region, catering to mercenaries, hunters, and other wanderers requiring respite or supplies.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Grey Lodge is.

title: The Howling Noose
topic_desc: The Howling Noose is a shabby tavern in Firewatch that serves as the headquarters of the local Thieves Guild. The establishment is run by Cornelius Sympsus, an Imperial publican with ties to the guild. Its clientele includes rogues, smugglers, agents, and other figures associated with the province's criminal underworld, who gather under the guild's hierarchy within its walls.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Howling Noose is.

title: The Inn Between
topic_desc: The Inn Between is a secluded retreat for adventurers situated within the Mephalan Vales. It provides lodging and services tailored to wandering wayfarers, including a publican and merchant, Revas Baldaren. The establishment hosts several notable residents, among them seasoned warriors and mystics who offer their expertise as trainers to those who find their way to this hidden refuge.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Inn Between is.

title: The Lost Crab Tavern
topic_desc: The Lost Crab Tavern is a small tavern in Port Telvannis, the Telvanni capital. Despite serving as the sole drinking establishment and social venue in a major city, it is remarkably modest in scale. The ground floor contains a bar where the Dunmer publican Hizam Aneroth, a Telvanni hireling, sells food and drink. An upper level provides a small dining area. The tavern's furnishings and stores are sparse, offering little of material value beyond basic provisions and utensils. Its existence reflects the character of Port Telvannis itself: a sprawling Telvanni settlement where public commerce and social congregation occupy a distinctly minor place compared to the towers and ambitions of the ruling wizard-lords.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Lost Crab Tavern is.
aliases: Port Telvannis, The Lost Crab Tavern

title: The Magic Mudcrab
topic_desc: The Magic Mudcrab is the social meeting place in the Telvanni settlement of Tel Ouada. It serves as a local gathering point for the community, hosting a variety of patrons and service providers typical of a remote House Telvanni holding. The establishment provides trade, healing, and spellcrafting services through its resident retainers and specialists, alongside offering a common space for the local populace and travelers passing through the district.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Magic Mudcrab is.

title: The Merchant's Purse
topic_desc: The Merchant's Purse is a small tavern situated within the Grand Bazaar of Narsis, the great Hlaalu city of western Morrowind. The establishment consists of a modest main room containing two tables and a bar, behind which lies a private bedroom and storage area. It is operated by Maldus Sendrul, a Dunmer publican who sells food and drink. A merchant offering thieves' tools and training, Beleru Dalen, is also associated with the premises. The tavern's situation in the Grand Bazaar places it at the commercial heart of one of Morrowind's wealthiest and most cosmopolitan mainland cities, reflecting the Hlaalu emphasis on trade and enterprise.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Merchant's Purse is.

title: The Note In Your Eye
topic_desc: The Note In Your Eye is an inn in Tel Muthada that offers beds, live entertainment, and merchandise. It is operated by a Dark Elf publican and features a resident Nord bard who provides musical performance for patrons.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Note In Your Eye is.

title: The Queen's Cutlass
topic_desc: The Queen's Cutlass is an upper-class tavern situated in the Market Quarter of Firewatch, a mainland Imperial settlement on Morrowind's eastern coast. The establishment is known for its ample stock of Cyrodiilic Brandy, a spirit favored by certain local figures. Lodging is available at ten gold per night. The tavern's clientele includes merchants, savants, and nobles, reflecting its relatively affluent character within the city. It is operated by a Cathay-raht Khajiit publican.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Queen's Cutlass is.

title: The Reckless Maiden
topic_desc: The Reckless Maiden is an adventurer's ship currently moored in the harbor of Helnim. The vessel features a cabin, an upper level, and a lower hull. The cabin serves as the quarters for Sjorvan the Wastrel, the ship's Nord shipmaster, and contains a spell book. The lower hull provides a practical interior with hammocks and storage space, secured by a locked door. Beyond this lock lies a chest holding Orcish armor. Another spell book rests within the hull's main area.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Reckless Maiden is.

title: The Red Drake
topic_desc: The Red Drake is a middle-class tavern in Helnim. It serves as a gathering place for a diverse clientele, including local merchants, traveling sorcerers, and retainers of Great House Telvanni. The establishment is operated by the publican Falura Lleste.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Red Drake is.

title: The Space Gone Missing
topic_desc: The Space Gone Missing is a large cavern existing in its own dimension, comprising three zones: Outer Caverns, Crypt, and Inner Caverns. It contains elements of a Breton crypt apparently displaced from High Rock during the Warp in the West, including Breton-style tombs, mausoleums, navy-blue mithril weaponry, and wooden heater shields associated with that province. The lich Nelgirion the Venerable, who claims origin in the High Rock barony of Dwynnen, lairs in the Inner Caverns. The site is inhabited by skeletons, hungers, and dark seducers. Conventional teleportation does not function within; egress requires summoning the daedra Lord Mhas Vathor. The displaced Passwall magic is implicated in the site's inaccessibility, as recovered versions of the spell transported Arch-Mage Ysadora there. The cavern holds adamantium ore deposits and notable armaments.
topic_desc_basic: You do not know where The Space Gone Missing is.
